kind.doc:
The player's aim mode (`CPlayer::EAimModes`): normal or precision aim. `CPlayer::SetAimMode`
 switches it and passes it on to the wielded weapon's
 [`SetAimMode`](equipment::weapon::WeaponBase::SetAimMode).

variants.name: AIM_MAX
variants.doc: The number of aim modes.

kind.doc:
How the player's aim is assisted (`CPlayerAimControl::EAimType`), stored in
 [`PlayerAimControl::m_AimType`]. `CPlayer::SetAimMode` selects normal aim in precision aim
 (unless the weapon keeps aim assist in precision aim) and auto aim otherwise, and forces normal
 aim when the aim-assist setting is off.

variants.name: ENormal
variants.doc: Aim without assist.

variants.name: EAuto
variants.doc: Aim with assist.

kind.doc:
The local player's aim state (`CPlayerAimControl`, an `ITargetSystemListener`), owned by the
 player. It is a target cache indexed by [`TargetType`]: every per-purpose array holds one slot
 per target type, filled each tick from one camera-derived raycast
 ([`UpdateDirectAim`](Self::UpdateDirectAim)) and the target system's fitness scoring
 ([`UpdateAllTargets`](Self::UpdateAllTargets)). The weapons, grapple, melee, and grenade code
 read their own slot. In normal third-person play the aim is camera-derived.

fields.name: m_DirectHits
fields.doc: Per slot, whether the direct-aim ray hit something within the slot's range.

fields.name: m_LastDirectAimHitNormals
fields.doc: Per slot, the surface normal of the last direct-aim hit.

fields.name: m_DirectTargets
fields.doc: Per slot, the target the direct-aim ray hit, or null.

fields.name: m_Target
fields.doc:
Per slot, the selected target: the direct target or the best-scoring candidate from aim
 assist, or null.

fields.name: m_RayTypeSetting
fields.doc: Per slot, the ray variant that fills the slot.

fields.name: m_DirectPositions
fields.doc:
Per slot, the direct-aim hit position, or the point at the slot's range along the ray when
 nothing was hit.

fields.name: m_DirectGrapplePosIsGrapplable
fields.doc: Whether the direct grapple hit is on a grapplable surface.

fields.name: m_AimPos
fields.doc:
Per slot, the world-space aim position: the direct position, pulled toward the selected
 target by aim assist. Slot [`TARGET_WEAPONS`](TargetType::TARGET_WEAPONS) is the point every
 weapon aims at, and slot [`TARGET_GRAPPLE`](TargetType::TARGET_GRAPPLE) is the grapple aim
 point.

fields.name: m_LastAimPos
fields.doc:
Per slot, [`m_AimPos`](Self::m_AimPos) as of the previous tick. The grapple reticle
 interpolates from it toward the current position.

fields.name: m_IsInRange
fields.doc: Per slot, whether the aim position is within the slot's range.

fields.name: m_DirectPosIsInRange
fields.doc: Per slot, whether the direct position is within the slot's range.

fields.name: m_IsGrappleUsingDirectPos
fields.doc:
Whether the grapple slot uses the direct position rather than a target; the grapple reticle
 is then centred on the screen instead of projected.

fields.name: m_HasLastValidGrapple
fields.doc: Whether the last-valid grapple cache below holds a target.

fields.name: m_LastValidGrappleAimPos
fields.doc: The cached grapple aim position, kept so a momentarily lost grapple target persists.

fields.name: m_LastValidGrappleNormal
fields.doc: The surface normal at [`m_LastValidGrappleAimPos`](Self::m_LastValidGrappleAimPos).

fields.name: m_LastValidGrappleTarget
fields.doc: The cached grapple target, or null.

fields.name: m_LastHitGrappleTargetGO
fields.doc:
The cached grapple game object (a `boost::weak_ptr<CGameObject>`: object pointer and weak
 control block).

fields.name: m_RayCastDistance
fields.doc:
The length of the direct-aim ray: the override distance when positive, otherwise the larger
 of the weapon and grapple slots' maximum aim distances.

fields.name: m_MaxAimDistance
fields.doc:
Per slot, the maximum aim distance, recomputed by [`UpdateRange`](Self::UpdateRange): the
 weapon slot takes the largest weapon range over the selected, wingsuit, and vehicle weapons
 (default 100), the sticky and snap slots copy it, the grapple slot takes the grapple
 tuning's range, the grenade slot the grenade weapon's range, and the melee slot is zero.

fields.name: m_OverrideRayCastDistance
fields.doc: A ray length that replaces the computed one when positive.

fields.name: m_AimType
fields.doc: Whether and how aim assist applies.

fields.name: m_Owner
fields.doc: The character this aim control serves.

associated_functions.name: GetAdjustedCameraMatrix
associated_functions.doc:
Returns the matrix used by the aim raycast: in aim-down-sights it reads the alternate-aim
 transform, otherwise the camera transform. `weapon` adds an optional ballistic pitch. The
 result is written through `result` and also returned.

associated_functions.name: UpdateDirectAim
associated_functions.doc: Raycasts from the camera position along camera-forward to find the aim target.

associated_functions.name: UpdatePostSim
associated_functions.doc:
The per-tick aim update after the camera for `character`: runs
 [`UpdateInput`](Self::UpdateInput), [`UpdateRange`](Self::UpdateRange),
 [`UpdateDirectAim`](Self::UpdateDirectAim), [`UpdateAllTargets`](Self::UpdateAllTargets),
 and `UpdateLastValidGrappleTarget`.

associated_functions.name: UpdatePreSim
associated_functions.doc:
The pre-simulation aim update, which polls the aim control's pending raycast requests for
 completion.

associated_functions.name: UpdateInput
associated_functions.doc: Folds the aim stick input and applies the yaw and pitch dead zones.

associated_functions.name: UpdateRange
associated_functions.doc:
Recomputes [`m_MaxAimDistance`](Self::m_MaxAimDistance) and
 [`m_RayCastDistance`](Self::m_RayCastDistance) from the current weapon, wingsuit, vehicle,
 grapple, and grenade tuning.

associated_functions.name: UpdateAllTargets
associated_functions.doc:
Target selection and aim assist: scores the target system's candidates per slot with the
 per-purpose fitness functions, picks [`m_Target`](Self::m_Target), and pulls
 [`m_AimPos`](Self::m_AimPos) toward the selected targets.

associated_functions.name: CheckDirectTargets
associated_functions.doc:
Distributes the direct-aim ray's hit into every slot except melee: fills
 [`m_DirectHits`](Self::m_DirectHits), [`m_DirectPositions`](Self::m_DirectPositions),
 [`m_AimPos`](Self::m_AimPos), [`m_IsInRange`](Self::m_IsInRange), and
 [`m_DirectTargets`](Self::m_DirectTargets) per slot according to its
 [`m_RayTypeSetting`](Self::m_RayTypeSetting) and range. `collector` is the ray's
 `CPlayerAimRaycastFilterCacheFirstHoleyHitAndMinDistanceHit` filter and `non_holey_info`
 its `CCastRayInfo`.

associated_functions.name: UpdateCrosshairLook
associated_functions.doc:
Updates the per-slot crosshair look (`CPlayerAimControl::ECrosshairLook`: in range with a
 neutral, allied, or hostile target, in range with no target, or out of range).

associated_functions.name: GetCurrentWeapon
associated_functions.doc: Returns the weapon that serves `target_type` through `result`, or a null pointer.

associated_functions.name: GetRaycastStartPosition
associated_functions.doc:
Returns the camera position moved 0.1 units along camera-forward, from the unadjusted
 camera matrix. The aim-distance measurements use it; the raycast computes its own origin.

associated_functions.name: GetRaycastMinDistanceStartPosition
associated_functions.doc:
Returns a start point blended from the wielded weapon's barrel and the character's head,
 against the aim matrix `aim_mat`. The raycast uses its distance along the ray as the
 minimum-distance hit fraction.

associated_functions.name: GetTargetBodyPosition
associated_functions.doc:
Returns a target's body aim position through `result`, optionally for a grenade throw,
 with an adjusted height, or clamped to the hip.

associated_functions.name: GetAverageWeaponTargetPosition
associated_functions.doc:
Copies the weapon slot's aim position (`m_AimPos[TARGET_WEAPONS]`) to `result`. The
 body sits beside
 [`GetActiveGrappleTargetPosition`](Self::GetActiveGrappleTargetPosition); it has no direct
 callers, as callers read the field inline.

associated_functions.name: GetActiveGrappleTargetPosition
associated_functions.doc: Returns a pointer to the grapple slot's aim position (`m_AimPos[TARGET_GRAPPLE]`).

associated_functions.name: GetCurrentGrappleTargetGO
associated_functions.doc:
Returns the cached grapple game object, or null unless
 [`m_HasLastValidGrapple`](Self::m_HasLastValidGrapple) and the grapple slot's
 [`m_IsInRange`](Self::m_IsInRange) are both set.

associated_functions.name: GetCurrentGrappleTargetWeakGO
associated_functions.doc:
The weak-pointer form of [`GetCurrentGrappleTargetGO`](Self::GetCurrentGrappleTargetGO):
 copies [`m_LastHitGrappleTargetGO`](Self::m_LastHitGrappleTargetGO) into `result` under the
 same conditions, and a null weak pointer otherwise.

associated_functions.name: IsLastValidGrappleAimPosStillValid
associated_functions.doc:
Re-validates the last-valid grapple cache against the current camera: rejects it when out
 of the grapple range from the camera or outside the grapple tuning's view angles, and
 otherwise re-queues its visibility raycast.

kind.doc:
The animation-graph condition that the evaluating character is the player's current weapon
 target (`CPlayerIsAutoAimingCondition`). Its layout is unmapped.

associated_functions.name: Evaluate
associated_functions.doc:
Evaluates the condition for the character owning `instance` (a
 `NAnimationSystem::CStateMachineInstance`): true when the player's
 `m_Target[TARGET_WEAPONS]` is that character and is not also the direct target.

kind.doc:
The raycast variant used for an aim slot (`CPlayerAimControl::ERayType`), stored per
 [`TargetType`] in [`PlayerAimControl::m_RayTypeSetting`]. It selects which of the direct-aim
 ray's recorded hits fills the slot.

variants.name: HIT_HOLEY
variants.doc: Stop at holey (see-through) geometry.

variants.name: SKIP_HOLEY
variants.doc: Pass through holey geometry.

variants.name: HIT_MIN_DISTANCE
variants.doc: Take the hit recorded below the minimum-distance fraction.

kind.doc:
A scored aim candidate (`CTarget`) registered with the target system: a weak reference to its
 game object, its local- and world-space aim positions, per-[`TargetType`] fitness and validity,
 and a visibility raycast. Characters, vehicles, vehicle parts, rigid objects, and destruction
 objects each own one. The layout is unmapped.

The aim purpose a target or aim slot serves (`CTarget::ETargetType`). The target system scores
 every candidate once per purpose, and the player's aim control keeps one slot per purpose in each
 of its per-purpose arrays (see [`PlayerAimControl`](aim::aim::PlayerAimControl)), indexed by
 this value.

variants.name: TARGET_WEAPONS
variants.doc: Firearms: the slot the character's weapons aim at.

variants.name: TARGET_STICKY_AIM
variants.doc: Sticky aim assist.

variants.name: TARGET_GRAPPLE
variants.doc: The grappling hook.

variants.name: TARGET_MELEE
variants.doc: Melee attacks.

variants.name: TARGET_GRENADE
variants.doc: Thrown grenades.

variants.name: TARGET_SNAP
variants.doc: Snap aim assist.

variants.name: NOF_TARGET_TYPES
variants.doc: The number of target types, and so the length of every per-purpose array.

kind.doc:
One aim effector of an arm aim IK task (`SAimEffectorProperties`, shared in shape by
 `NRightArmAimIK` and `NReelInAimIK`). The task's `Update` fills the bone index, bone position, and
 gain each frame; `UpdateAimEffector` writes the aim direction and rotation axis it derives.

fields.name: m_BoneIndex
fields.doc: The skeleton bone index the effector rotates (resolved from a safe-bone hash).

fields.name: m_BonePosition
fields.doc: The bone's position, in character-model space, taken from the pre-additive pose.

fields.name: m_Gain
fields.doc:
The effector's rotation-reach weight: the task's aim weight times the per-effector gain.
 `UpdateAimEffector` writes it to [`HumanIK::m_TargetReachR`] for the effector.

fields.name: m_AimDirection
fields.doc: The normalized direction from the bone to the aim target (model space).

fields.name: m_RotationAxis
fields.doc: The rotation axis turning the reference axis onto [`m_AimDirection`](Self::m_AimDirection).

kind.doc:
The aim effector index of an arm aim IK task (`NRightArmAimIK::EAimEffectorTypes`, which
 `NReelInAimIK::EAimEffectorTypes` aliases). [`RightArmAimIK::Update`] fills the effectors in
 this order.

variants.name: AET_NOF_TYPES
variants.doc: The number of effector types.

kind.doc: Shared helpers of the aim IK tasks (`NAimIKUtil`).

associated_functions.name: GetIKWeightValue
associated_functions.doc:
The aim IK weight envelope for the character, in `0..1`: the aim segment's local time (or
 `1` outside it, or when `force_full` is set), optionally overridden from the blackboard,
 minus the local time of the aim fade-out segment.

kind.doc:
The grapple reel-in aim IK task (`NReelInAimIK`). A player-only animation state task, active in
 the grapple reel-in state, that rotates the right arm toward the aim target and swings the chest
 toward the grappling hook. Its per-instance properties are [`ReelInAimIKInstanceProperties`].

associated_functions.name: Update
associated_functions.doc:
The task's per-frame update. Gated like [`RightArmAimIK::Update`] on the player and the
 [`AIM_IK_WEIGHT_ID`](blackboard::ObjectBlackboard::AIM_IK_WEIGHT_ID) weight: aims the `RIGHT_ARM`
 effector at the player aim control's weapon aim point (weighted by
 [`AimIKUtil::GetIKWeightValue`]), then measures the signed horizontal angle, about the `SPINE`
 bone, between that point and a position stored on the grappling hook, and past a threshold
 queues a chest-end rotation of up to
 [`MAX_CHEST_ROTATION_DEGREES`](Self::MAX_CHEST_ROTATION_DEGREES), faded by the reel
 segment's local time.

associated_functions.name: UpdateAimEffector
associated_functions.doc:
The reel-in variant of [`RightArmAimIK::UpdateAimEffector`], additionally given the
 character.

kind.doc: The largest chest swing, in degrees, [`Update`](Self::Update) applies toward the hook.
The instance properties of [`ReelInAimIK`] (`NReelInAimIK::SInstanceProperties`).

The right-arm (gun arm) aim IK task (`NRightArmAimIK`). A player-only animation state task,
 active in the weapon-aim states, that rotates the right arm, the right hand, and the head toward
 the aim target with rotation effectors on [`Pass::MAIN`](animation::ik::Pass::MAIN) at
 [`SolveStep::UPPER_BODY`](animation::ik::SolveStep::UPPER_BODY). Its per-instance properties are
 [`RightArmAimIKInstanceProperties`].

associated_functions.name: Update
associated_functions.doc:
The task's per-frame update. Runs only for the player and while the
 [`AIM_IK_WEIGHT_ID`](blackboard::ObjectBlackboard::AIM_IK_WEIGHT_ID) weight is non-zero: brings the
 player aim control's weapon aim point into model space (the inverse of
 [`Character::m_WorldMatrixT1`]), fills the three effectors (`RIGHT_ARM`, `RIGHT_HAND`, and
 `HEAD`, weighted by [`RightArmAimIK_ArmGain`], [`RightArmAimIK_HandGain`], and
 [`RightArmAimIK_HeadGain`]), and calls [`UpdateAimEffector`](Self::UpdateAimEffector) for
 each. The pole vector is the negated forward axis of the `ATTACH_HAND_RIGHT` bone.

associated_functions.name: UpdateAimEffector
associated_functions.doc:
Turns `props`'s bone axis toward `target`: computes the direction and the rotation axis
 against `pole`, queues a rotation target on the bone's effector
 ([`HumanIK::AddEffectorTargetRotationVector`], `UPPER_BODY`, `MAIN`, no interpolation or
 blend-out), and writes the effector's rotation reach from `m_Gain`. Skips a target within
 about 3 mm of the bone or already aligned with the pole.

kind.doc: The instance properties of [`RightArmAimIK`] (`NRightArmAimIK::SInstanceProperties`).

fields.name: m_AimEffectors
fields.doc: The effectors, indexed by [`AimEffectorType`].

kind.doc: The per-effector gain of the [`RightArmAimIK`] `RIGHT_ARM` effector (initially `0.75`).
The per-effector gain of the [`RightArmAimIK`] `RIGHT_HAND` effector (initially `0.6`).
The per-effector gain of the [`RightArmAimIK`] `HEAD` effector (initially `0.15`).

The effector slot a HumanIK node drives, as assigned by the engine's node-to-effector mapping.
 The mapping is a fixed switch over `HIKNodeId`, so these ids are constant across characterizations;
 a node with no effector maps to [`EFFECTOR_SLOTS`](HumanIK::EFFECTOR_SLOTS) instead, and
 [`GetEffectorIdFromBoneIndex`](HumanIK::GetEffectorIdFromBoneIndex) reports
 [`NO_EFFECTOR`](HumanIK::NO_EFFECTOR) for a bone that is not mapped at all.

 Only nodes the characterization actually uses are present in a given solver, so an id here is the
 slot a node *would* occupy rather than a promise that the rig has that node.

variants.name: CHEST_END
variants.doc:
The chest end, also returned by
 [`GetChestEndEffectorId`](HumanIK::GetChestEndEffectorId).

kind.doc:
A chain entry in the effector-id hash table (`THashTable<int, unsigned int, 1, unsigned short>`
 bucket-chain element): skeleton bone index to effector id.

The skeleton-bone-index to effector-id map (an open-chained hash table). Built at
 [`Init`](HumanIK::Init) time: for every used HumanIK node, the node's skeleton bone index keys
 the node's [`Effector`] id. [`GetEffectorIdFromBoneIndex`](HumanIK::GetEffectorIdFromBoneIndex)
 queries it.

 The key is the bone whose *name matches the HumanIK node's own name*: `Init` takes
 `HIKNodeNameFromNodeId(node)`, hashes it, and resolves it through
 `CSkeleton::GetBoneIndexByHashedName`. Membership therefore follows Autodesk's node naming rather
 than any of the engine's own bone-naming schemes, and the two coincide only where a rig happens
 to use the same name for the same joint. A bone the characterization does not name is absent from
 the table entirely. To go the other way — from an effector to the bone it drives — walk
 [`m_HIKNodeAndBonePairs`](HumanIK::m_HIKNodeAndBonePairs), which holds the same relation in a form
 that can be scanned.

fields.name: m_HashTable
fields.doc:
The bucket array: `m_HashTableLength` `u16` slots, each [`EMPTY_INDEX`](Self::EMPTY_INDEX)
 or an index into `m_ChainPool`.

kind.doc:
The index that marks an empty bucket in [`m_HashTable`](Self::m_HashTable) and the end of
 a chain in [`EffectorIdChain::m_Next`].

A queued positional effector target: place the effector at `effector_position` (character-model
 space) with the given `solve_step`. Interpolation, when enabled, eases the effector's reach
 weight toward the target at `effector_interpolation_rate`; blend-out eases it back down at
 `effector_blend_out_rate` when the target is no longer supplied.

fields.name: effector_position
fields.doc:
The desired effector position, in character-model space (the root-relative space of the
 character's pose, i.e. `inverse(world) * world_position`).

fields.name: is_valid
fields.doc:
Whether this entry was (re-)queued since the last solve. Set by
 [`AddEffectorTargetPosition`](HumanIK::AddEffectorTargetPosition), cleared by
 [`ClearTargets`](HumanIK::ClearTargets) after the solve consumes the pass. A cleared entry is
 *retained* — [`UpdateEffectorsFromTargets`](HumanIK::UpdateEffectorsFromTargets) keeps
 applying its (now stale) position while
 [`DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues`](HumanIK::DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues)
 blends its reach weight toward zero — and is removed only once that reach reaches zero. So a
 set flag distinguishes a target actively supplied this frame from a leftover blending out.

kind.doc:
A queued rotational effector target: rotate the effector by `effector_rotation_angle` radians
 about `effector_rotation_axis`, with the given `solve_step`. Interpolation and blend-out
 behave as for [`EffectorTargetPosition`].

fields.name: is_valid
fields.doc:
Whether this entry was (re-)queued since the last solve; the semantics are those of
 [`EffectorTargetPosition::is_valid`](EffectorTargetPosition::is_valid).

kind.doc:
The engine's wrapper over an Autodesk HumanIK character solver. It owns the HIK character and
 state objects, holds the queued effector targets for each [`Pass`], and holds the per-effector
 control-value arrays (pull / resistance / translation-reach / rotation-reach), indexed by
 effector id (below [`EFFECTOR_SLOTS`](HumanIK::EFFECTOR_SLOTS)).

 # Per-frame lifecycle

 A character drives its IK inside `CCharacter::UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel`, after the
 animation graph has finalized the local pose and before `CalculateModelSpacePose`. For each
 [`Pass`], the sequence is:

 1. Targets are queued (via [`AddEffectorTargetPosition`](Self::AddEffectorTargetPosition) /
    [`AddEffectorTargetRotation`](Self::AddEffectorTargetRotation)) — the aim/reach IK does
    this during animation-graph evaluation for `MAIN`; the hand pass queues its own for
    `SECONDARY`.
 2. [`HasTargets`](Self::HasTargets) gates the solve. If there are none, the whole solve for
    that pass is skipped.
 3. [`SetActiveIKPass`](Self::SetActiveIKPass), then
    [`DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues`](Self::DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues), then
    the solve proper: [`CharacterToIKState`](Self::CharacterToIKState) →
    [`UpdateEffectorsFromTargets`](Self::UpdateEffectorsFromTargets) →
    [`Solve`](Self::Solve) → [`IKToCharacterState`](Self::IKToCharacterState) (writing the
    solved pose back into the character's `hkaPose`).
 4. [`ResetSolveStep`](Self::ResetSolveStep), then [`ClearTargets`](Self::ClearTargets)
    invalidates consumed targets (and returns whether the pass is now empty).

 A target queued before the `HasTargets` gate for a pass is therefore consumed in the same frame.
 It is not *removed* that frame, though: `ClearTargets` only clears the entry's `is_valid` flag,
 and the entry — stale data and all — keeps being applied by
 [`UpdateEffectorsFromTargets`](Self::UpdateEffectorsFromTargets) with a decaying reach weight
 until a later `ClearTargets` removes it (immediately on the next frame without the blend-out
 flag, after the blend-out decay with it). A supplier that re-queues per frame re-validates the
 same entry before the gate each time, so the entry's data never goes stale.

fields.name: m_HIKCharacter
fields.doc: The Autodesk HIK character (`HIKCharacter*`); opaque solver handle.

fields.name: m_HIKCharacterState
fields.doc:
The HIK character state (`HIKCharacterState*`): the current node transforms the solver reads
 and writes.

fields.name: m_HIKEffectorSetState
fields.doc:
The HIK effector-set state (`HIKEffectorSetState*`): per-effector target transforms and
 activation weights.

fields.name: m_HIKPropertySetState
fields.doc: The HIK property-set state (`HIKPropertySetState*`): solver tuning properties.

fields.name: m_PassInfo
fields.doc: One [`PassInfo`] per [`Pass`] (`MAIN`, `SECONDARY`).

fields.name: m_CurrentPass
fields.doc:
The pass currently being driven; set by [`SetActiveIKPass`](Self::SetActiveIKPass) and
 read by the queue/solve helpers.

fields.name: m_UsedHIKNodeIds
fields.doc:
The used `HIKNodeId`s, in bone-index order, terminated by
 [`USED_HIK_NODE_IDS_END`](Self::USED_HIK_NODE_IDS_END).

fields.name: m_TargetPull
fields.doc:
The target pull weight per effector: how much satisfying this effector's target propagates
 into the rest of the body rather than being absorbed by the chain the effector terminates.
 An effector reached with zero pull moves only its local chain, leaving the torso on the
 animated pose. Copied into [`m_Pull`](Self::m_Pull) — verbatim, not eased — by
 [`DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues`](Self::DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues), for
 each effector carrying a queued *positional* target. The foot and hip IK writes this
 alongside [`m_TargetReachT`](Self::m_TargetReachT); the aim IK, which queues only rotational
 targets, leaves it alone.

fields.name: m_TargetResist
fields.doc:
The target resistance weight per effector: how much this effector resists being displaced by
 other effectors' pull. Copied into [`m_Resist`](Self::m_Resist) — verbatim, not eased — by
 [`DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues`](Self::DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues), for
 each effector carrying a queued *rotational* target.

fields.name: m_TargetReachT
fields.doc:
The target translation-reach weight per effector: how strongly a positional target pulls the
 effector. Callers write this directly after queuing a positional target (interpolation
 destination for `m_ReachT`).

fields.name: m_TargetReachR
fields.doc:
The target rotation-reach weight per effector: how strongly a rotational target orients the
 effector (interpolation destination for `m_ReachR`).

fields.name: m_Pull
fields.doc:
The current pull weight per effector, driven toward
 [`m_TargetPull`](Self::m_TargetPull) and pushed into the effector-set state via
 `HIKSetPull` by
 [`UpdateEffectorsFromTargets`](Self::UpdateEffectorsFromTargets).

fields.name: m_Resist
fields.doc:
The current resistance weight per effector, driven toward
 [`m_TargetResist`](Self::m_TargetResist) and pushed into the effector-set state via
 `HIKSetResist` by
 [`UpdateEffectorsFromTargets`](Self::UpdateEffectorsFromTargets).

fields.name: m_ReachT
fields.doc: The current translation-reach weight per effector, driven toward `m_TargetReachT`.

fields.name: m_ReachR
fields.doc: The current rotation-reach weight per effector, driven toward `m_TargetReachR`.

associated_functions.name: Init
associated_functions.doc:
Builds the solver from a skeleton and an Autodesk HIK characterization buffer: creates the
 HIK character/state objects, maps each used HIK node to its skeleton bone index (populating
 [`m_EffectorIds`](Self::m_EffectorIds)), and zeroes the control-value arrays.

associated_functions.name: SetActiveIKPass
associated_functions.doc: Selects the pass that subsequent target-queue and solve calls operate on.

associated_functions.name: HasTargets
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the given pass has any queued position or rotation targets. Gates the pass's solve in
 `CCharacter::UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel`.

associated_functions.name: GetEffectorIdFromBoneIndex
associated_functions.doc:
Maps a skeleton bone index to its HumanIK effector id (below
 [`EFFECTOR_SLOTS`](Self::EFFECTOR_SLOTS)) via [`m_EffectorIds`](Self::m_EffectorIds), or
 [`NO_EFFECTOR`](Self::NO_EFFECTOR) if the bone has no effector mapping. The bone index is in
 the same space as the character's bone matrices/joints (the value the safe-bone-index table
 resolves to). The head bone maps to [`Effector::HEAD`]; the chest end effector is
 [`GetChestEndEffectorId`](Self::GetChestEndEffectorId).

associated_functions.name: GetChestEndEffectorId
associated_functions.doc: The effector id of the chest end effector (always [`Effector::CHEST_END`]).

associated_functions.name: AddEffectorTargetPosition
associated_functions.doc:
Queues a positional effector target on the given pass, or updates the existing target for the
 same effector. `pos` is in character-model space. `effector_interpolation` eases the reach
 weight in at `effector_interpolation_rate`; `effector_blend_out` eases it out at
 `effector_blend_out_rate` once the target stops being supplied. The engine's hand pass calls
 this with interpolation off at
 [`HAND_PASS_INTERPOLATION_RATE`](Self::HAND_PASS_INTERPOLATION_RATE) and blend-out on at
 [`HAND_PASS_BLEND_OUT_RATE`](Self::HAND_PASS_BLEND_OUT_RATE), and then writes the desired
 reach weight to the effector's entry of [`m_TargetReachT`](Self::m_TargetReachT).

 A pass holds at most one position target per effector: if an entry for `effector` already
 exists — including one [`ClearTargets`](Self::ClearTargets) has invalidated but not yet
 removed — it is overwritten in place and re-validated rather than a second entry being added.

 The prototype is confirmed.

associated_functions.name: AddEffectorTargetRotation
associated_functions.doc:
Queues a rotational effector target about a cardinal [`RotationAxis`], or updates the existing
 target for the same effector. `rotation_offset` is in radians. This is the axis-enum overload
 of the engine's `AddEffectorTargetRotation`; see
 [`AddEffectorTargetRotationVector`](Self::AddEffectorTargetRotationVector) for the
 explicit-axis overload. The one-live-entry-per-effector update semantics are those of
 [`AddEffectorTargetPosition`](Self::AddEffectorTargetPosition), on the pass's rotation list.

associated_functions.name: AddEffectorTargetRotationVector
associated_functions.doc:
Queues a rotational effector target about an explicit axis vector, or updates the existing
 target for the same effector. `rotation_angle` is in radians. This is the explicit-axis
 overload of the engine's `AddEffectorTargetRotation`; the aim IK uses it with
 [`SolveStep::UPPER_BODY`] on [`Pass::MAIN`] to bend the spine and head toward the aim
 direction.

associated_functions.name: DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues
associated_functions.doc:
Interpolates the active pass's current control values (`m_Pull`(HumanIK::m_Pull) etc.)
 toward their targets (`m_TargetPull`(HumanIK::m_TargetPull) etc.) by `dt`, per each queued
 target's interpolation/blend-out settings.

 The pass's two target lists are walked separately, and each drives a different pair of
 control values:

 - The **position**-target list drives [`m_ReachT`](Self::m_ReachT), and copies
   [`m_TargetPull`](Self::m_TargetPull) into [`m_Pull`](Self::m_Pull) verbatim, with no
   interpolation.
 - The **rotation**-target list drives [`m_ReachR`](Self::m_ReachR) from
   [`m_TargetReachR`](Self::m_TargetReachR) the same way, and copies
   [`m_TargetResist`](Self::m_TargetResist) into [`m_Resist`](Self::m_Resist) verbatim.

 The reach drive branches on the entry's `is_valid` flag:

 - **Valid** (queued since the last solve): the reach is `SpeedLerp`ed toward the target reach
   when the entry carries the interpolation flag, and snapped to it otherwise. The blend-out
   flag plays no part.
 - **Invalid** (a leftover [`ClearTargets`](Self::ClearTargets) has not yet removed): the
   reach is `SpeedLerp`ed toward zero at the blend-out rate when the entry carries the
   blend-out flag, and zeroed outright otherwise. The interpolation flag plays no part.

 So an effector's pull is only refreshed in a frame where it carries a positional target, and
 its resistance only in a frame where it carries a rotational one — and both copies run for
 invalid leftovers too, all the way until removal.

associated_functions.name: CharacterToIKState
associated_functions.doc:
Copies the character's current pose (`hkaPose*`) into the HIK character state, in preparation
 for a solve.

associated_functions.name: UpdateEffectorsFromTargets
associated_functions.doc:
Pushes the active pass's queued targets into the HIK effector-set state and promotes the
 pass's [`SolveStep`], then applies the current per-effector control values.

 Every entry in the pass's lists is applied, whether or not it `is_valid`: an invalidated
 leftover keeps steering its effector with its stale data while its reach weight blends out.
 A position target replaces the effector state's translation and keeps its rotation; a
 rotation target multiplies its angle-axis quaternion onto the effector state's current
 rotation (an *offset*, not an absolute orientation — a zero angle targets the state as it
 stands) and keeps its translation. The effector states themselves were just rebuilt from the
 character's pre-solve pose (`HIKEffectorSetFromCharacter` at entry), so "current" here means
 this frame's animated pose.

 The final stage loops over all [`EFFECTOR_SLOTS`](Self::EFFECTOR_SLOTS) slots — not just the
 ones with queued targets — and pushes four values into the effector-set state:
 `HIKSetTranslationActive` from [`m_ReachT`](Self::m_ReachT), `HIKSetRotationActive` from
 [`m_ReachR`](Self::m_ReachR), `HIKSetPull` from [`m_Pull`](Self::m_Pull), and
 `HIKSetResist` from [`m_Resist`](Self::m_Resist).

associated_functions.name: Solve
associated_functions.doc: Runs the Autodesk HIK solver for the active pass at the pass's accumulated [`SolveStep`].

associated_functions.name: IKToCharacterState
associated_functions.doc:
Writes the solved HIK character state back into the character's pose (`hkaPose*`). When
 `update_all_bones` is set, every mapped bone is written; otherwise only the affected chain.

associated_functions.name: ResetSolveStep
associated_functions.doc: Resets the active pass's accumulated [`SolveStep`] to [`SolveStep::UNDEFINED`].

associated_functions.name: ClearTargets
associated_functions.doc:
Drops targets whose reach weight has fully blended out, and marks the rest not-valid for the
 next frame. Returns whether the pass is now empty of targets.

 An entry is removed only when its effector's current reach weight is zero *and* it is
 already invalid; every other entry survives with `is_valid` cleared, and
 [`UpdateEffectorsFromTargets`](Self::UpdateEffectorsFromTargets) keeps applying it until a
 later `ClearTargets` removes it. With the blend-out flag set that takes as long as the reach
 takes to decay (`SpeedLerp` at the blend-out rate); without it,
 [`DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues`](Self::DriveAllCurrentEffectorControlValues) zeroes
 the reach on the next driven frame and the entry dies there.

associated_functions.name: ResetProperties
associated_functions.doc: Resets the solver tuning properties applied during floor-contact setup.

associated_functions.name: ResetAllTargetEffectorControlValues
associated_functions.doc:
Zeroes the four target control-value arrays (`m_TargetPull`(HumanIK::m_TargetPull),
 `m_TargetResist`(HumanIK::m_TargetResist), `m_TargetReachT`(HumanIK::m_TargetReachT),
 `m_TargetReachR`(HumanIK::m_TargetReachR)).

fields.name: hik_node_id

kind.doc:
The IK pass an effector target belongs to, and the pass currently being driven. The engine keeps
 one independent [`PassInfo`] per pass. `MAIN` is the general body-IK pass (aim IK, reach IK);
 `SECONDARY` is the hand/grip pass. Each pass is solved separately per frame, gated on whether it
 has targets.

 rotation targets. [`HumanIK`] holds one of these per [`Pass`].

 a single cardinal axis or all three.

The IK solve step requested for an effector target, and the accumulated step for a pass. Each
 target carries its own step; the pass's step is promoted to the maximum of its targets' steps
 (with arm-combining special cases) before [`Solve`](HumanIK::Solve) maps it to the Autodesk
 HumanIK solver bitmask. Higher values solve more of the body.

A cached translation/quaternion/scale triple for a HumanIK node (one per used node), populated
 while transferring the pose to and from the solver.

A pose producer (`CPoseProducer`): owns an animated model's blenders and the `T0`/`T1` poses
 the skinning palette is built from.

associated_functions.name: MakeSkinningPalette
associated_functions.doc:
Queues a skinning-palette job for this producer: advances the time of any time-updatable
 blender, then records the skeleton's bone count, `dtf`, and the two poses into the next slot
 of the global skinning job table (up to 0x1000 jobs per frame) together with the output
 `palette` buffer. The skinning job later blends the `T0` and `T1` poses by `dtf` into the
 palette. Reached from
 [`AnimationController::UpdateSkinning`](character::character::AnimationController::UpdateSkinning)
 in the render phase.

kind.doc:

 A character's [`AnimatedModel`](character::character::AnimatedModel) holds one per animated model,
 the first being the body's.

The state's name hash (`hashlittle(state_name)`, e.g. `hashlittle("S_IDLE")`), identifying

kind.doc:
The animation-system event-id (act) symbol table: maps act names (`ACT_*`) to the sequential
 runtime ids that the animation state machines and [`Character::QueueAct`](character::character::Character::QueueAct)
 use. Ids are assigned in registration order as names are first encountered (by loaded animation
 data or the `NCharacter` id globals), so an act's id is only resolvable at runtime.

associated_functions.name: string_to_id
associated_functions.doc:
Resolves an act name to its runtime id. Registers the name with a fresh id when it is not
 yet present (asserting if the table has been locked), so resolving a name that no loaded
 animation data uses yields an id that no queued act will ever carry.

kind.doc:
The on-foot / land-vehicle reversing act: drives the `S_REVERSE_*` states in
 `rico_base.afsmb`, where Rico turns to look over his shoulder while backing up.
The motorbike variant of [`ACT_REVERSE`](Self::ACT_REVERSE).

The one-off idle-variation act: transitions the on-foot idle from `S_IDLE` to
 `S_IDLE_ONE_OFF` in `rico_base.afsmb`, playing a single idle-break animation (a weight shift,
 a look-around, a fidget) before returning to `S_IDLE`. `NStateTask_InputLocoIdleTask::Update`
 queues it via [`Character::QueueAct`](character::character::Character::QueueAct) once a
 per-character idle countdown (reset to a random ~8.5-12 s each time the character moves)
 elapses while the character is standing still, calm, and not attached to a vehicle.

A keyed value store attached to game objects (`CObjectBlackboard`); the character's instance

 assigned as they are first written.

fields.name: m_CurrentOffset

fields.name: m_BbLock

fields.name: m_FirstLineToDump
fields.doc: The dev dump cursor ("first line to dump"); unreferenced by the game code.

associated_functions.name: SetVector3

The `SetBlackboardValue<CVector3f>` template instantiation. `value` is by-value `CVector3f`
 at the C++ level, which the MSVC x64 ABI passes by reference — hence the pointer here.
 `persistence` is recorded when the call creates the key, and is
 [`PERSISTENCE_LOCAL_FRAME`](PersistenceType::PERSISTENCE_LOCAL_FRAME) at every observed
 call site; `name` is an optional debug label, null in every observed call.

 `NRightArmAimIK::Update` and `NReelInAimIK::Update` (the IK is skipped while it is zero). The

The id of a float marker (written as `1.0` by the stunt set-target-direction task) whose

 other surface-constrained locomotion): when set, the movement task blends its displacement

The id of the camera-relative world-space move direction (`CVector3f`), written each frame
 by `NStateTask_InputLocoSetTargetDirTask::SetupTargetDir`.

The id of the previous target direction (`CVector3f`), written by
 `NStateTask_InputLocoSetTargetDirTask::SetupTargetDir` and read by
 `NStateTask_LocoUtil::EvaluateCharacterDisplacement` as the code-driven displacement
 direction inside its special segments.

The id of the float speed value the input locomotion tasks branch on (`<= 0` routes into
 the stop acts).

The id of the float that replaces the result of
 [`EvaluateCharacterSpeed`](input::locomotion::NStateTask_LocoUtil::EvaluateCharacterSpeed) when that function is
 asked to use the blackboard override and the key is present.

The id of the float turn angle (degrees) the swim input tasks write when they latch an
 animated turn: the XZ angle from the body forward to the desired direction, measured by

 `m_AnimatedTurnBaseDir`/`m_AnimatedTurnTargetDir` pair the swim movement actuators slerp

The id of the target face direction (`CVector3f`): the desired body facing the orientation

associated_functions.name: WriteMetrics
associated_functions.doc:
Writes `entry`'s metrics as a JSON array: the per-category GPU times (named by
 `GetRenderPassCategoryName`), the frame time and its peak, the per-category GPU memory, the
 CPU frame and draw times, the per-phase CPU times named through
 [`CpuProfiler::GetScopeName`](cpu_profiler::CpuProfiler::GetScopeName), and the CPU memory
 usage.

associated_functions.name: WriteTotalEntry
associated_functions.doc:
Writes the sampling session's averages to `total.txt` in the scratch path: build and system
 information, then the average GPU time, frame time, memory usage, per-category GPU times and
 memory, and per-phase CPU times. Called when sampling stops.

kind.doc:
One sampled report entry (`CBorkReport::ReportEntry`): the accumulated GPU per-category, GPU
 memory, CPU per-phase, and memory metrics for a sampling window. Layout not yet mapped.

associated_functions.name: UpdateRender
associated_functions.doc:
The per-frame camera update: snapshots the previous view-projection, lerps the transform from
 `m_TransformT0` to `m_TransformT1` by `dtf`, and recalculates the projection and frustum.

associated_functions.name: SetupRenderCamera
associated_functions.doc:
Builds the render-camera matrices once per draw: applies reverse-Z and the TAA jitter to the
 projection, then rebuilds `m_ViewProjection` and `m_ViewProjectionF` from `m_View`. Runs at most
 once per camera, guarded by the `m_IsRenderCamera` flag. Returns the last matrix-copy
 destination.

associated_functions.name: SetComputeView
associated_functions.doc:
Sets or clears the `m_ComputeView` flag. When set, [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender)
 re-derives `m_View` as the inverse of `m_TransformF` each frame instead of reading a supplied
 view matrix.

associated_functions.name: RecalcProjection
associated_functions.doc:
Rebuilds `m_Projection` from the FOV, near, far, and aspect parameters (perspective,
 off-center, or orthographic per the `m_UseOffCenter` and `m_Ortho` flags), clears
 `m_DirtyProjection`, and applies the reverse-Z remap only when `m_IsRenderCamera` is set.

associated_functions.name: UpdateFrustum
associated_functions.doc:
Rebuilds the 6 world-space frustum planes (`m_FrustumPlane`) and the AABB-test acceleration
 data from `m_ViewProjection`: it inverts the view-projection, transforms the NDC cube corners to
 world space (using `transform`'s translation for the apex), and derives the planes. Reads the
 standard-depth `m_ViewProjection` (not the reverse-Z `m_ViewProjectionF`) and asserts
 `!m_IsRenderCamera`. Called from [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender) when the view is dirty;
 the frustum-cull consumers (terrain patches, occlusion) read these planes, not `m_ProjectionF`.

associated_functions.name: IsBoxVisible
associated_functions.doc:
Tests a world-space axis-aligned box (`CAABox`: min then max corner) against the camera's
 frustum planes and AABB-test acceleration data, as rebuilt by
 [`UpdateFrustum`](Self::UpdateFrustum). Returns whether any part of the box is inside.

kind.doc:
The far-plane default the engine's `Camera` constructor applies; the engine
 reads the live value from `m_Far`.

The near-plane default the engine's `Camera` constructor applies; the engine reads the
 live value from `m_Near`.

 ([`ShadowManager::UpdateRender`](graphics_engine::shadow_manager::ShadowManager::UpdateRender))
 among them.

 so the subsequent interpolation holds it constant.

associated_functions.doc:

 [`Camera::UpdateRender`] on each. This is where the active camera's `m_View` is produced for the
 frame.

 modifiers, populating the render contexts each frame.
An opaque node in the camera pipeline.

associated_functions.doc:
Funnels the camera control contexts into the active camera state: reads the next render
 context, sets the audio listener, applies the jitter filter, and calls
 [`CameraManager::InitTransform`] and [`CameraManager::InitFOV`].

associated_functions.doc: Reads the action-effector inputs into the transformed-gamepad-input blackboard value.

associated_functions.doc: Whether the alternate-aim (aim-down-sights) transform is in use.

associated_functions.name: GetInputMatrix
associated_functions.doc:
Writes the camera matrix used for mapping player input to world space — the same matrix the
 locomotion input task reads to make the move direction camera-relative (its negated third
 row is the camera forward on the ground plane). Reads
 [`CameraControlContext::m_NextRenderContext`](camera::camera_context::CameraControlContext::m_NextRenderContext)'s camera transform.

associated_functions.name: GetCameraMatrix
associated_functions.doc:
Writes the sim-phase camera matrix: [`CameraControlContext::m_NextCameraContext`](camera::camera_context::CameraControlContext::m_NextCameraContext)'s camera
 transform, as opposed to [`GetInputMatrix`](Self::GetInputMatrix)'s next *render* context. Read by the player aim
 control (raycast start position, adjusted camera matrix, target visibility casts), weapon
 aim-target queries, melee and grapple state tasks, and other sim-side camera consumers.

associated_functions.name: GetAlternateAimMatrix
associated_functions.doc:
Writes the alternate-aim (aim-down-sights) matrix:
 [`CameraControlContext::m_NextRenderContext`](camera::camera_context::CameraControlContext::m_NextRenderContext)'s alternate aim transform. The player aim
 control prefers it over [`GetCameraMatrix`](Self::GetCameraMatrix) when [`IsAlternateAimTransformUsed`](Self::IsAlternateAimTransformUsed) is set.

associated_functions.name: UpdateRender

 [`CameraTree::UpdateRenderContexts`], pushes the render context, then updates the lighting and
 water level at the camera.

Adds a reference to camera hint `hint` in the manager's hint table (a hash of hint id to
 reference count), inserting it with a count of one if absent. Camera states read the table
 to select hinted behaviour. `debug_name` is unused.

associated_functions.name: ResetCamera
associated_functions.doc:
Resets the camera control context, the camera director, and the camera tree; when
 `transform` is non-null, also initializes the camera manager's transform to it and stores it
 as the reset transform. Called on player teleports.

flags.doc:
Whether the character may use the wingsuit. Written by
 [`SetWingsuitEnabled`](Character::SetWingsuitEnabled).

flags.name: m_IsStuntAutoExitEnabled
flags.doc:
Whether the character automatically leaves stunt positions. Written by
 [`SetStuntAutoExitEnabled`](Character::SetStuntAutoExitEnabled).

kind.doc:
The character's packed aiming and presentation bit-flags (one byte of `CCharacter` bitfields).
 [`HandleAimingInputPlayer`](Character::HandleAimingInputPlayer) writes the aim bits each frame for
 the player; the locomotion state machine reads them to choose aim-relative (strafe) movement over
 run/steer: `m_AimingWeapon` (or `m_AimingGrapple`) is the switch that makes the body face the aim
 direction and turns the directional keys into strafes. `m_WasAiming` reflects the state as of the
 start of this frame. The other bits are unrelated flags that share the byte.

flags.name: m_WasVisible
flags.doc:
`m_WasVisible`: the previous frame's visibility, cleared and re-latched by
 `CCharacter::UpdateModelVisibility`.

flags.name: m_UseFinalTransparency
flags.doc:
`m_UseFinalTransparency`: whether the character's models render with the final-transparency
 setting. Written by `CCharacter::SetUseFinalTransparency`.

flags.name: m_AimingWeapon
flags.doc: `m_WeaponAimActive`.

flags.name: m_AimingGrapple
flags.doc: `m_GrappleAimActive`.

flags.name: m_GodModeSequence
flags.doc:
`m_GodModeSequence`: the sequence-scoped god mode. `CCharacter::SetupForSequence` sets it
 for the player when [`GOD_MODE`](DamageStateFlags::GOD_MODE) is off, and
 [`SetGodMode`](Character::SetGodMode) clears it.

flags.name: m_InCargoBay
flags.doc:
`m_InCargoBay`: the character is riding in a vehicle's cargo bay. Read by
 [`IsInCargoBay`](Character::IsInCargoBay).

fields.name: m_InstanceData
fields.doc:
The model's animation instance data (`SAnimatedModelInstanceData*`), null until the animation
 instance is created (the first frames after spawn or stream-in). Some character-state
 predicates, [`Character::IsUsingWingsuit`] among them, report false while it is null.

fields.name: m_ModelInstances
fields.doc:
The model-instance slots (`NModelSystem::CModelInstance*`, null when unused): the base
 body model plus attachments and variants. `CAnimatedModel::GetModel`/`SetModel` index this
 array directly. Each instance embeds its render-block-instance info (`CRBIInfo`) at
 [`MODEL_INSTANCE_RBI_INFO_OFFSET`](Self::MODEL_INSTANCE_RBI_INFO_OFFSET), which is the
 `info` pointer its render blocks are drawn with.

associated_functions.name: TryAct
associated_functions.doc:
Tests whether the animation state machine would accept the act from its current state,
 without queuing it. A `CCharacter` virtual forwards to this on
 [`Character::m_AnimatedModel`]; the game's act dispatchers call it before
 [`Character::QueueAct`] to pick a supported act.

kind.doc:
The [`m_ModelInstances`](Self::m_ModelInstances) slot holding the character's
 *body* model -- the one whose skeleton the character's bone indices belong to. The other
 slots are attachments with their own skeletons (the parachute among them), where the same
 numeric indices land on arbitrary bones.

The offset of a model instance's embedded render-block-instance info (`CRBIInfo`) within
 `NModelSystem::CModelInstance` (`CModelInstance::AddToPass` passes this offset to
 `ForEachRb`); that pointer is the `info` every one of its block draws receives. A constant
 rather than a field because the instance type itself is unmapped.

The number of [`m_ModelInstances`](Self::m_ModelInstances) slots. Keep in sync
 with that array's length.

associated_functions.name: GetRawRootVelocity
associated_functions.doc:
The current animation's unfiltered root velocity, in the character's local frame. The
 movement actuators take its horizontal magnitude as the character's speed for the frame, so
 the shipped clips are what set how fast a given locomotion state travels -- both swim
 movement cores scale their wanted velocity by it.

associated_functions.name: UpdateAnimationsTime
associated_functions.doc:
Advances the playback clocks of the controller's time-updatable blenders by `dt` (via
 `CPoseProducer::UpdateBlendersTimeInRange`) without recomputing the pose. Runs each SIM frame
 in the character's animation pass, before [`UpdateAnimations`](Self::UpdateAnimations).

associated_functions.name: UpdateAnimations
associated_functions.doc:
Recomputes the controller's pose from its pose producers: advances each blender's clock by
 `dt` (`CPoseProducer::Update` -> `CBlender::UpdateTime`) and samples and blends the active
 clips into the model-space pose over `num_of_bones` bones. Runs each SIM frame in the
 character's animation pass. A `dt` of `0` holds the animation clocks, producing a static pose.

associated_functions.name: UpdateSkinning
associated_functions.doc:
The render-phase skinning update (`CAnimationControl::UpdateSkinning`): hands the pose
 producer's skinning job to
 [`PoseProducer::MakeSkinningPalette`](animation::pose_producer::PoseProducer::MakeSkinningPalette)
 with `dtf` and the current frame's palette buffer (the control double-buffers its palettes by
 frame parity). `world_matrix` is unused in this build. `CCharacter::UpdateRender` calls it
 (the character-level `UpdateSkinning` is inlined there).

fields.name: m_AimingSettings
fields.doc:
The character's aiming-settings resource (`TResourceCachePtr<SCharacterAimingSettings>`, a
 resource handle resolved through the resource cache). `HandleAimingInputNPC` reads the
 aim-timer refill value from the resolved settings.

fields.name: m_Inventory
fields.doc: The character's embedded equipment inventory.

fields.name: m_HIK
fields.doc:
The character's embedded HumanIK solver. Driven each frame in
 [`UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel`](Self::UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel), after the
 animation graph finalizes the local pose and before the model-space pose is computed. See
 [`HumanIK`] for the per-pass lifecycle.

fields.name: m_PfxCharacter
fields.doc:
The character's physics-side body instance. The movement actuators drive the character
 through it: they write the wanted velocity into its input and its orientation through
 [`SetOrientation`](physics::PfxCharacterInstance::SetOrientation).

fields.name: m_Blackboard
fields.doc:
The character's embedded [`ObjectBlackboard`]. The loco tasks' blackboard call sites address
 it in place on the character.

fields.name: m_DamageFlags
fields.doc: Packed damage-state bit-flags; see [`DamageStateFlags`].

fields.name: m_UnlimitedAmmo
fields.doc:
Whether the character's weapons draw ammunition without consuming it. Read by
 `CWeaponBase::HasUnlimitedAmmo` together with the non-player and challenge-island rules.
 Set through [`SetUnlimitedAmmo`](Self::SetUnlimitedAmmo), which also refreshes the HUD's
 weapon readout for the player.

fields.name: m_AimFlags
fields.doc: Packed aiming-state bit-flags; see [`AimState`].

fields.name: m_CurrentMotionState
fields.doc:
How the character's motion is integrated this frame (`CCharacter::EMotionState`), read by
 the dispatch in `CCharacter::UpdateIntegratingPhysics`. Each movement actuator sets it as
 part of its per-frame update. Left as a raw integer because only a few of its ~25 values have
 been confirmed: `MOTION_STATE_SWIMMING` and `MOTION_STATE_RAGDOLL`
 on this type.

fields.name: m_AimTargetPositionWeapons
fields.doc:
The world-space point the character's weapons aim at, written each frame by
 [`UpdateWeaponAiming`](Self::UpdateWeaponAiming) (for the player, from the aim control's
 weapon aim point). The weapons read it as their fire target.

fields.name: m_AimTargetPositionGrenade
fields.doc:
The world-space point thrown grenades aim at, written by
 [`UpdateGrenadeAiming`](Self::UpdateGrenadeAiming).

fields.name: m_WeaponInputs
fields.doc:
The per-frame weapon input values (fire, precision aim, plant, and the rest), cleared by
 [`UpdateWeapons_Parallel`](Self::UpdateWeapons_Parallel) after the inventory consumes them.

fields.name: m_AimTargetPositionWeaponWasSetThisFrame
fields.doc:
Set by [`UpdateWeaponAiming`](Self::UpdateWeaponAiming) and cleared by
 [`UpdateWeapons_Parallel`](Self::UpdateWeapons_Parallel): whether the weapon aim target was
 supplied this frame.

fields.name: m_ControlParameters
fields.doc:
The character's animation control parameters, which own the character state-bitflag words
 ([`ControlParameters::m_UserVM`]). Almost every one-bit "what is the character doing"
 predicate on this type reads through this pointer.

fields.name: m_LodFlags
fields.doc: Per-character LOD/update-gating flags; see [`CharacterLodFlags`].

fields.name: m_SelectedWeaponSlot
fields.doc: The inventory slot of the weapon the character has selected.

fields.name: m_RotationGoal
fields.doc:
The orientation the character is turning toward (`CQuaternion`, `x, y, z, w`).
 [`SetOrientation`](Self::SetOrientation) writes the rotation into
 [`m_WorldMatrixT1`](Self::m_WorldMatrixT1) and stores the same quaternion here.

fields.name: m_Avatar
fields.doc:
The character's avatar (`CAvatar`), the controller that drives it. For the player it is the
 [`Avatar`] base of the `CPlayer`. Holds the mental state written by
 [`SetMentalState`](Self::SetMentalState).

fields.name: m_IsPlayer
fields.doc:
Whether this character is a player character (local or remote). Gates the player-only
 side effects of setters such as [`SetUnlimitedAmmo`](Self::SetUnlimitedAmmo).

fields.name: m_AimTimer
fields.doc:
The weapon-aim countdown timer, in seconds. It is refreshed while an aim input is held and
 decremented by the frame delta otherwise; a positive value keeps
 [`m_AimingWeapon`](AimState::m_AimingWeapon) set in [`m_AimFlags`](Self::m_AimFlags),
 so the character stays in aim/strafe locomotion for a short tail after the aim button is
 released.

fields.name: m_AbilityFlags
fields.doc: The traversal-ability enable bits; see [`AbilityFlags`].

fields.name: m_IdleFidgetTimer
fields.doc:
The idle-variation countdown, in seconds, driven by
 [`NStateTask_InputLocoIdleTask::Update`](input::locomotion::NStateTask_InputLocoIdleTask::Update):
 while the character stands idle it is decremented by the frame delta, and once it goes
 negative the task queues
 [`ACT_TO_IDLE_ONE_OFF`](animation::symbol_table::EventIdSymbolTable::ACT_TO_IDLE_ONE_OFF) to
 play a one-off idle break, then resets it to a random ~8.5-12 s the next time the character's
 aim reference moves.

fields.name: m_SwimActionParams
fields.doc: The swim locomotion family's per-character state; see [`SwimActionParams`].

associated_functions.name: IsInVehicleAttachState
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is attached to a vehicle (riding, or in the mount/dismount
 transitions), read from the animation rule system's current state. The state machine
 pointers it walks are game-thread data, so the call is only safe on the game update thread.

associated_functions.name: SetUnlimitedAmmo
associated_functions.doc:
Sets [`m_UnlimitedAmmo`](Self::m_UnlimitedAmmo). For the locally controlled player, a
 change also re-selects the current weapon on the HUD so its ammo readout updates.

associated_functions.name: SetGodMode
associated_functions.doc:
Sets the [`GOD_MODE`](DamageStateFlags::GOD_MODE) damage flag and the damageable's
 invulnerability. Enabling it on a living character also restores full health, forces the
 neutral animation state, and notifies the network component.

associated_functions.name: GetGrapplingHook
associated_functions.doc:
Returns a reference to the character's grappling-hook slot
 ([`Inventory::m_GrapplingHook`](character::inventory::Inventory::m_GrapplingHook)).

associated_functions.name: UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel
associated_functions.doc:
The character's SIM-phase pose-finalization pass. After the animation graph has finalized the
 local pose, this drives the [`HumanIK`](Self::m_HIK) solve (the `MAIN` body pass, gated
 on [`HumanIK::HasTargets`], followed by the `SECONDARY` hand pass), then computes the
 model-space pose (`CalculateModelSpacePose`), and finally calls
 [`UpdatePropEffects`](Self::UpdatePropEffects). Effector targets queued before this runs
 are solved into the pose the same frame.

associated_functions.name: UpdatePropEffects
associated_functions.doc:
The per-frame update of the character's attached prop visual effects. Runs last in
 [`UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel`](Self::UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel), after the IK
 solve and the model-space pose computation.

associated_functions.name: HandleAimingInputPlayer
associated_functions.doc:
The per-frame player aiming-input update. Resolves whether the player is aiming a weapon or
 grapple from the equipped weapon and [`m_AimTimer`](Self::m_AimTimer), then writes the
 result into [`m_AimFlags`](Self::m_AimFlags)
 ([`m_AimingWeapon`](AimState::m_AimingWeapon) / [`m_AimingGrapple`](AimState::m_AimingGrapple)).
 The locomotion tasks read those flags to select aim-relative (strafe) movement. NPCs use a
 separate `HandleAimingInputNPC`; this variant is player-only and is the single point that
 decides the on-foot aim/strafe state.

associated_functions.name: IsAimingWeaponPossible
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is currently permitted to aim a weapon (an aimable weapon is equipped
 and the character state allows it). Gates the aim path in the locomotion tasks.

associated_functions.name: IsPlayer
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is the local player. Used by the locomotion queue helpers to restrict
 the aim-relative movement path to the player.

associated_functions.name: QueueAct
associated_functions.doc:
Queues an animation act by id (`act` points at the runtime `idstring` value, e.g. the
 `ACT_*` id globals initialized at startup). Acts drive the animation state machine's
 transitions; unmatched acts are dropped at the end of the frame.

associated_functions.name: IsUsingWingsuit
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is flying the wingsuit:
 [`SB_IS_WINGSUIT`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_WINGSUIT), and only
 once [`AnimatedModel::m_InstanceData`] exists (false before the animation instance is created).

associated_functions.name: IsUsingParachute
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the parachute is deployed:
 [`SB_IS_PARACHUTING`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_PARACHUTING).

associated_functions.name: IsFreefalling
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is in free fall:
 [`SB_IS_FREE_FALLING`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_FREE_FALLING).

associated_functions.name: IsFastfalling
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is in a fast (dive) fall:
 [`SB_IS_FASTFALLING`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_FASTFALLING).

associated_functions.name: IsReelingIn
associated_functions.doc:
Whether a grapple reel-in traversal is in progress:
 [`SB_IN_REELING_IN`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IN_REELING_IN).

associated_functions.name: IsRidingMC
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is riding a motorcycle:
 [`SB_IS_RIDING_MOTORBIKE`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_RIDING_MOTORBIKE).

associated_functions.name: IsSwimming
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is swimming (surface or underwater):
 [`SB_IS_SWIMMING`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_SWIMMING).

associated_functions.name: IsUnderwaterSwimming
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is swimming underwater:
 [`SB_IS_UW_SWIMMING`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_UW_SWIMMING).

associated_functions.name: IsInAttachedToParachute
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character hangs from a vehicle-attached parachute:
 [`SB_IN_ATTACHED_TO_PARACHUTE`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IN_ATTACHED_TO_PARACHUTE).

associated_functions.name: IsPreReelingIn
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is in the reel-in wind-up:
 [`SB_IN_PRE_REEL`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IN_PRE_REEL).

associated_functions.name: IsPreHang
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is in the wind-up to a grapple hang:
 [`SB_IN_PRE_HANG`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IN_PRE_HANG).

associated_functions.name: IsInRidingInVehicleState
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is seated and riding a vehicle:
 [`SB_IS_RIDING_MOTORBIKE`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_RIDING_MOTORBIKE),
 or the body rule system's current state is one of eight riding states (idle, driver,
 passenger, and reverse variants). Reads game-thread animation state.

associated_functions.name: IsInDrivingVehicleState
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is in a driver-seat driving state:
 [`SB_IS_RIDING_MOTORBIKE`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_RIDING_MOTORBIKE),
 or the body rule system's current state is one of four driving states. Reads game-thread
 animation state.

associated_functions.name: IsReeledIn
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character is reeled onto an attach point: the grappling hook's state is one of
 the reeled states
 ([`GHS_REELED_ATTACHED`](equipment::grappling_hook::GrapplingHookState::GHS_REELED_ATTACHED),
 [`GHS_REELED_HANG`](equipment::grappling_hook::GrapplingHookState::GHS_REELED_HANG),
 [`GHS_REELED_UPSIDEDOWN`](equipment::grappling_hook::GrapplingHookState::GHS_REELED_UPSIDEDOWN),
 or [`GHS_REELED_STUNT`](equipment::grappling_hook::GrapplingHookState::GHS_REELED_STUNT)),
 and either
 [`SB_IN_GRAPPLE_ATTACHED`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IN_GRAPPLE_ATTACHED)
 or [`SB_IS_GRAPPLE_UPSIDEDOWN`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_GRAPPLE_UPSIDEDOWN)
 is set or the body rule system is in one of eight reeled-in stunt and hang states.

associated_functions.name: IsGrappleHanging
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character hangs from a reeled grapple: with a hook present, the body rule
 system is in `S_GRAPPLE_HANG` or `S_IDLE_HANG_STUNT`, the hook's state is
 [`GHS_REELED_HANG`](equipment::grappling_hook::GrapplingHookState::GHS_REELED_HANG), or
 [`SB_IS_GRAPPLE_UPSIDEDOWN`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_GRAPPLE_UPSIDEDOWN)
 is set.

associated_functions.name: IsStuntTraversing
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the body rule system is in one of the four stunt-position traversal states
 (`S_STUNT_FWD`, `S_STUNT_RIGHT`, `S_STUNT_LEFT`, `S_STUNT_BWD`).

associated_functions.name: IsInMountedGunState
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character mans a mounted gun: the weapon in the
 [`E_SLOT_HEAVY`](WeaponSlot::E_SLOT_HEAVY) slot is in its mounted weapon state.

associated_functions.name: GetVehicle
associated_functions.doc:
Fills `out` with the vehicle the character is attached to, found by walking the interaction
 graph's top root object and casting it to `CVehicle`; empty when there is none. Takes a
 reference on the vehicle.

associated_functions.name: GetVehiclePtr
associated_functions.doc:
The raw-pointer form of [`GetVehicle`](Self::GetVehicle); still takes and releases a
 reference internally.

associated_functions.name: IsAttachedToVehicle
associated_functions.doc: Whether the character is attached to any vehicle through the interaction graph.

associated_functions.name: IsAttachedToLandVehicle
associated_functions.doc: Whether the attached vehicle is a `CLandVehicle` (cars and motorcycles), by RTTI `IsType`.

associated_functions.name: IsAttachedToAirVehicle
associated_functions.doc: Whether the attached vehicle is a `CAirVehicle` (planes and helicopters), by RTTI `IsType`.

associated_functions.name: IsAttachedToSeaVehicle
associated_functions.doc: Whether the attached vehicle is a `CSeaVehicle` (boats and jetskis), by RTTI `IsType`.

associated_functions.name: IsAttachedToHelicopter
associated_functions.doc: Whether the attached vehicle is a `CHelicopter`, by RTTI `IsType`.

associated_functions.name: IsAttachedToMech
associated_functions.doc: Whether the attached vehicle is a mech ([`Vehicle::IsMech`]).

associated_functions.name: UpdateWeaponAiming
associated_functions.doc:
Stores `target` in [`m_AimTargetPositionWeapons`](Self::m_AimTargetPositionWeapons) and
 sets [`m_AimTargetPositionWeaponWasSetThisFrame`](Self::m_AimTargetPositionWeaponWasSetThisFrame).

associated_functions.name: UpdateGrenadeAiming
associated_functions.doc: Stores `target` in [`m_AimTargetPositionGrenade`](Self::m_AimTargetPositionGrenade).

associated_functions.name: UpdateWeapons_Parallel
associated_functions.doc:
Runs the inventory's parallel weapon update
 ([`Inventory::Update_Parallel`](character::inventory::Inventory::Update_Parallel)) with the
 weapon and grenade aim targets, then clears [`m_WeaponInputs`](Self::m_WeaponInputs) and
 the aim-target-set flag.

associated_functions.name: CanPrecisionAim
associated_functions.doc: Whether the equipped weapon and the character state allow precision (down-sights) aiming.

associated_functions.name: HandleAimingInputNPC
associated_functions.doc:
The per-frame aiming-input update for non-player characters: refreshes and counts down
 [`m_AimTimer`](Self::m_AimTimer) (the refill value comes from
 [`m_AimingSettings`](Self::m_AimingSettings)), writes the weapon-aim bit of
 [`m_AimFlags`](Self::m_AimFlags), mirrors it into
 [`SB_IS_AIMING_WPN_OR_GRPL`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_IS_AIMING_WPN_OR_GRPL),
 and queues the matching aim-transition act.

associated_functions.name: PreSimUpdateGrapple
associated_functions.doc:
The pre-simulation grapple update: runs the hook's own pre-sim update and recomputes the
 grapple-aim bit of [`m_AimFlags`](Self::m_AimFlags).

associated_functions.name: IsTryingToAim
associated_functions.doc: Whether the character is trying to aim (an aim input is active and aiming is permitted).

associated_functions.name: IsTryingToFireAnyWeapons
associated_functions.doc:
Whether any weapon fire input is active: fire, precision-aim fire, or explosive planting.
 `ignore_animation` skips the inventory's animation-permission checks.

associated_functions.name: HasAnyWeaponInput
associated_functions.doc: Whether any weapon input is active this frame.

associated_functions.name: SetMentalState
associated_functions.doc:
Sets the character's mental state on its [`m_Avatar`](Self::m_Avatar) with a hold `timer`.
 Unless `force` is set, the write happens only once the avatar's current timer has run out.

associated_functions.name: DrawWeapon
associated_functions.doc:
Draws the selected weapon when the inventory's animation state allows it: selects a valid
 weapon, queues the draw act, and blocks drawing and grenades until the animation re-enables
 them.

associated_functions.name: HolsterWeapon
associated_functions.doc:
Holsters the current weapon when the inventory's animation state allows it by queuing the
 holster act.

associated_functions.name: ForceNeutralState
associated_functions.doc: Forces the character's animation and control state back to neutral (on foot, idle).

associated_functions.name: SetOrientation
associated_functions.doc:
Sets the character's orientation from a quaternion (`CQuaternion`, `x, y, z, w`): writes
 the rotation into [`m_WorldMatrixT1`](Self::m_WorldMatrixT1), keeping its translation, and
 stores the quaternion in [`m_RotationGoal`](Self::m_RotationGoal). A direct world-matrix
 write; it does not go through the physics proxy.

associated_functions.name: SetYAlignedAttachTo
associated_functions.doc:
Attaches the character to `target` with a yaw-only alignment: computes the yaw between the
 character's and the target's forward directions and calls the
 [`AttachTo`](Self::AttachTo) virtual with that rotation as the offset.

associated_functions.name: IsInCargoBay
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character rides in a vehicle's cargo bay
 ([`m_InCargoBay`](AimState::m_InCargoBay)).

associated_functions.name: SetWeaponsEnabled
associated_functions.doc: Sets [`WEAPONS_ENABLED`](DamageStateFlags::WEAPONS_ENABLED).

associated_functions.name: SetParachuteEnabled
associated_functions.doc: Sets [`m_IsParachuteEnabled`](AbilityFlags::m_IsParachuteEnabled).

associated_functions.name: SetWingsuitEnabled
associated_functions.doc: Sets [`m_IsWingsuitEnabled`](AbilityFlags::m_IsWingsuitEnabled).

associated_functions.name: SetStuntAutoExitEnabled
associated_functions.doc: Sets [`m_IsStuntAutoExitEnabled`](AbilityFlags::m_IsStuntAutoExitEnabled).

functions.name: AttachTo
functions.doc:
Attaches the character to a parent (`CCharacter::AttachTo`): `target` is the parent's
 attach frame, `object` the parent object, `attach_type` a `CCharacter::AttachType`, and
 `offset` the character's transform relative to the parent frame. While attached, the
 character's world transform follows the parent instead of the physics proxy.
 [`SetYAlignedAttachTo`](Self::SetYAlignedAttachTo) is the yaw-aligned wrapper.

kind.doc:
The offset of the character's `CGameObject` base subobject. RTTI tests (`IsType`) and the
 `CGameObject` virtuals go through the vtable at this offset rather than the primary one,
 and state tasks recover the character from that subobject by subtracting this offset.

The slot, in the vtable of the [`GAME_OBJECT_BASE_OFFSET`](Self::GAME_OBJECT_BASE_OFFSET)
 subobject, of `CGameObject::InitTransform(const CMatrix4f*)`: it re-bases the object's world
 transform directly. `CGameWorld::TeleportPlayerInstant` moves the player character through it.
`m_CurrentMotionState` while ragdolling.
`m_CurrentMotionState` while swimming, written by both swim movement cores every frame.

Per-character LOD/update-gating flags. Checked before the SIM-phase animation and IK work:
 [`UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel`](Character::UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel) skips the
 HumanIK solve when [`REDUCED_LOD`](Self::REDUCED_LOD) is set. Only that bit is mapped.

fields.name: AttachTo
fields.doc:
Attaches the character to a parent (`CCharacter::AttachTo`): `target` is the parent's
 attach frame, `object` the parent object, `attach_type` a `CCharacter::AttachType`, and
 `offset` the character's transform relative to the parent frame. While attached, the
 character's world transform follows the parent instead of the physics proxy.
 [`SetYAlignedAttachTo`](Self::SetYAlignedAttachTo) is the yaw-aligned wrapper.

kind.doc:
The global HumanIK enable (`CCharacter::m_EnableHIK`): the engine gates the whole IK pass in
 [`UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel`](Character::UpdatePassFinalizePose_Parallel) on it.

`CCharacter::m_ForceCombat`: while set, `CPlayer::UpdateMentalState` holds the player in the
 combat mental state.

`CCharacter::m_ForceNonCombat`: while set, `CPlayer::UpdateMentalState` holds the player in the
 relaxed mental state. Checked before [`Character_ForceCombat`].

A byte of `CCharacter` bitfields holding the visibility, invulnerability, and weapons-enabled
 flags. Not every bit is mapped: three of the remaining bits are, in ascending order, `Enabled`,
 `m_GhostMode`, and `m_PermanentGhostMode`, and these names are unconfirmed.

flags.name: VISIBLE
flags.doc: `Visible`: whether the character's models are shown. Read by `CCharacter::IsVisible`.

flags.name: GOD_MODE
JESUS_MODE
flags.doc:
`m_JesusMode`: the damage-immune variant written by `CCharacter::SetJesusMode`, which, when
 enabling it on a living character, also restores health and forces the neutral state.

flags.name: WEAPONS_ENABLED
flags.doc:
`m_WeaponsEnabled`: whether the character may use its weapons. Written by
 [`SetWeaponsEnabled`](Character::SetWeaponsEnabled); `HandleAimingInputNPC` only lets an
 aim-capable weapon refresh the aim timer while it is set.

kind.doc:
The character's animation control parameters (`CControlParameters`), reached through
 [`Character::m_ControlParameters`](character::character::Character::m_ControlParameters). Only some
 members are bound.

fields.name: m_AimTargetWeapons
fields.doc:
The weapon aim point (world space), copied here from the player's aim control each frame by
 `CPlayer::UpdatePostCamera` alongside
 [`Character::UpdateWeaponAiming`](character::character::Character::UpdateWeaponAiming).

fields.name: m_UserVM
fields.doc: The animation user VM state, holding the character state-bitflag words.

kind.doc:
The animation state machine's per-instance data (`SUserVM`, derived from
 `SAnimatedModelInstanceData`): the register file and the state-bitflag words. Animation-graph
 evaluation on the SIM tick sets and clears the bits as the state machine enters and leaves
 states; the one-bit predicates on [`Character`](character::character::Character) read them. The
 words are game-thread data.

 The bits are named by [`StateBitFlag`](state::StateBitFlag), an index across the words: bit `n`
 lives in word `n / 64` at position `n % 64`, so its mask within that word is `1 << (n % 64)`.

fields.name: m_Registers
fields.doc: The animation register array.

fields.name: m_CurrentStateBitFlags0
fields.doc: The current state bits `0..64` ([`StateBitFlag`](state::StateBitFlag) indices `0x00..0x40`).

fields.name: m_CurrentStateBitFlags1
fields.doc: The current state bits `64..128` ([`StateBitFlag`](state::StateBitFlag) indices `0x40..0x80`).

fields.name: m_CurrentStateBitFlags2
fields.doc: The current state bits `128..192` ([`StateBitFlag`](state::StateBitFlag) indices `0x80..0xC0`).

fields.name: m_CurrentStateBitFlags3
fields.doc: The fourth state word; no state bit is assigned to it.

kind.doc:
The character's equipment inventory (`CInventory`), embedded in `CCharacter`
 ([`Character::m_Inventory`](character::character::Character::m_Inventory)). Only some members
 are mapped.

fields.name: m_GrapplingHook
fields.doc:
The character's grappling hook, or null before the inventory is populated.
 `CCharacter::GetGrapplingHook` returns a reference to this field.

fields.name: m_DoesAnimationAllowShooting
fields.doc:
Whether the current animation permits shooting; one half of
 [`GetAnimationAllowsShooting`](Self::GetAnimationAllowsShooting).

fields.name: m_Character
fields.doc: The character that owns the inventory.

associated_functions.name: Update_Parallel
associated_functions.doc:
The inventory's parallel per-frame update. `muzzle_target` and `grenade_target` point at
 by-value `CVector3f` copies of the owner's weapon and grenade aim targets.

associated_functions.name: UpdateWeapons_Parallel
associated_functions.doc:
The inventory's parallel weapon update, taking the same aim targets as
 [`Update_Parallel`](Self::Update_Parallel).

associated_functions.name: GetAnimationAllowsShooting
associated_functions.doc:
Whether the character may shoot: [`m_DoesAnimationAllowShooting`](Self::m_DoesAnimationAllowShooting)
 is set and the owner's
 [`SB_DISABLE_SHOOT`](state::StateBitFlag::SB_DISABLE_SHOOT) state
 bit is clear.

associated_functions.name: UpdateInventoryPermissions
associated_functions.doc:
Recomputes the inventory's per-frame permissions from the owner's state (it consults the
 grapple reel-in predicates among others).

associated_functions.name: UpdateWeaponHandling
associated_functions.doc: The inventory's per-frame weapon-handling update (`CInventory::UpdateWeaponHandling`).

associated_functions.name: UpdateAttachmentEffects
associated_functions.doc:
Updates the inventory's attached effect container (the wielded weapon's muzzle flash,
 casings, and sounds), when it has one.

kind.doc:
An inventory weapon slot (`CInventory::EWeaponSlot`). Mounted guns a character picks up occupy
 [`E_SLOT_HEAVY`](Self::E_SLOT_HEAVY): `CCharacter::IsInMountedGunState` tests the weapon in that
 slot.
The player's aim mode (`CPlayer::EAimModes`), held in [`Player::m_AimMode`].

variants.name: AIM_NORMAL
variants.doc: Normal (hip) aim.

variants.name: AIM_PRECISION
variants.doc: Precision (down-sights) aim.

kind.doc:
The local player object (`CPlayer`). It derives from `NEvent::CEventHandler` and then
 `CAvatar`, so the [`Avatar`] base sits at [`AVATAR_BASE_OFFSET`](Self::AVATAR_BASE_OFFSET) and a
 character's [`m_Avatar`](character::character::Character::m_Avatar) points there rather than at
 the start of the player. Only some members are bound.

fields.name: m_Character
fields.doc: The player's character.

fields.name: m_AimControl
fields.doc:
The player's aim control, which resolves the aim points each frame. Its weapon aim point
 (the [`TARGET_WEAPONS`](aim::target::TargetType::TARGET_WEAPONS) slot of
 [`m_AimPos`](aim::aim::PlayerAimControl::m_AimPos)) is the target the arm aim IK tasks steer
 toward.

fields.name: m_AimMode
fields.doc:
The player's aim mode: [`AIM_PRECISION`](AimMode::AIM_PRECISION) while in precision
 (down-sights) aim, [`AIM_NORMAL`](AimMode::AIM_NORMAL) otherwise. Written by
 [`SetAimMode`](Self::SetAimMode).

fields.name: m_AimModeChangeTime
fields.doc:
The game time ([`Clock`](clock::Clock) game-time milliseconds) at which
 [`m_AimMode`](Self::m_AimMode) last changed.

associated_functions.name: SetAimMode
associated_functions.doc:
Switches the player's aim mode. Entering precision aim
 ([`AIM_PRECISION`](AimMode::AIM_PRECISION)) is refused while
 falling without a parachute or when the character has none of the aimable weapon slots
 filled. On a change it records [`m_AimModeChangeTime`](Self::m_AimModeChangeTime), adds or
 removes the precision-aim camera hint (adding it only when `add_camera_hint` is set), sets
 the aim control's aim state, and forwards the mode to the selected weapon (or draws it).

associated_functions.name: UpdateAimMode
associated_functions.doc:
Drops the player out of precision aim ([`SetAimMode`](Self::SetAimMode) with
 [`AIM_NORMAL`](AimMode::AIM_NORMAL)) when the
 character can no longer precision-aim and is not planting an explosive. Called from
 `CPlayer::UpdatePostPhysics`.

kind.doc: The offset of the [`Avatar`] base within the player.

`SSwimActionParams`: the per-character state the swim locomotion family carries across frames,
 embedded in [`Character`](character::character::Character). Constructed by
 [`Construct`](Self::Construct), which is where the fixed capsule offsets below get their
 values. Only some members are bound; the rest of the struct (momentum, transition and warping
 state, the surface-plane quaternions, the procedural anim amounts) is covered by the minimum
 size.

fields.name: m_UwSwimmingCapsuleOffset
fields.doc:
The rigid transform from the character's orientation frame to the physics capsule frame
 while swimming underwater: `RotationX(-1.256636)` (about -72 degrees) with a small downward
 translation. The underwater movement core composes it onto the orientation it computes
 before handing the result to
 [`PfxCharacterInstance::SetOrientation`](physics::PfxCharacterInstance::SetOrientation).

fields.name: m_UwSwimmingCapsuleOffsetInv
