 destination must already be resident. Asserts when a deferred teleport is in flight.
 Main thread only.

fields.name: IsTeleporting
fields.doc: Whether a deferred [`TeleportPlayer`](Self::TeleportPlayer) is still being serviced.

kind.doc:
`CTeleport`: a placed game object that teleports the player to its own transform when
 triggered by its teleport event, through [`GameWorld::TeleportPlayer`]. Only the fields
 [`Teleport`](Self::Teleport) reads are mapped.

fields.name: m_LocalTransform
fields.doc: The object's local transform.

fields.name: m_WorldMatrix
fields.doc: The object's world transform: the teleport destination.

fields.name: m_TeleportObjectId
fields.doc: The optional object whose arrival state is checked before teleporting.

fields.name: m_State
fields.doc: The character state to enter on arrival.

fields.name: m_Flags
fields.doc: The packed flags.

associated_functions.name: SetTransform
associated_functions.doc:
`CTeleport::SetTransform`: copies `world_matrix` into
 [`m_WorldMatrix`](Self::m_WorldMatrix).

associated_functions.name: Teleport
associated_functions.doc:
`CTeleport::Teleport`: issues [`GameWorld::TeleportPlayer`] to
 [`m_WorldMatrix`](Self::m_WorldMatrix) with the object's state, fade times, and flags, posts
 the teleport message, and clears the pending-teleport bit
 ([`m_Teleport`](TeleportFlags::m_Teleport)). Called from
 `CTeleport::UpdatePreSim` when a teleport is pending.

kind.doc:
The packed flag bits of [`Teleport::m_Flags`] (`CTeleport`'s bitfield members, from the low bit
 upward).

flags.name: m_Teleport
flags.doc: A teleport is pending; [`Teleport::Teleport`] clears it.

flags.name: m_UseFade
flags.doc: Fade to black: passed as `use_fade` to [`GameWorld::TeleportPlayer`].

flags.name: m_IgnoreFade
flags.doc: Adds [`TELEPORT_FLAG_NO_FADE`](GameWorld::TELEPORT_FLAG_NO_FADE) to the teleport flags.

flags.name: m_bUseLoadingScreen
flags.doc: Passed as `use_load_screen` to [`GameWorld::TeleportPlayer`].

kind.doc:
The game world object manager: owns the character occlusion BFBC state and drives the per-frame
 character occlusion cull. Each frame, [`StartCommitAddRemove`](Self::StartCommitAddRemove)
 copies the camera manager's active camera into [`m_OcclusionCamera`](Self::m_OcclusionCamera)
 and dispatches [`ProcessCharacterOcclusion`](Self::ProcessCharacterOcclusion) via a
 CPU fragment. That function builds a BFBC cull frustum from the active camera via
 [`GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::OccluderCollectionManager::GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime),
 then runs `BFBCProcess` with `E_BFBC_PROCESSFUNCTION_FRUSTUM_CULL` to cull character occlusion —
 hiding characters the frustum rejects. The frustum is built from the single active camera's
 projection.

fields.name: m_OcclusionCamera
fields.doc:
The camera the character occlusion cull builds its BFBC frustum against. Set each frame by
 [`StartCommitAddRemove`](Self::StartCommitAddRemove) from
 [`CameraManager::m_ActiveCamera`](camera::camera_manager::CameraManager::m_ActiveCamera).

fields.name: m_CharacterBFBCContext
fields.doc: The BFBC cull context for character occlusion.

associated_functions.name: StartCommitAddRemove
associated_functions.doc:
Copies the camera manager's active camera into
 [`m_OcclusionCamera`](Self::m_OcclusionCamera), along with its frustum planes
 and transform, then dispatches
 [`ProcessCharacterOcclusion`](Self::ProcessCharacterOcclusion) via a CPU
 fragment (`CallProxy`).

associated_functions.name: ProcessCharacterOcclusion
associated_functions.doc:
Builds a BFBC cull frustum from [`m_OcclusionCamera`](Self::m_OcclusionCamera)
 via [`GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::OccluderCollectionManager::GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime),
 then runs `BFBCProcess` with `E_BFBC_PROCESSFUNCTION_FRUSTUM_CULL` to cull character occlusion.
 Dispatched asynchronously from
 [`StartCommitAddRemove`](Self::StartCommitAddRemove).

kind.doc: The occluder collection the BFBC occluder-frustum build draws candidates from. Opaque.

A BFBC (beam-frustum-based-culling) occluder frustum: a set of planes the cull tests boxes
 against. Opaque.
The settings for the BFBC occluder-frustum build. Opaque.
A BFBC process state. Opaque.

fields.name: m_BackBuffer
fields.doc:
The presentable back-buffer surface owned by the DXGI swapchain, returned by
 [`GetDeviceSurface`]``(BackBuffer). [`ResizeBuffers`] recreates its RTV/SRV/texture on a
 swapchain resize.

fields.name: m_DeviceInfo
fields.doc:
The device's live mode descriptor. [`ResizeBuffers`] writes its display dimensions/ratio on a
 swapchain resize; [`GetDeviceInfo`] returns a copy of it. Subsystems that re-size their own
 render targets read their dimensions from here (via [`GetDeviceInfo`]), so it is the
 device-side source of the display size independent of the [`CreateRenderSetups`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::CreateRenderSetups)
 parameter.

fields.name: m_WasResized
fields.doc: Set when the swapchain has been resized since the last time the flag was consumed.

kind.doc:
The device's cached mode/capability descriptor. [`GetDeviceInfo`] returns a copy of the device's own
 instance ([`Device::m_DeviceInfo`]), and [`CreateRenderSetups`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::CreateRenderSetups)
 sizes every scene render target from a caller-supplied copy's
 [`m_DisplayWidth`](Self::m_DisplayWidth)/[`m_DisplayHeight`](Self::m_DisplayHeight).

fields.name: m_DisplayWidth
fields.doc: The display width in pixels. The source of every scene render target's width.

fields.name: m_DisplayHeight
fields.doc: The display height in pixels. The source of every scene render target's height.

fields.name: m_DisplayRatio
fields.doc: The display aspect ratio (`m_DisplayWidth / m_DisplayHeight`).

fields.name: m_DisplayPresentationInterval
fields.doc: The present sync interval (0 disables vsync).

kind.doc:
The surface a device exposes to [`GetDeviceSurface`]. The presentable back buffer is
 [`BackBuffer`](Self::BackBuffer); the eye-specific variants are for stereo output devices.

The `flags` argument of [`Clear`] (`Graphics::EClearFlags`): which targets of the bound render
 setup to clear. [`Clear`] clears the colour targets for any of the channel bits and the
 depth-stencil view for the depth and stencil bits.

flags.name: CLEAR_DEPTHBUFFER
flags.doc: Clears the depth buffer.

flags.name: CLEAR_STENCILBUFFER
flags.doc: Clears the stencil buffer.

kind.doc:
Parameters to [`CreateDomainProgram`]: the compiled DXBC bytecode, its byte length, and a debug
 name. Same layout as [`CreateVertexProgramParams`].

Parameters to [`CreateFragmentProgram`]: the compiled DXBC bytecode (`m_Code`) and its byte length
 (`m_Size`), passed straight through to `ID3D11Device::CreatePixelShader`. `m_Size` is read as a
 pointer-width value (the bytecode length argument to `CreatePixelShader`).

Parameters to [`CreateHullProgram`]: the compiled DXBC bytecode, its byte length, and a debug name.
 Same layout as [`CreateVertexProgramParams`].

Parameters to [`CreateVertexProgram`]: the compiled DXBC bytecode, its byte length, and a debug
 name (attached to the D3D object and used to size the retained bytecode copy).

The primitive topology passed to the draw wrappers. The patchlist variants are tessellation
 control-point counts.

The constant-buffer size classes (`CB_SIZES`), in `float4` rows and ascending.
 [`SetFragmentProgramConstantBufferSize`] and [`SetVertexProgramConstantBufferSize`] round a
 requested row count up to the first entry at or above it, and the context pre-creates one pooled
 `ID3D11Buffer` per slot and size class.
The global-illumination render pass (`RP_GLOBAL_ILLUMINATION`), owning the LPV [`GISolver`].

fields.name: m_pGISolver
fields.doc: The LPV solver the pass delegates its GI work to.

kind.doc:
The light-propagation-volume solver: RSM inject + LPV propagation for the global-illumination pass.
 `CGISolver::Execute` refreshes one of the two LPV cascades each dispatch and toggles
 [`m_CascadeToUpdate`](Self::m_CascadeToUpdate) afterward, so the cascades are refreshed in
 alternation across frames.

fields.name: m_CascadeToUpdate
fields.doc:
Selects which of the two LPV cascades is freshly injected + propagated this dispatch. Toggles
 `0 <-> 1` once per `Execute` (i.e. once per `Draw`).

kind.doc:
The scene light manager, owning the global-illumination pass. The singleton address holds a pointer
 to the manager, which is null until the light system initializes.

fields.name: m_GlobalLightDiffuse
fields.doc:
The diffuse colour of the embedded global light (the sun, or the moon at night) -- the head
 of `m_GlobalLight.m_Light.Diffuse`. The atmospheric-scattering sky-lighting compute and the
 deferred sun term both read it.

fields.name: m_GIPass
fields.doc: The global-illumination render pass.

kind.doc:
A ring of GPU queries buffered over several frames (`NGraphicsEngine::CGPUBufferedQuery`): each
 query kind has `count * m_NumBuffers` handles, so a caller can issue queries this frame and read
 them back buffers later without stalling on the GPU. The issue functions return the handle index
 they used, or [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX) when the kind's per-buffer
 capacity is exhausted.

fields.name: m_Params
fields.doc: The per-buffer capacity of each kind, and the buffer count.

fields.name: m_Current
fields.doc: This frame's usage of each kind; `m_NumBuffers` holds the current buffer index.

associated_functions.name: Create
associated_functions.doc: Allocates the handle arrays and creates `count * m_NumBuffers` queries of each kind.

associated_functions.name: Destroy
associated_functions.doc: Destroys every query and frees the handle arrays.

associated_functions.name: SetTimestamp
associated_functions.doc:
Issues the next timestamp query of the current buffer; returns its index or
 [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX).

associated_functions.name: SetFence
associated_functions.doc:
Issues the next event (fence) query of the current buffer; returns its index or
 [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX).

associated_functions.name: SetOcclusionBegin
associated_functions.doc:
Begins the next occlusion query of the current buffer; returns its index or
 [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX).

associated_functions.name: SetOcclusionEnd
associated_functions.doc: Ends the occlusion query at `index` (ignored when it is [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX)).

associated_functions.name: SetFrequencyBegin
associated_functions.doc:
Begins the next timestamp-disjoint (frequency) query of the current buffer; returns its index
 or [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX).

associated_functions.name: GetOcclusionResult
associated_functions.doc: Reads the occlusion query at `index` (0 when it is [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX)).

associated_functions.name: GetFrequencyResult
associated_functions.doc: Reads the timestamp frequency of the disjoint query at `index` (0 when it is [`INVALID_QUERY_INDEX`](Self::INVALID_QUERY_INDEX)).

kind.doc:
The index the issue functions return when the kind's per-buffer capacity is exhausted. The
 end and read functions accept it and do nothing (the reads return 0).

The per-kind query counts of a [`GPUBufferedQuery`] (`CGPUBufferedQuery::SCreateParams`). The
 same shape holds both the capacities and the per-frame usage counters.

The engine's developer GPU profiler (`NGraphicsEngine::CGPUProfiler`, `g_GPUProfiler`): per-scope
 GPU and CPU times, occlusion, and draw-call counts over the render-pass categories. Only the
 construction and the result-count accessor survive; the scope recording and result
 read-back are compiled out. Created by `CGraphicsEngine::InitializeSystem`.

associated_functions.name: GetScopeResultCount
associated_functions.doc: The number of scope results in the last frame's results (80-byte `SScopeData` entries).

associated_functions.name: GetScopeResult
associated_functions.doc: The scope result at `index`. Compiled to return null.

kind.doc: A graphics-backend event (fence) query handle (`Graphics::HEventQuery_t`).
A graphics-backend occlusion query handle (`Graphics::HOcclusionQuery_t`).

A GPU timer for one render pass (`NGraphicsEngine::CRenderPassGpuTimingQuery`): a four-slot ring
 of start/end timestamp and disjoint queries, read back three frames later into a timing
 history. The render engine owns one instance, timing the particle pass.

fields.name: m_TimeStamps
fields.doc: The four ring slots.

fields.name: m_ParticleGPUTimingHistory
fields.doc: The GPU time of recent frames in milliseconds.

associated_functions.name: Create
associated_functions.doc: Allocates the four ring slots and creates their queries.

associated_functions.name: Destroy
associated_functions.doc: Destroys the ring's queries and frees it.

associated_functions.name: BeginGPUTimingQuery
associated_functions.doc:
Advances the ring, reads the oldest slot's timestamps and frequency into the history, then
 records the start timestamp and begins the disjoint query of the new slot.

associated_functions.name: EndGPUTimingQuery
associated_functions.doc: Records the current slot's end timestamp and ends its disjoint query.

associated_functions.name: GetAverageGpuTiming
associated_functions.doc:
A fixed weighted average of the
 [`m_ParticleGPUTimingHistory`](Self::m_ParticleGPUTimingHistory) samples, in milliseconds.

kind.doc: One slot of a [`RenderPassGpuTimingQuery`] ring (`CRenderPassGpuTimingQuery::STimeStampData`).

fields.name: m_Frequency
fields.doc: The last read timestamp frequency (initialised to 100 MHz).

kind.doc:
A scoped graphics debug marker (`Graphics::CScopeMarker`): the constructor opens a named scope on
 the context with [`BeginScopeMarker`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::BeginScopeMarker) and the
 destructor closes it with [`EndScopeMarker`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::EndScopeMarker).

The per-camera beam-frustum-based-culling parameters cached by
 [`GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime`](OccluderCollectionManager::GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime),
 pointed at by its `out_params`.

fields.name: m_FrustumCount
fields.doc:
The number of active cull frustums: the camera frustum plus one per active occluder
 (`occluderCount + 1`), with up to 32 occluder slots (so `1..=33`; `1` = camera frustum only).

kind.doc:
A D3D11 rasterizer viewport (`D3D11_VIEWPORT`): the screen-space output rectangle the rasterizer
 maps NDC into and clips to, plus its depth range.

The opaque parameter block passed to
 [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](GraphicsEngine::HandleDrawThreadTask).

One reflection-proxy depth-history slot in the planar / water reflection state machine
 (`CGraphicsEngine::SEffectInfo`). The graphics engine holds an array of these in
 [`GraphicsEngine::m_EffectInfo`], and the lifecycle byte advances once per scene dispatch.

fields.name: m_DepthTexture
fields.doc: The reflection-proxy depth texture.

fields.name: m_FrameIndex
fields.doc:
The lifecycle counter, one of the `FRAME_INDEX_*` constants on this type. Any other non-free
 value increments once per dispatch.

kind.doc:
The lifecycle value of a slot whose depth was copied this dispatch. The next dispatch
 increments it to [`FRAME_INDEX_READY`](Self::FRAME_INDEX_READY).

The lifecycle value of a free slot. The `CopyEffectTextures` stage of
 [`GraphicsEngine::HandleDrawThreadTask`] copies the reflection-proxy depth into the last free
 slot it finds and marks that slot [`FRAME_INDEX_COPIED`](Self::FRAME_INDEX_COPIED).

The lifecycle value of the picked slot. The scan stores its index in
 [`GraphicsEngine::m_EffectInfoIndex`]; the stage then writes the render camera's
 view-projection into its [`m_Transform`](Self::m_Transform) and resets it to
 [`FRAME_INDEX_FREE`](Self::FRAME_INDEX_FREE).

The lifecycle value of a slot whose copy is one dispatch old. The scan promotes it to
 [`FRAME_INDEX_PICKED`](Self::FRAME_INDEX_PICKED).
The result status of [`QueryTimeStampFrequency`].

variants.name: Ok
variants.doc: The result is available and the interval was continuous.

variants.name: Disjoint
variants.doc:
The result is available but the interval was disjoint; timestamps taken inside it are
 unreliable.

variants.name: Pending
variants.doc: The result is not yet available.

fields.name: m_HasBeenInitialized
fields.doc:
Whether the engine has finished its system initialisation. [`ResizeBuffers`](Self::ResizeBuffers)
 only applies a resize inline once this is set.

fields.name: m_CPUDrawFinished
fields.doc:
Set by the tail of [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask) once the
 frame's CPU draw has completed (just before
 [`m_CPUFinishedDrawingEvent`](Self::m_CPUFinishedDrawingEvent) is signalled).
 [`WaitForCPUDrawToFinish`](Self::WaitForCPUDrawToFinish) returns immediately when
 set and otherwise waits on the event.

fields.name: m_CPUFinishedDrawingEvent
m_DrawFragmentSignal
fields.doc:
When a draw fragment is outstanding, points at its completion signal (a `u32` that the
 fragment sets non-zero); null otherwise.
 [`WaitForCPUDrawToFinish`](Self::WaitForCPUDrawToFinish) drains it first, via the
 work-stealing `cpu_fragment::CpuFragmentWaitUntilSignalIsNonZero`.

fields.name: m_DrawThreadWorkSignal
fields.doc:
Completion signal for the async draw-dispatch CPU fragment that
 [`DispatchDraw`](Self::DispatchDraw) kicks to run the render passes. The fragment sets
 it non-zero on completion; the engine waits on it (via
 `cpu_fragment::CpuFragmentWaitUntilSignalIsNonZero`, gated by `CpuPrimaryCount() > 1`) only at the
 *next* [`Draw`](Self::Draw)'s entry.
 [`WaitForCPUDrawToFinish`](Self::WaitForCPUDrawToFinish) does *not* wait on it.

fields.name: m_FramesUntilScreenshot
fields.doc:
The frames remaining before the pending screenshot is written (`SScreenShotData::m_FramesUntilScreenshot`),
 negative when none is pending. [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask) counts it
 down once per dispatch, at the point matching [`m_ScreenshotMode`](Self::m_ScreenshotMode), and
 calls [`SaveScreen`](Self::SaveScreen) when it goes negative.

fields.name: m_ScreenshotMode
fields.doc:
Whether the pending screenshot is taken before or after the UI is drawn
 (`SScreenShotData::m_Mode`).

fields.name: m_ScreenshotSaveDepth
fields.doc: Whether the pending screenshot also saves the depth buffer (`SScreenShotData::m_SaveDepth`).

fields.name: m_DisplayModeChangeState
fields.doc:
The display-mode state machine serviced once per frame by
 [`HandleModeChange`](Self::HandleModeChange): while idle it applies a deferred
 window resize, and while a mode change is pending it applies the fullscreen/adapter change.

fields.name: m_HasNewValidDisplayMode
fields.doc:
Set at the tail of [`ApplyResize`](Self::ApplyResize) once a resize has been applied
 and a valid display mode is in effect.

fields.name: m_WindowWidth
fields.doc:
The pending deferred-resize width, stashed by [`ResizeBuffers`](Self::ResizeBuffers)
 and consumed by [`HandleModeChange`](Self::HandleModeChange).

fields.name: m_WindowHeight
fields.doc: The pending deferred-resize height.

fields.name: m_SynchronousResize
fields.doc:
When set, [`ResizeBuffers`](Self::ResizeBuffers) applies a resize inline rather than
 deferring it; the fullscreen/adapter path sets it around its device reset.

fields.name: m_HasNewWindowSettings
fields.doc:
Set when a deferred resize is pending in [`m_WindowWidth`](Self::m_WindowWidth)/
 [`m_WindowHeight`](Self::m_WindowHeight), consumed by
 [`HandleModeChange`](Self::HandleModeChange).

fields.name: m_ShadowManager
fields.doc: The cascaded sun-shadow system.

fields.name: m_RenderCamera
fields.doc:
The engine-owned scene render camera: a by-value copy rebuilt each
 [`Draw`](Self::Draw) by `Camera::SetupRenderCamera` (reverse-Z + jitter, then the
 view-projection products from `m_View`). This is the camera the render passes consume;
 distinct from the [`CameraManager`](camera::camera_manager::CameraManager)'s camera objects, which are pointers to the gameplay
 cameras.

fields.name: m_RenderContext
fields.doc:
The engine-owned render context handed to the render passes: the per-view camera matrices,
 the graphics context, and the currently-installed render setup.

fields.name: m_GBufferTexture
fields.doc: Deferred-shading render targets ("GBuffer0".."GBuffer3").

fields.name: m_VelocityBufferTexture
fields.doc: Motion-blur velocity buffer.

fields.name: m_BackBufferRenderSetup
fields.doc:
The final composite render setup: colour → [`m_BackBufferLinear`](Self::m_BackBufferLinear),
 depth → the main depth surface. Built by
 [`CreateRenderSetups`](Self::CreateRenderSetups) against the live swapchain back
 buffer and stored as the render context's setup; the HUD and the scene resolve target it.

fields.name: m_MainDepthTexture
fields.doc: Main scene depth ("MainDepthBuffer").

fields.name: m_MainDepthSurface
fields.doc:
The render-target surface over [`m_MainDepthTexture`](Self::m_MainDepthTexture), built by
 [`CreateRenderSetups`](Self::CreateRenderSetups) with
 [`GetRenderTarget`](graphics_engine::surface::GetRenderTarget). It is the depth target of
 the scene and back-buffer render setups, and the depth-stencil view the UI binds alongside
 [`m_BackBufferLinear`](Self::m_BackBufferLinear).

fields.name: m_MainColorBuffer
fields.doc: Main scene HDR color ("MainColorBuffer").

fields.name: m_DownSampledDepthTexture
fields.doc: Hi-Z / downsampled depth ("DownsampledDepth").

fields.name: m_EffectInfo
fields.doc: Reflection-proxy depth-history (planar / water reflection state machine).

fields.name: m_BackBufferLinear
fields.doc: Final linear back buffer ("BackBufferLinear").

fields.name: m_PostEffectRenderSetup
fields.doc:
The post-effect render setup: colour[0] is the raw device back-buffer surface, with no
 depth. Built by [`CreateRenderSetups`](Self::CreateRenderSetups) alongside
 [`m_BackBufferRenderSetup`](Self::m_BackBufferRenderSetup) and bound by
 [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask) for the world filters and the
 post-effect stack.

fields.name: m_DeviceDisplayWidth
fields.doc:
The device's display width, copied from `Graphics::GetDeviceInfo` by
 [`ApplyResize`](Self::ApplyResize) and [`ApplyMode`](Self::ApplyMode).

fields.name: m_DeviceDisplayHeight
fields.doc:
The device's display height, copied alongside
 [`m_DeviceDisplayWidth`](Self::m_DeviceDisplayWidth).

fields.name: m_TitleSafeWidth
fields.doc:
The title-safe area width, `max(32, 4 * width / 5)`, recomputed by
 [`ApplyResize`](Self::ApplyResize) and [`ApplyMode`](Self::ApplyMode).

fields.name: m_TitleSafeHeight
fields.doc: The title-safe area height, `max(32, 4 * height / 5)`.

fields.name: m_AppliedWidth
fields.doc:
The applied window width, written by [`ApplyResize`](Self::ApplyResize) (the clamped resize
 width) and [`ApplyMode`](Self::ApplyMode) (the new mode's width).

fields.name: m_AppliedHeight
fields.doc: The applied window height, written alongside [`m_AppliedWidth`](Self::m_AppliedWidth).

fields.name: m_UVScale
fields.doc:
The G-buffer UV scale the fullscreen reconstruction vertex shaders apply (`UVScale`, their
 vertex `cb1[5].xy`). `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` copies it into
 [`RenderContext::m_UVScale`](RenderContext::m_UVScale) each pass, and the clustered lighting
 resolve uploads it from there. The writer has not been traced.

fields.name: m_OutputGammaChanged
fields.doc:
Set to request an output-gamma change; [`Draw`](Self::Draw) applies it through
 `Graphics::SetOutputGamma` under the context lock and clears it.

fields.name: m_CPUDrawStallTime
fields.doc:
A QPC timestamp from which [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask) measures
 [`m_CPUDrawStallDuration`](Self::m_CPUDrawStallDuration). Its writer has not been
 traced.

fields.name: m_CPUDrawStallDuration
fields.doc:
Seconds from [`m_CPUDrawStallTime`](Self::m_CPUDrawStallTime) to the end of
 [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask), written at its tail.

fields.name: m_DrawTime
fields.doc:
The dispatch's CPU draw time in seconds, from [`draw_start_time`] to the end of
 [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask), written at its tail
 (`m_DrawTime`).

fields.name: m_OldAniso
fields.doc:
The anisotropy level the render-block types were last created with. [`Draw`](Self::Draw)
 recreates every render-block type when it differs from [`m_Aniso`](Self::m_Aniso), then copies
 it over.

fields.name: m_Aniso
fields.doc: The requested anisotropy level, copied per pass into the render context.

fields.name: m_SoftParticlesEnabled
fields.doc:
Whether soft particles are enabled
 ([`RenderContextFlags::m_UseSoftParticles`](RenderContextFlags::m_UseSoftParticles)).

fields.name: m_PointLightSpecularEnabled
fields.doc:
Whether point-light specular is enabled
 ([`RenderContextFlags::m_UsePointLightSpecular`](RenderContextFlags::m_UsePointLightSpecular)).

fields.name: m_DrawScene
fields.doc:
Whether [`HandleDrawThreadTask`](Self::HandleDrawThreadTask) renders the 3D scene
 this frame (GBuffer, world, post-effects) rather than only the UI. [`Draw`](Self::Draw)
 sets it from the game state and the UI's static-background grab: it is cleared while a
 full-screen UI with a static background is shown (pause / map / menus), in which case the draw
 thread clears the target to transparent instead of rendering the scene.

fields.name: m_FirstFrame
fields.doc:
Set on the first frame (by `CGraphicsEngine::InitializeSystem`) so the [`Draw`](Self::Draw)
 prologue skips its [`Flip`](Self::Flip) once; the prologue clears it after the check
 (`m_FirstFrame`).

fields.name: m_EffectInfoIndex
fields.doc: Index of the reflection-proxy slot picked this frame.

fields.name: m_CurrentBundleName
fields.doc:
The currently-loaded shader bundle name, compared by
 [`LoadShaderBundle`](Self::LoadShaderBundle) to skip a same-name reload. The
 bundle names are `"Shaders"` / `"ShadersLowShadows"` (and the Intel `"ShadersConstMath*"`
 variants).

associated_functions.name: WaitForCPUDrawToFinish
associated_functions.doc:
Blocks until the frame's CPU draw has completed: first drains an outstanding draw
 fragment via [`m_DrawFragmentSignal`](Self::m_DrawFragmentSignal) (a
 work-stealing wait -- see
 `cpu_fragment::CpuFragmentWaitUntilSignalIsNonZero`),
 then waits on [`m_CPUFinishedDrawingEvent`](Self::m_CPUFinishedDrawingEvent)
 unless [`m_CPUDrawFinished`](Self::m_CPUDrawFinished) is already set. Because of
 the work-stealing drain, only threads the fragment system knows may call it.

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
The graphics entry point: runs the per-frame prologue (presents the previous frame, advances
 the clock and constant-buffer pools), then dispatches this frame's draw.

associated_functions.name: Flip
associated_functions.doc: Presents the previous frame's back buffer.

associated_functions.name: DispatchDraw
associated_functions.doc: Queues this frame's render work on the render thread.

associated_functions.name: HandleDrawThreadTask
associated_functions.doc: The render-thread body: GBuffer, lighting, post-effects, and UI.

associated_functions.name: TextureCachePlatformUpdate
associated_functions.doc:
A draw-prologue step. Copies the active camera into the engine-owned render-camera slot, runs
 [`Camera::SetupRenderCamera`] on it, publishes it as the camera manager's render camera, then
 runs the per-frame texture-cache update under the context lock.

associated_functions.name: CreateRenderSetups
associated_functions.doc:
Creates every scene render target and render setup. Each scene target
 (main depth/colour, the four GBuffers, velocity, downsampled depth, the reflection-proxy
 targets, the AO volume, and the `VfxDepthCopy_%d` slots) is sized from
 `device_info`'s [`m_DisplayWidth`](graphics_engine::device::DeviceInfo::m_DisplayWidth)/
 [`m_DisplayHeight`](graphics_engine::device::DeviceInfo::m_DisplayHeight) (some at half
 resolution), so it can be re-run at any size by passing a modified copy. The final
 `BackBufferLinear` alias plus [`m_BackBufferRenderSetup`](Self::m_BackBufferRenderSetup)
 and the post-effect setup are instead built against the live swapchain surface via
 `GetDeviceSurface(BackBuffer)`, independent of
 `device_info`. Per-pass viewports follow the bound target's size. Assumes the previously
 created setups have been torn down
 ([`DestroyRenderSetups`](Self::DestroyRenderSetups)) and that no draw is in flight.

 The return value is undefined. The declared C++ return type is `bool`, but the compiled
 code has no final `return 1`: the last instruction before the
 epilogue is the trailing [`CreateRenderSetup`] call, so `al` carries the low byte of the
 pointer it returned. The result therefore carries no success information.

associated_functions.name: DestroyRenderSetups
associated_functions.doc:
Destroys every scene render target, surface, and render setup created by
 [`CreateRenderSetups`](Self::CreateRenderSetups), including the `BackBufferLinear`
 alias, after first unbinding the active setup. The swapchain back buffer itself is not touched.
 Pass-owned render targets (post-effect, SSAO, SSR, anti-aliasing pools) are not freed here — the
 registered resize callbacks re-allocate those.

associated_functions.name: ApplyResize
associated_functions.doc:
Applies a resize: tears down the render setups, has the UI drop its references, resizes the
 swapchain (the device-level [`ResizeBuffers`](graphics_engine::device::ResizeBuffers)), re-creates the render
 setups at the new size ([`CreateRenderSetups`](Self::CreateRenderSetups)), runs every
 registered resize callback (which re-sizes the pass-owned pools), restores the UI, and updates
 the camera aspect and window params. Called from
 [`HandleModeChange`](Self::HandleModeChange) in the [`Draw`](Self::Draw)
 prologue, so it runs on the main thread with no draw in flight.

associated_functions.name: ResizeBuffers
associated_functions.doc:
The resize request entry. Applies the resize inline via
 [`ApplyResize`](Self::ApplyResize) when
 [`m_SynchronousResize`](Self::m_SynchronousResize) and
 [`m_HasBeenInitialized`](Self::m_HasBeenInitialized) are set; otherwise it stashes the
 dimensions in [`m_WindowWidth`](Self::m_WindowWidth)/
 [`m_WindowHeight`](Self::m_WindowHeight) and defers to the next
 [`HandleModeChange`](Self::HandleModeChange).

associated_functions.name: ApplyMode
associated_functions.doc:
Applies a pending display-mode change (fullscreen, resolution, or adapter): has the UI drop its
 device references, rebuilds the device through `Graphics::ResetDevice` with the new
 parameters, updates the graphics params, the cursor,
 [`m_DeviceDisplayWidth`](Self::m_DeviceDisplayWidth)/[`m_DeviceDisplayHeight`](Self::m_DeviceDisplayHeight),
 [`m_AppliedWidth`](Self::m_AppliedWidth)/[`m_AppliedHeight`](Self::m_AppliedHeight), and the
 title-safe area, re-binds [`m_BackBufferRenderSetup`](Self::m_BackBufferRenderSetup), and
 restores the UI. Returns whether the device reset succeeded.

associated_functions.name: InitializeSystem
associated_functions.doc:
The one-time startup bring-up of the graphics engine (`CGraphicsEngine::InitializeSystem`,
 virtual): creates the device (with a hardcoded `ABGR32` front-buffer format), selects the shader
 bundle (the `"ShadersConstMath"` variants on Intel adapters), creates the render setups, the
 shadow and reflective-shadow managers, and the GPU profiler, and sets
 [`m_FirstFrame`](Self::m_FirstFrame).

associated_functions.name: HandleModeChange
associated_functions.doc:
Services the display-mode state machine once per frame from the [`Draw`](Self::Draw)
 prologue: applies a deferred resize ([`ApplyResize`](Self::ApplyResize)) when one is
 pending, or the fullscreen/adapter change when a mode change is pending, then reconciles the
 flip interval. It runs after the previous frame's draw dispatch has drained and before the
 current frame is dispatched.

associated_functions.name: SaveScreen
associated_functions.doc:
Writes the pending screenshot to disk: saves `surface` to the requested colour filename
 (and, when the request asked for depth, `depth_texture` to the depth filename) through the
 device's texture-to-file writer, marks the screenshot request done, and clears a filename
 whose write failed. Called from the draw thread once the frame the request was made on has
 finished compositing, with the engine's
 [`m_BackBufferLinear`](Self::m_BackBufferLinear) as the surface. IDA labels this
 address `NGraphicsEngine::CGPUProfiler::EndFrame`.

associated_functions.name: LoadShaderBundle
associated_functions.doc:
Loads (or reloads) the named shader bundle and re-creates every shader holder from it, but only
 if `name` differs from [`m_CurrentBundleName`](Self::m_CurrentBundleName).
 Re-creating the holders routes every shader through
 `Graphics::CreateFragmentProgram`. The bundle names are `"Shaders"` / `"ShadersLowShadows"`
 (and the Intel `"ShadersConstMath*"` variants), selected by shadow quality in
 `CSettingsManager::UpdateSettings`. `name` is a NUL-terminated C string.

associated_functions.name: SetCursor
associated_functions.doc:
Sets [`m_ActiveCursor`](Self::m_ActiveCursor) and, when it changed, posts
 `WM_SETCURSOR` to the game window so [`WndProc`] runs
 [`UpdateCursor`](Self::UpdateCursor). `COverlayUI` drives it: `Arrow` when the
 overlay cursor becomes visible, `None` when it hides.

associated_functions.name: UpdateCursor
associated_functions.doc:
Applies [`m_ActiveCursor`](Self::m_ActiveCursor) to the OS: for `None` it sets a
 null `HCURSOR` and clips the cursor to the client rect (when the window is foreground);
 otherwise it unclips and sets `GraphicsParams::m_Cursors[cursor]`. The entries are
 loaded at startup as the system `IDC_ARROW`, `IDC_CROSS`, `IDC_HAND`, and `IDC_NO`
 cursors. Called from [`WndProc`] on `WM_SETCURSOR`.

kind.doc:
A GPU context handle: the engine's wrapper over the D3D11 immediate context, carrying the deferred,
 dirty-tracked pipeline state that [`SetupRenderStates`] flushes to D3D before each draw. Partial:
 only the depth-stencil state index and stencil ref are mapped.

fields.name: m_DepthStencilStateIndex
fields.doc:
The packed depth-stencil state index staged by the granular stencil/depth setters and flushed by
 [`SetupRenderStates`] into a cached `ID3D11DepthStencilState`. Bit layout, low dword: bit0
 `DepthEnable`, bit1 `DepthWriteMask`, bits2-5 `DepthFunc`, bit6 `StencilEnable`, bits7-10
 `StencilFunc`, bits11-18 `StencilReadMask`, bits19-26 `StencilWriteMask`, bits27-30
 `StencilFailOp`; high dword bits0-3 `StencilDepthFailOp`, bits4-7 `StencilPassOp`. The D3D enum
 values are stored verbatim (`D3D11_COMPARISON_*`, `D3D11_STENCIL_OP_*`).

fields.name: m_StencilRef
fields.doc: The stencil reference value bound alongside the depth-stencil state.

kind.doc: A GPU device handle.

A render-target configuration a pass draws into: the output views bound via `OMSetRenderTargets`,
 and optionally a fixed viewport. Applied by [`SetRenderSetup`]. Partial: only the viewport fields
 are mapped; the type extends past them (`min_size` is the 8-aligned bound just past the last field).

fields.name: m_HasCustomViewport
fields.doc:
When set, [`SetRenderSetup`] applies [`m_Viewport`](Self::m_Viewport) as the
 rasterizer viewport; when clear, it synthesizes a viewport covering the full render target.

fields.name: m_Viewport
fields.doc:
The fixed rasterizer viewport applied when
 [`m_HasCustomViewport`](Self::m_HasCustomViewport) is set.

kind.doc: A GPU texture handle.

A GPU timestamp-disjoint query handle (an `ID3D11Query` of `D3D11_QUERY_TIMESTAMP_DISJOINT`):
 brackets an interval and yields the GPU tick frequency plus whether the interval's timestamps
 are reliable.
A GPU timestamp query handle (an `ID3D11Query` of `D3D11_QUERY_TIMESTAMP`).

A vertex-declaration handle: the input layout a render block binds before its draws, passed to the
 render block types' `Setup` and on to `Graphics::SetVertexDeclaration`.

The scene occluder / beam-frustum-based-culling manager. Its cull frustum is built (and cached
 per camera and time) from a camera's `m_View` and `m_ProjectionF`, and every scene-geometry,
 terrain, streaming, and occlusion consumer reads it through
 [`GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime`](Self::GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime).

 The main cull camera is the manager's own copy of the active centre camera, embedded at
 [`CULLING_CAMERA_OFFSET`](Self::CULLING_CAMERA_OFFSET) (the consumer identity every main-view BFBC
 consumer passes; shadow and reflection culls use separate functions). The layout around it is not
 yet mapped, so the offset is carried as a named constant rather than a field.

associated_functions.name: GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime
associated_functions.doc:
Build or fetch the cached BFBC cull-frustum parameters for `camera` at `time`. The frustum is
 derived from `camera.m_View` combined with `camera.m_ProjectionF`.
 `out_params` and `out_state` receive pointers into the manager's per-camera cache slot;
 `*out_params` is the [`BFBCFrustumCullParameters`].

kind.doc:
The main cull camera the manager embeds at [`CULLING_CAMERA_OFFSET`](Self::CULLING_CAMERA_OFFSET):
 a verbatim copy of the active centre camera, used as the identity every main-view BFBC consumer
 (terrain, dynamic/static models, streaming, AO volumes) passes to
 [`GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime`](Self::GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime).

The per-view render context the render passes read: the camera matrices (view, projection, the
 translation-free offset view-projection, and the separate camera world position), shadow data, and
 per-frame flags. Filled each dispatch by [`RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera`].

fields.name: m_View
fields.doc:
The world→view matrix for this dispatch, copied from [`Camera::m_View`] by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera). Row 3 carries the camera
 translation; [`CalculateOffsetViewProjectionMatrix`](graphics_engine::render_pass::CalculateOffsetViewProjectionMatrix) zeroes it before
 multiplying by [`m_ProjectionF`](Self::m_ProjectionF) to produce
 [`m_OffsetViewProjection`](Self::m_OffsetViewProjection). The clustered deferred-lighting
 pass uploads rows 0..2 with a `(0, 0, 0, 1)` fourth row as the light-assignment vertex
 shader's `ViewMatrix`, which transforms light proxy vertices the CPU has already made
 relative to [`m_RenderCameraPosition`](Self::m_RenderCameraPosition) into view space.

fields.name: m_ProjectionF
fields.doc:
The projection matrix for this dispatch, copied from [`Camera::m_ProjectionF`] by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera). The deferred-lighting
 clustered pass reads it to build the geometry proxy transform (cb0) and the froxel tile
 bounds (cb1).

fields.name: m_ViewProjectionF
fields.doc:
The world→clip view-projection for this dispatch, copied verbatim from
 [`Camera::m_ViewProjectionF`] by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera) — the reverse-Z projection
 applied to the translation-bearing view, so it maps absolute world positions to clip space.
 Distinct from [`m_OffsetViewProjection`](Self::m_OffsetViewProjection), which drops the camera
 translation and is what the camera-relative geometry paths bake. The water block types build
 their screen-space reflection/refraction lookup from it.

fields.name: m_OffsetViewProjection
fields.doc:
The translation-free view-projection for this dispatch (the rotation and projection without the
 camera world translation). The tessellation constant buffers bake it directly (e.g.
 [`RenderBlockTypeTerrain::SetupConstantBuffers`](graphics_engine::render_block::RenderBlockTypeTerrain)),
 so it carries the per-view projection.

fields.name: m_CameraPosition
fields.doc:
The camera world position for this dispatch, copied from the camera's transform translation
 by [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera). Camera-relative geometry
 subtracts it per object, and [`RenderPass::DoDraw`] hands it to
 [`SortList`](RenderPass::SortList) as the sort camera position.

fields.name: m_CameraTransform
fields.doc:
The world transform of the camera this dispatch draws with, copied from the camera's
 `m_TransformF` by [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera). Its
 translation row is the same world position as
 [`m_CameraPosition`](Self::m_CameraPosition);
 [`SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderEngine::SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants)
 uploads that row and the forward row to the vertex GlobalConstants.

fields.name: m_RenderCameraPosition
fields.doc:
The world position of the camera manager's render camera — the translation row of
 `CCameraManager::GetRenderCamera()`'s `m_TransformF` — written each pass by
 `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext`. Distinct from
 [`m_CameraPosition`](Self::m_CameraPosition), which follows whichever camera the pass draws
 with (a light camera during the shadow passes); this always holds the main scene camera's
 position. `CLightManager::SetupLightingData` and the clustered deferred-lighting pass
 subtract it from each light's world position to build the camera-relative light proxies.
 `CRenderEngine::SetFog` reads its `y` (height) component.

fields.name: m_FrustumPlanes
fields.doc:
The six world-space frustum planes of the camera this dispatch draws with, copied from the
 camera by [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera).
 [`SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderEngine::SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants)
 uploads them as vertex GlobalConstants rows 38..43.

fields.name: CameraFOV
fields.doc:
The vertical field of view in radians, copied from [`Camera::m_FOV`] by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera).

fields.name: CameraNear
fields.doc:
The near clip plane distance, copied from [`Camera::m_Near`] by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera).

fields.name: CameraFar
fields.doc:
The far clip plane distance, copied from [`Camera::m_Far`] by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera).

fields.name: m_DisplayWidth
fields.doc:
The display width in pixels. The clustered deferred-lighting pass derives the froxel tile
 count from this (width / 64).

fields.name: m_DisplayHeight
fields.doc:
The display height in pixels. The clustered deferred-lighting pass derives the froxel tile
 count from this (height / 64).

fields.name: m_DisplayRatio
fields.doc: The display aspect ratio (`m_DisplayWidth / m_DisplayHeight`).

fields.name: m_Context
fields.doc:
The graphics context this dispatch draws through. The render blocks' draw paths and the
 scope markers ([`BeginScopeMarker`] / [`EndScopeMarker`]) read it off the render context.

fields.name: m_VPGlobals
fields.doc:
The vertex GlobalConstants constant buffer, copied per pass from the render engine by
 `CRenderEngine::UpdateRenderContextGlobals`. Render blocks and full-screen passes bind it as
 vertex constant buffer 0.

fields.name: m_FPGlobals
fields.doc:
The fragment GlobalConstants constant buffer, copied per pass from the render engine by
 `CRenderEngine::UpdateRenderContextGlobals`. Render blocks and full-screen passes bind it as
 fragment constant buffer 0.

fields.name: m_EnvCubeTexture
fields.doc:
The composite environment cube map (static env blended with the dynamic sky cube), the
 ambient specular source the material shaders sample. Written per frame from the render
 engine's composite cube. [`SetupLightingTextures`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupLightingTextures)
 binds it on fragment texture slot 11.

fields.name: m_DynamicReflectionColorTexture
fields.doc:
The dynamic (planar) reflection colour texture. `CNvWaterHighEndRenderBlock::Setup` binds it
 on fragment slot 1 (clearing the slot when the pointer is null).

fields.name: m_DynamicReflectionAlphaTexture
fields.doc:
The dynamic (planar) reflection alpha texture, paired with
 [`m_DynamicReflectionColorTexture`](Self::m_DynamicReflectionColorTexture).
 `CNvWaterHighEndRenderBlock::Setup` binds it on fragment slot 12 (clearing the slot when the
 pointer is null).

fields.name: m_LightFalloffTexture
fields.doc:
The scene colour texture as of this pass, the screen-space refraction source.
 `CNvWaterHighEndRenderBlock::Setup` binds it on fragment slot 3.
 The light falloff texture, copied per frame from the light manager.
 [`SetupLightingTextures`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupLightingTextures)
 binds it on fragment texture slot 12.

fields.name: m_DepthBufferTexture
fields.doc: The scene depth texture. `CNvWaterHighEndRenderBlock::Setup` binds it on fragment slot 0.

fields.name: m_DownsampledDepthBufferTexture
fields.doc:
The half-resolution depth texture, copied per pass from
 [`GraphicsEngine::m_DownSampledDepthTexture`](GraphicsEngine::m_DownSampledDepthTexture).

fields.name: m_SamplerStateLightingLinear
fields.doc:
The linear-filtered lighting sampler, copied per frame from the light manager.
 [`SetupLightingTextures`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupLightingTextures)
 binds it on fragment sampler slot 10.

fields.name: m_SamplerStateLightingCube
fields.doc: The cube-map lighting sampler, bound on fragment sampler slot 11.

fields.name: m_CurrentNightLightReference
fields.doc:
The night-light reference level for the current time of day, interpolated from the
 atmosphere's 24-entry per-hour table and copied in per frame from the light manager's
 frame-info ring.

fields.name: m_Dt
fields.doc: The frame delta time in seconds.

fields.name: m_TimeOfDay
fields.doc: The time of day in hours (0-24), copied per frame from the world time.

fields.name: m_TimeOfDayEmissiveScale
fields.doc:
The emissive intensity scale for the current time of day, set each pass by
 `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` from
 [`LightManager::m_TimeOfDayLightModulator`](graphics_engine::light_manager::LightManager::m_TimeOfDayLightModulator)
 (through `CLightManager::GetTimeOfDayLightModulator`).

fields.name: m_UVScale
fields.doc:
The G-buffer UV scale (`UVScale`), copied each pass by `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` from
 [`GraphicsEngine::m_UVScale`](GraphicsEngine::m_UVScale). The clustered deferred-lighting
 resolve uploads the register starting here as its vertex `cb1[5]`, which the fullscreen
 reconstruction vertex shaders multiply into their G-buffer UV, and
 [`RenderPass::PreDraw`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPass::PreDraw) scales the
 depth-resolve rectangle (the display size) by it.

fields.name: m_LightBuffer
fields.doc:
The clustered-lighting frame constant buffer (`LightingFrameConsts`: the packed point, spot,
 and projection light arrays), copied per frame by `CLightManager::UpdateRenderContext`.
 [`SetupForwardLightingResources`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupForwardLightingResources)
 and the clustered resolve bind it as fragment constant buffer 3.

fields.name: m_LightLookup
fields.doc:
The clustered light-grid lookup texture for this frame. `CLightManager::UpdateRenderContext`
 copies it from the light manager's per-frame ring (indexed by the render context frame
 counter modulo [`RING_SIZE`](RenderFrameCounters::RING_SIZE)), or from a single light-assignment output texture when the
 clustered light-assignment path is active
 ([`m_UseClusteredLightAssignment`](RenderContextFlags::m_UseClusteredLightAssignment)).
 [`SetupLightingTextures`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupLightingTextures)
 binds it on fragment texture slot 31.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentFillRenderSetup
fields.doc:
The render setup the second (fill) phase of the clustered light assignment draws into.
 `CRenderBlockDeferredLighting::DrawClustered` binds it, samples
 [`m_LightAssignmentTexture`](Self::m_LightAssignmentTexture) on fragment slot 0, and draws a
 fullscreen triangle per depth slice. Copied per frame by `CLightManager::UpdateRenderContext`.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentTexture
fields.doc:
The first light-assignment phase's output texture (one texel per 64-pixel tile, arrayed over
 light chunks), read by the fill phase. Copied per frame by
 `CLightManager::UpdateRenderContext`.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentRenderSetup
fields.doc:
The render setup the first clustered light-assignment phase draws into (the light proxy
 spheres and cones rasterized against the tile grid). `CRenderBlockDeferredLighting::DrawClustered`
 binds it and clears every colour target to one before drawing. Copied per frame by
 `CLightManager::UpdateRenderContext`.

fields.name: m_HorizonMap0
fields.doc:
The first of the paired terrain horizon maps (large-scale sky-visibility occlusion), copied by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera) from the shadow manager's
 parity-indexed pair
 ([`ShadowManager::m_HorizonMaps`](graphics_engine::shadow_manager::ShadowManager::m_HorizonMaps)).
 [`SetupLightingTextures`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupLightingTextures)
 binds it on fragment texture slot 44, substituting
 [`ShadowManager::m_HorizonMapFallback`](graphics_engine::shadow_manager::ShadowManager::m_HorizonMapFallback)
 when it is null.

fields.name: m_HorizonMap1
fields.doc:
The second of the paired terrain horizon maps, copied like
 [`m_HorizonMap0`](Self::m_HorizonMap0) and bound on fragment texture slot 45.

fields.name: m_PointLightInfo
fields.doc:
The frame's packed point-light records (72 bytes each), from the light manager's per-frame
 ring slot. The clustered light assignment reads each light's position from them.

fields.name: m_ActivePointLightCount
fields.doc:
The number of point lights active for this render frame, copied by
 `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` from
 `CLightManager::GetActiveRenderPointLightCount`. The clustered deferred-lighting pass uses it
 as the instance count of its sphere-proxy draw, and skips the whole light-assignment phase
 (including its render-target clear) when it and
 [`m_ActiveSpotLightCount`](Self::m_ActiveSpotLightCount) are both zero.

fields.name: m_SpotLightInfo
fields.doc:
The frame's packed spot-light records (96 bytes each), from the light manager's per-frame
 ring slot. The clustered light assignment reads each light's position and cone from them.

fields.name: m_ActiveSpotLightCount
fields.doc:
The number of spot lights active for this render frame, copied by
 `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` from
 `CLightManager::GetActiveRenderSpotLightCount`. The clustered deferred-lighting pass uses it
 as the instance count of its cone-proxy draw.

fields.name: m_GlobalLightVector
fields.doc:
The direction toward the global light (the sun, or the moon at night) for this dispatch.
 The atmospheric-scattering scene composite uploads it directly and derives its sky and fog
 brightness factors from the elevation (`y`) component.

fields.name: m_SunVector
fields.doc:
The sun direction for this dispatch, copied by `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` from the
 render engine's sun vector.

fields.name: m_GlobalLightDiffuse
fields.doc:
The global light's diffuse colour, copied by `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` from
 [`LightManager::m_GlobalLightDiffuse`](graphics_engine::light_manager::LightManager::m_GlobalLightDiffuse).

fields.name: m_UniformShadowUpVector
fields.doc:
The up vector of the shadow-casting light camera, written by
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera) (`(0, 0, 1)` outside the shadow
 passes).

fields.name: m_PrecipitationDensity
fields.doc: The precipitation density, copied per pass from the render engine.

fields.name: m_WindStrength
fields.doc: The wind strength, copied per pass from the render engine.

fields.name: m_WindAnimation
fields.doc: The wind animation phase, copied per pass from the render engine.

fields.name: m_ActiveRenderPass
fields.doc:
The id (`ERenderPass`, see
 [`RenderPassId`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderPassId)) of the pass currently
 drawing through this context, written by `SetupRenderContext` from the pass's index.
 [`RP_NONE`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderPassId::RP_NONE) outside a pass body.

fields.name: m_RenderFrameNo
fields.doc:
The per-real-frame stamp for this dispatch, set from [`render_frame_counters`]'s `m_FrameIndex`
 during render-context setup. Passes that cache per-frame state key on it — the terrain
 tessellation blocks compare it against their per-slot
 [`m_WasCBApplied`](graphics_engine::render_block::RenderBlockTypeTerrain::m_WasCBApplied) stamp
 to decide whether to re-upload the constant buffer.

fields.name: m_RenderFrameIndex
fields.doc:
The render-frame ring slot for this dispatch, `m_RenderFrameNo %`
 [`RING_SIZE`](RenderFrameCounters::RING_SIZE), written by
 `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext`. It selects the current slot of every per-frame ring the
 draw side reads, including the instance-transform slot the render blocks pass to
 [`RBIInfo::GetMatrix`](graphics_engine::render_block::RBIInfo::GetMatrix).

fields.name: m_PreviousRenderFrameIndex
fields.doc:
The previous render frame's ring slot, `(m_RenderFrameNo + RING_SIZE - 1) %`
 [`RING_SIZE`](RenderFrameCounters::RING_SIZE), written alongside
 [`m_RenderFrameIndex`](Self::m_RenderFrameIndex).

fields.name: m_ShadowMatrices
fields.doc:
The per-atlas-slice projective shadow transforms, copied per dispatch from the shadow
 manager's parity storage. The deferred lighting shaders index them dynamically by a light's
 packed slice index (`cb0[63 + 4*slice .. 66 + 4*slice]` in the GlobalConstants) to project a
 light-relative position into its shadow-atlas slice; the sun resolve uses
 [`m_ShadowCascades`](Self::m_ShadowCascades) instead.

fields.name: m_ShadowCascades
fields.doc: The forward-material cascaded sun-shadow transform + cascade box-test parameters.

fields.name: m_ActiveCascadeCount
fields.doc:
The number of active cascades this frame, copied per dispatch from the shadow manager's
 parity storage (a byte store in [`RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera`]).

fields.name: m_RenderStatus
fields.doc:
The pass-family status bits for the current draw. Render blocks branch on the shadow-map
 bits ([`RENDERSTATUS_SHADOWMAP`](RenderStatus::RENDERSTATUS_SHADOWMAP)) to select the
 shadow/depth-only path versus the full material path.

fields.name: m_RenderSetup
fields.doc:
The render setup this context draws into. On the graphics engine's own context this is the
 context's copy of [`GraphicsEngine::m_BackBufferRenderSetup`], written by
 [`CreateRenderSetups`](GraphicsEngine::CreateRenderSetups) immediately after the engine
 field.

fields.name: m_TranslucentRenderSetup
fields.doc: The render setup the translucent pass draws into.

kind.doc:
Per-frame packed state bits carried by a [`RenderContext`] (the packed bools that follow the
 aniso field).

flags.name: m_CameraUnderwater
flags.doc:
The camera is underwater. The depth-of-field composite selects its underwater shader family
 when set.

flags.name: m_UseSoftParticles
flags.doc: Soft particles are enabled, copied from the graphics engine.

flags.name: m_UsePointLightSpecular
flags.doc: Point-light specular is enabled, copied from the graphics engine.

flags.name: m_IsIndoor
flags.doc: The render engine's indoor flag.

flags.name: m_Wireframe
flags.doc: The render engine's wireframe flag.

flags.name: m_UseSecondSun
flags.doc: Set when all four sun backlight and shadow diffuse/specular multipliers exceed `0.001`.

flags.name: m_UseClusteredLightAssignment
flags.doc:
The clustered light-assignment path is active, copied from the light manager by
 `CLightManager::UpdateRenderContext`. `CRenderBlockDeferredLighting::DrawClustered` builds the
 light grid on the GPU only when it is set, and
 [`RenderContext::m_LightLookup`](RenderContext::m_LightLookup) then comes from the assignment
 output rather than the per-frame ring.

kind.doc:
Per-real-frame counters, advanced once in the [`GraphicsEngine::Draw`] prologue. `m_FrameIndex`
 (set from the post-incrementing `m_Counter`) drives the TAA jitter phase and shadow parity;
 `m_RingIndex` is the slot of the constant-buffer ring, which has
 [`RING_SIZE`](Self::RING_SIZE) slots.

The number of slots in the per-frame rings (`m_RingIndex = m_FrameIndex % RING_SIZE`), which
 also sizes the light manager's per-frame light lookups and the render-block transform slots.

When a pending screenshot is taken relative to the UI draw
 (`CGraphicsEngine::EScreenshotMode`).

variants.doc: The screenshot is taken after the UI is drawn.

variants.name: ScreenshotWithoutUI
variants.doc: The screenshot is taken before the UI is drawn.

kind.doc:
The cascaded sun-shadow constants for the forward-material resolve: the cascade transform plus the
 per-cascade box-test parameters, staged into cb0 by [`SetGlobalShaderConstants`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderEngine::SetGlobalShaderConstants).

fields.name: m_Transform
fields.doc:
Maps a camera-relative world position into cascade/texture space (row-major, row-vector; its
 columns are `cb0[45..47]` in the GlobalConstants, the translation `cb0[48]`). The
 forward-material shadow resolve evaluates `(worldPos - cameraPos) * M + translation`, with the
 camera position from `cb0[4]`; `CShadowManager::UpdateCascade` bakes the transform relative to
 the active camera's position.

fields.name: m_ScaleBlend
fields.doc: Per-cascade scale + blend-band (`.w`), one per cascade.

fields.name: m_OffsetRadius
fields.doc: Per-cascade offset + texture-array slice (`.w`), one per cascade.

kind.doc:
The QPC timestamp [`GraphicsEngine::HandleDrawThreadTask`] records on entry; its tail measures
 [`GraphicsEngine::m_DrawTime`] from it.

The previous frame's [`RenderFrameCounters::m_RingIndex`], saved by the [`GraphicsEngine::Draw`]
 prologue before it recomputes the ring index (`CGraphicsEngine::PrevRenderContextFrameIndex`).

`m_Counter %` [`RING_SIZE`](RenderFrameCounters::RING_SIZE) after the [`GraphicsEngine::Draw`]
 prologue increments the counter
 (`CGraphicsEngine::RenderFrameIndex`).

The scene light manager: gathers the frame's visible lights and prepares the per-frame lighting
 render state. Only the fields below are verified.

fields.name: m_GlobalLightDiffuse
fields.doc:
The global light's (sun or moon) diffuse colour, the `Diffuse` of the embedded global light's
 `SLight`. `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` copies it into
 [`RenderContext::m_GlobalLightDiffuse`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_GlobalLightDiffuse).

fields.name: m_GlobalLightDirection
fields.doc:
The direction toward the global light, the `Direction` of the embedded global light's
 `SLight`. `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` copies it into
 [`RenderContext::m_GlobalLightVector`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_GlobalLightVector),
 and `CRenderEngine::SetGlobalShaderConstants` stages it (raw and elevation-clamped) as the
 shaders' sun direction.

fields.name: m_NightLightReferences
fields.doc: The 24-entry per-hour night-light reference table (`SetNightLightReferences`).

fields.name: m_TimeOfDayLightModulator
fields.doc:
The time-of-day light modulator, returned by `GetTimeOfDayLightModulator`.
 `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext` copies it into
 [`RenderContext::m_TimeOfDayEmissiveScale`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_TimeOfDayEmissiveScale).

fields.name: m_EnvLightIntensityScaleFactor
fields.doc: The environment-light intensity scale (`SetEnvLightIntensityScaleFactor`).

fields.name: m_VFXLightIntensityScaleFactor
fields.doc:
The VFX-light intensity scale (`SetVFXLightIntensityScaleFactor` /
 `GetVFXLightIntensityScaleFactor`).

fields.name: m_LightBuffer
fields.doc:
The clustered-lighting frame constant buffer, copied into
 [`RenderContext::m_LightBuffer`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_LightBuffer).

fields.name: m_LightLookup
fields.doc: The per-frame light-grid lookup ring, indexed by the render frame modulo the ring length.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentLookup
fields.doc:
The light-grid lookup the clustered light assignment writes; used instead of
 [`m_LightLookup`](Self::m_LightLookup) while
 [`m_UseClusteredLightAssignment`](Self::m_UseClusteredLightAssignment) is set.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentFillRenderSetup
fields.doc: The fill-phase render setup of the clustered light assignment.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentTexture
fields.doc: The first light-assignment phase's output texture.

fields.name: m_LightAssignmentRenderSetup
fields.doc: The first light-assignment phase's render setup.

fields.doc:
Whether the clustered light-assignment path is active. `UpdateRenderContext` mirrors it into
 [`RenderContextFlags::m_UseClusteredLightAssignment`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContextFlags::m_UseClusteredLightAssignment).

Copies the frame's visible point and spot lights into the parity-buffered update lists and
 configures the volumetric-lighting passes. Reads
 [`enable_low_res_spot_light_volume`] (and whether any volumetric spot lights are present this
 frame) to select the reduced- or full-resolution spot-light-cone render setup, toggle the
 low-res upsampling pass, and set the spot-light-cone block type's low-res flag. `reserved_slots`
 is the count of shadow-atlas slices reserved for other casters; `dt` drives the per-light fade.

kind.doc:
The edge length in pixels of the clustered light grid's screen tiles:
 `CRenderBlockDeferredLighting::DrawClustered` divides the display size by it to get the tile
 counts, and the light-grid lookup shader addresses tiles by shifting `SV_Position` right by
 its base-2 logarithm.

Whether the engine renders volumetric spot-light cones at reduced resolution (the engine's
 `g_EnableLowResSpotLightVolume`). When set — the default — the per-frame light gather routes the
 spot-light-cone render block through a quarter-resolution render setup, enables the low-res
 upsampling pass, and sets the cone block type's low-res flag; when clear, the cones render at full
 resolution into the main render setup. It is also treated as clear for any frame that has no
 visible volumetric spot lights. Read once per frame by
 [`LightManager::CopyLightsToUpdate`](LightManager::CopyLightsToUpdate).

 `ForEachRb` instantiations (`CModelInstance::SAddtoRenderContext`): the target passes and the
 camera the render blocks are tested against. Opaque.

associated_functions.name: DoCulling
associated_functions.doc:
The instance-level broad-phase cull: runs a BFBC frustum and distance process over the model
 collections against the occluder manager's main cull camera (its cached parameters from
 `GetBFBCFrustumParamsForCameraAndTime`), passing each survivor on through
 `CModelCollection::CollectionCallback` and `CModelInstanceManager::BFBCCallback`, and
 accumulating `cull_stat`. Static. IDA labels this address
 `CAOVolumeManager::AddToRenderThread`; it is `CModelCollection::DoCulling`.

 instance info and world transform. Opaque.

associated_functions.name: AddToRender
associated_functions.doc:
Builds the per-pass draw lists for this instance's render blocks. It fills an
 [`AddToRenderContext`] whose test camera is the camera manager's active camera, then
 dispatches to the `ForEachRb` instantiation selected by [`enable_coarse_pre_z_models`] and
 [`use_bounding_box_model_rb_view`]. IDA labels this address

Sets the instance's world transform and recomputes its world bounding box from the model's
 bounding box (a tail call to `UpdateMatrixAndAABB`).

associated_functions.name: ForEachRb_1_1
associated_functions.doc:
`NModelSystem::ForEachRb<1, 1>`: walks `count` render blocks, frustum-tests each block's
 world bounding box against the context camera (`CCamera::IsBoxVisible`), skipping failing
 blocks for every pass, and adds survivors to their passes, routing near, large blocks to
 the coarse pre-Z list (see [`coarse_pre_z_models_distance_threshold`] and
 [`coarse_pre_z_models_area_threshold`]). The instantiation used when both selector globals
 are set, as they are by default. Static.

associated_functions.name: ForEachRb_0_1

`NModelSystem::ForEachRb<0, 1>`: as [`ForEachRb_1_1`](Self::ForEachRb_1_1), selected when
 [`use_bounding_box_model_rb_view`] is clear and [`enable_coarse_pre_z_models`] is set. It still
 frustum-tests each block. Static.

associated_functions.name: ForEachRb_1_0
associated_functions.doc:
`NModelSystem::ForEachRb<1, 0>`: the frustum-testing walk without the coarse pre-Z routing,
 selected when [`enable_coarse_pre_z_models`] is clear. Static.

associated_functions.name: ForEachRb_0_0
associated_functions.doc:

 per-block frustum test nor the coarse pre-Z routing. Static.

fields.name: m_Width
fields.doc: The effect's own working resolution, at a quarter of the scene's.

associated_functions.name: Apply
associated_functions.doc:
Runs the prepass: a near-field circle-of-confusion prologue built entirely out of compute
 dispatches, then the packing draw.

 The prologue works on a quarter-resolution pair of single-channel textures (the effect's own
 [`m_Width`](Self::m_Width)/[`m_Height`](Self::m_Height) divided by four in each dimension),
 and every
 [`Dispatch`](graphics_engine::draw::Dispatch) in it is sized `ceil(width / 4 / 32)` by
 `ceil(height / 4 / 8)` groups of 32x8 threads, covering that whole texture:

 1. `bokehextractneardof` reads the depth texture and the manager's focal parameters and writes
    the near-field coverage into the first of the two textures. It takes no view or projection
    matrix -- only the depth-to-linear terms and the focal tuning -- so its result does not
    depend on the camera's projection shape.
 2. `bokehblurneardof` runs four times, two horizontal-then-vertical rounds ping-ponging the two
    textures, so the blurred coverage ends up back in the first. Compute constant 0's `xy` is the
    integer step direction for the round ((1, 0) or (0, 1)) and is the program's only input
    besides the source texture. The kernel is a fixed 7-tap Gaussian, `-3..+3` texels along the
    step, so two rounds reach 6 texels along each axis. Like the extract, the program addresses
    its source and destination directly by `SV_DispatchThreadID`, with no origin or offset term
    and no bounds clamp -- taps outside the texture read zero.

 The packing draw then downsamples the scene into the effect's own render setup with the blurred
 near-field coverage bound as a texture, colouring it with the time-of-day haze terms. That draw
 is the sole consumer of [`GetViewProjInverse`], which it uploads as vertex constants 1..4; no
 part of the compute prologue reads it.

kind.doc: The alpha-blended fade quad over the scene.
