kind.doc:
The window render block *type* (`NGraphicsEngine::CRenderBlockWindow::CRenderBlockTypeWindow`). IDA
 labels its `Setup` as `CRenderBlockFoliageType::Setup`; the vtable and
 body identify it.

associated_functions.name: SetupConstantBuffers
associated_functions.doc: Binds the per-pass constant buffers (the `IRenderBlockType::SetupConstantBuffers` override).

associated_functions.name: Setup
associated_functions.doc:
The type-level per-pass setup (the `IRenderBlockType::Setup` override): binds the reflection
 textures, the forward lighting resources
 ([`LightManager::SetupForwardLightingResources`](graphics_engine::light_manager::LightManager::SetupForwardLightingResources)),
 and the alpha-blended, depth-tested, depth-write-off state.

kind.doc:
A skinned draw batch within a character render block. The vertex data references palette slots;
 `BatchToSkeletonLookup` maps each slot to its skeleton bone index when the palette is built
 (`SetMatrixPalette`), so the batch's lookup table enumerates exactly the bones its geometry is
 weighted to.

fields.name: Size
fields.doc: The batch's index count (indices, not triangles; `DrawBatches` divides by 3).

fields.name: Offset
fields.doc: The batch's start offset in the block's index buffer.

kind.doc:
The hull-clip variant a [`RenderBlockTerrain`] draws with
 (`NRenderBlockTerrain::ETerrainHullClipType`), returned by
 [`HullClipType`](RenderBlockTerrain::HullClipType). It indexes the type's hull-program table.

variants.name: TERRAIN_HULL_CLIP_DISABLED
variants.doc: No clipping.

variants.name: TERRAIN_HULL_CLIP_BETWEEN_LODS
variants.doc:
The LOD clip: the hull discards a patch whose footprint a finer-LOD tile has fully faded in
 over, read from the global terrain visibility mask.

variants.name: TERRAIN_HULL_CLIP_UNDER_WATER
variants.doc: The water clip: the hull discards patches below the cached water level.

variants.name: TERRAIN_HULL_CLIP_DETAIL
variants.doc: The detail clip.

kind.doc:
Whether the WaveWorks water draws with the tessellated shader permutations
 (`CNvWaterHighEndRenderBlockType::ETessellationOptions`), read from
 [`NvWaterHighEndRenderBlockType::m_TessellationOptions`].

variants.name: E_TESSELLATION_OPTIONS_OFF
variants.doc: The untessellated permutations.

variants.name: E_TESSELLATION_OPTIONS_ON
variants.doc: The tessellated (`_tess`) permutations.

kind.doc:
The tree-impostor render block (`CTreeImpostorRB`): far-distance flat billboard cards that replace
 full tree meshes at range.

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
Issues the impostor cards as a single non-instanced [`DrawIndexed`] over a static quad index
 buffer (`6 * min(card_count, 0x1400)` indices); the vertex shader keys off
 `SV_VertexID` (`card = id >> 2`, `corner = id & 3`), pulling each card's world position, size, and
 atlas data from a texture buffer bound at vertex slot 0. The card orientation (facing) is computed
 in the vertex shader from the render camera carried in the engine's global per-view billboard
 constant buffer (the translation-bearing `m_ViewProjectionF`); the block stages only per-draw
 scalars on `cb1`. The [`RENDERSTATUS_SHADOWMAP`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderStatus::RENDERSTATUS_SHADOWMAP)
 bits of
 [`RenderContext::m_RenderStatus`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_RenderStatus)
 select the depth/shadow vertex- and fragment-program permutations. The vertex shader writes `SV_Position` directly; the index and instance counts are
 CPU-supplied, so no part of this block's submission is GPU-driven.

kind.doc: The tree-impostor render block *type* (`CTreeImpostorRB::CTreeImpostorRBType`).

associated_functions.name: Create
associated_functions.doc:
Creates the type's GPU resources ([`RenderBlockTypeBase::Create`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::Create)): builds the static quad
 index buffer the impostor cards draw from and loads the program permutations.

kind.doc: The water-box render block (`NGraphicsEngine::CWaterBoxRenderBlock`): one bounded water volume.

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
Draws the box volume: the ten-triangle interior hull when the volume-rendering flag is set, and
 then — unless the surface-rendering flag is set — the two-triangle top face with the near or
 far surface permutation chosen by the camera's distance to the box. Both are plain
 [`DrawIndexed`] calls over the type's shared geometry, and both consume the screen-lookup
 matrix [`WaterBoxRenderBlockType::Setup`](WaterBoxRenderBlockType::Setup) staged for the pass.

associated_functions.name: DrawSurface
associated_functions.doc:
Draws the box's tessellated surface grid (162 triangles) in the surface-rendering mode, staging
 the box's own world transform — a scale by the box half-extents plus a camera-relative
 translation — on **vertex slot 2, registers 0..3** first. It stages no view-projection; the
 screen-lookup matrix is whatever
 [`WaterBoxRenderBlockType::Setup`](WaterBoxRenderBlockType::Setup) last left on vertex slot 1.
 [`DrawWaterBoxSurface`](DrawWaterBoxSurface) runs the same body inline over every visible
 registered water box.

 The `waterboxsurface` vertex shader consumes those two stagings as `cb1[0..3]` (the box
 transform) and `cb1[4..7]` (the screen lookup), and takes its clip position from the *global*
 vertex constant buffer instead: it adds the camera world position at `cb0[4]` to the
 camera-relative transformed vertex, recovering an absolute world position, and multiplies that
 by the full, translation-bearing view-projection at `cb0[0..3]` — not the translation-free
 [`RenderContext::m_OffsetViewProjection`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_OffsetViewProjection)
 at `cb0[29..32]` that the camera-relative model families use. It is the only member of the
 water-box family that builds clip that way; the volume permutations drawn by
 [`Draw`](Self::Draw) go through the block type's own staging.

kind.doc:
The water-box render block *type*
 (`NGraphicsEngine::CWaterBoxRenderBlock::CWaterBoxRenderBlockType`): the per-pass setup for the
 `waterbox`, `waterboxbelow`, `waterboxsurface`, and `waterboxclear` permutations that render the
 bounded water volumes (pools, tanks, interiors) placed in the world as `NWater::SWaterBox`.

associated_functions.name: Setup
associated_functions.doc:
Binds the water-box render state, textures, and samplers, stages `cbWaterConsts.WaterConsts` on
 **vertex slot 1, registers 4..7**, and hands the fragment stage the inverse view-projection and
 the water tuning.

 The vertex constant is
 [`RenderContext::m_OffsetViewProjection`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_OffsetViewProjection)
 post-multiplied by the same NDC→texture bias
 [`WaterHighEndRenderBlockType::Setup`](WaterHighEndRenderBlockType::Setup) applies, and it feeds
 the same projective-`TEXCOORD1` screen-lookup idiom in the `waterbox*` shaders.

 The whole body is conditional on the water-box manager's mode flags: it runs only when the
 volume-rendering flag is set or the surface-rendering flag is clear, so in surface-only mode it
 stages nothing and the surface path relies on
 [`SetupSurface`](Self::SetupSurface) instead.

associated_functions.name: SetupSurface
associated_functions.doc:
The alternative setup for the surface-rendering mode: binds the tessellated surface grid's
 vertex declaration, stream, and index buffer, sets the stencil test that keeps the surface
 inside the box, and sizes the vertex constant buffer at slot 2. Stages no view-projection of
 its own.

kind.doc:
The legacy high-end water render block (`NGraphicsEngine::CWaterHighEndRenderBlock`): one water
 patch of the ocean/lake surface grid, drawn with the shader permutations set up by
 [`WaterHighEndRenderBlockType`].

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
Selects the vertex/fragment program permutation from the patch's distance to the camera (a far
 pair beyond 1024 m, otherwise one of three LOD pairs), stages the patch's own position and
 scale on vertex slot 2 register 0, binds the shared water vertex stream, and issues the patch's
 quads through the block's internal `DrawQuads` ([`DrawIndexed`] per admitted quad). The
 screen-space lookup matrix it draws with is the one
 [`WaterHighEndRenderBlockType::Setup`](WaterHighEndRenderBlockType::Setup) staged for the pass;
 nothing here restages it.

kind.doc:
The legacy (non-NVIDIA WaveWorks) high-end water render block *type*
 (`NGraphicsEngine::CWaterHighEndRenderBlock::CWaterHighEndRenderBlockType`): the shared per-pass
 setup for the `waterhighend`, `waterbelow`, and `watershader_lod0/1/2` shader permutations, which
 the engine selects at the lower water-quality settings in place of the WaveWorks path.

associated_functions.name: Setup
associated_functions.doc:
Binds the water render state (alpha blend, depth test and write, back-face cull), the five
 water textures and samplers, the wave-table vertex constants, and the fragment constants for
 the water tuning — then stages the block type's `TypeConstants.ReflectionViewProj` on **vertex
 slot 1, registers 1..4**.

 That matrix is
 [`RenderContext::m_ViewProjectionF`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_ViewProjectionF)
 post-multiplied (row-vector convention, so the bias applies to the projected result) by the
 constant NDC→texture bias
 `{0.5,0,0,0 / 0,0.5,0,0 / 0,0,1,0 / 0.5,0.5,0,1}`. The vertex shaders transform the water
 vertex by it with a multiply-add chain over those four registers and pass the `(u·w, v·w, w)`
 components on as a projective `TEXCOORD1`; the pixel shaders divide by `w` to get the
 screen-space UV they sample `ReflectionMap`, `RefractionMap`, and `DepthMap` with. The NDC→UV
 half-scale is therefore already folded into the CPU-side matrix rather than done in the shader,
 and the UV it produces is normalized over the *viewport* the matrix was built for.

 The fragment stage separately receives the inverse of
 [`RenderContext::m_ViewProjectionF`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_ViewProjectionF)
 at fragment slot 1 registers 3..6 for its own depth reconstruction.

kind.doc: The pointer holding the atmospheric-scattering block type singleton.

The abstract render-block type interface (`NGraphicsEngine::IRenderBlockType`): the per-type
 singleton every render block's `GetType` returns, holding the type's shaders and per-pass setup.
 Mapped by vtable only.

associated_functions.name: SetupLightingTextures
associated_functions.doc:
Binds the per-frame lighting textures and samplers every lit render block type shares
 (`CRenderBlockType::SetupLightingTextures`, static): the lighting samplers on fragment sampler
 slots 10 and 11, the environment cube map on fragment texture slot 11 (cleared when null), the
 light falloff texture on slot 12, [`RenderContext::m_LightLookup`] on slot 31, and the terrain
 horizon maps [`RenderContext::m_HorizonMap0`] and [`RenderContext::m_HorizonMap1`] on slots 44
 and 45 (each replaced by
 [`ShadowManager::m_HorizonMapFallback`](graphics_engine::shadow_manager::ShadowManager::m_HorizonMapFallback)
 when null).

associated_functions.name: SetupForwardLightingResources
associated_functions.doc:
Binds the forward-lighting resources (`CRenderBlockType::SetupForwardLightingResources`,
 static): [`RenderContext::m_LightBuffer`] as fragment constant buffer 3, the first GBuffer
 texture ([`GraphicsEngine::m_GBufferTexture`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::m_GBufferTexture)`[0]`)
 on fragment texture slot 15, then [`SetupLightingTextures`](Self::SetupLightingTextures).

functions.name: Create
functions.doc:
Creates the type's GPU resources (shaders, buffers) against the given
 `SResourceContext`. Each type's `RegisterType` calls this at startup with the render
 engine's own resource context.

functions.name: Destroy
functions.doc: Destroys the type's GPU resources.

functions.name: Recreate
functions.doc:
Recreates the type's GPU resources against the given `SResourceContext`.
 `CRenderEngine::RecreateRenderBlockTypes` calls this on every registered type with the
 render engine's own resource context (the settings-change path). Several types,
 including the terrain setup types, implement it as a no-op; for those, only
 [`Destroy`](Self::Destroy) followed by [`Create`](Self::Create) rebuilds the resources.

functions.name: GetTypeName
functions.doc: Returns the type's display name (e.g. `"VolumetricTerrain"`, `"TerrainPatch"`).

functions.name: GetHash
functions.doc: Returns the type's name hash (the registry sort key).

functions.name: IsEnabled
functions.doc:
Whether render passes draw blocks of this type: `CRenderPass::DoDraw` dispatches this
 per type run (vtable slot [`IsEnabled`](Self::IsEnabled)) and skips every block whose
 type reports disabled. The base implementation is compiled to a
 constant `true`.

functions.name: Enable
functions.doc:
Enables drawing of this type's blocks. The base implementation is
 compiled to a no-op (the enabled flag was optimized out).

functions.name: Disable
functions.doc:
Disables drawing of this type's blocks. The base implementation is
 compiled to a no-op (the enabled flag was optimized out), so a type's
 [`IsEnabled`](Self::IsEnabled) implementation alone decides whether its blocks draw.

fields.name: Create
fields.doc:
Creates the type's GPU resources (shaders, buffers) against the given
 `SResourceContext`. Each type's `RegisterType` calls this at startup with the render
 engine's own resource context.

fields.name: Destroy
fields.doc: Destroys the type's GPU resources.

fields.name: Recreate
fields.doc:
Recreates the type's GPU resources against the given `SResourceContext`.
 `CRenderEngine::RecreateRenderBlockTypes` calls this on every registered type with the
 render engine's own resource context (the settings-change path). Several types,
 including the terrain setup types, implement it as a no-op; for those, only
 [`Destroy`](Self::Destroy) followed by [`Create`](Self::Create) rebuilds the resources.

fields.name: GetTypeName
fields.doc: Returns the type's display name (e.g. `"VolumetricTerrain"`, `"TerrainPatch"`).

fields.name: GetHash
fields.doc: Returns the type's name hash (the registry sort key).

fields.name: IsEnabled
fields.doc:
Whether render passes draw blocks of this type: `CRenderPass::DoDraw` dispatches this
 per type run (vtable slot [`IsEnabled`](Self::IsEnabled)) and skips every block whose
 type reports disabled. The base implementation is compiled to a
 constant `true`.

fields.name: Enable
fields.doc:
Enables drawing of this type's blocks. The base implementation is
 compiled to a no-op (the enabled flag was optimized out).

fields.name: Disable
fields.doc:
Disables drawing of this type's blocks. The base implementation is
 compiled to a no-op (the enabled flag was optimized out), so a type's
 [`IsEnabled`](Self::IsEnabled) implementation alone decides whether its blocks draw.

kind.doc:
One entry in the global render-block-type registry: the type's hash (its `GetHash`) and the
 type object.

The engine's fixed-size table of *every* live [`RenderBlockTypeBase`] instance, distinct from the
 [`RenderBlockTypeRegistry`] below. `IRenderBlockType`'s constructor (also inlined at many
 construction sites) scans this table for the first null slot, stores the instance there,
 and records the slot index in the object; the destructor clears the slot again. Every render-block
 type therefore appears here the moment it is constructed, whether or not it is later handed to
 `CRenderBlockFactory::AddType` — so this table, minus the registry, is the set of types that draw
 but cannot be reached through the registry.

 The slots are raw `IRenderBlockType*` with no hash alongside; a type's name comes from its own
 [`GetTypeName`](RenderBlockTypeBase::GetTypeName). The constructor breaks into the debugger if the
 table is full.

 The table is **not** compacted: the destructor nulls only the slot its own object claimed, so a
 type destroyed out of construction order leaves a hole with occupied slots after it, and the next
 construction refills that hole rather than appending. Occupied slots can therefore sit anywhere
 among the [`CAPACITY`](Self::CAPACITY) slots, with nulls between them. The engine's own reader,
 `CGPUProfiler::DrawDrawCallPanel`, indexes every slot and skips nulls to label its per-type
 draw-call rows.
The first slot of the table.

The number of slots; the constructor's scan bound is the address one past the last slot
 ([`ADDRESS`](Self::ADDRESS) + [`CAPACITY`](Self::CAPACITY) slots).

The global render-block-type registry that `CRenderEngine::AddType` and `RemoveType` maintain
 (the leading fields of the `CRenderBlockFactory` object): a vector of
 [`RenderBlockTypeEntry`], kept sorted by type hash for binary search. The factory itself sits
 behind a pointer in static storage.

fields.name: m_TessFactorScale
fields.doc:
The particle tessellation factor scale, adapted each frame by
 [`BeginParticlePassGpuTimingQuery`](Self::BeginParticlePassGpuTimingQuery): lowered by 0.1 while
 the particle pass's average GPU time exceeds 5 ms, raised by 0.1 below 4 ms, and clamped to at
 most 1.

fields.name: m_ParticlePassGpuIntense
fields.doc:
Set while the particle pass's average GPU time is above the heavy-load threshold, cleared once
 it falls below 5 ms.

fields.name: m_ParticlePassGpuTimingQuery
fields.doc: The GPU timing query bracketing the particle pass.

fields.name: m_RenderPasses
fields.doc:
The per-pass render-block-item lists: one vector of [`RenderPass`] pointers per pass id.
 [`DrawRenderPassRange`](Self::DrawRenderPassRange) and the per-frame list rotation walk
 this.

fields.name: m_TimeOfDay
fields.doc:
The time of day in hours, copied per pass into
 [`RenderContext::m_TimeOfDay`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_TimeOfDay).

fields.name: m_Dt
fields.doc:
The frame delta time in seconds, copied per pass into
 [`RenderContext::m_Dt`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_Dt).

fields.name: m_WindAnimation
fields.doc:
The wind animation phase, copied per pass into
 [`RenderContext::m_WindAnimation`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_WindAnimation).

fields.name: m_AccFrameTime
fields.doc:
The accumulated frame time, copied per pass into the render context and staged as the
 GlobalConstants frame-time term.

fields.name: m_PrecipitationDensity
fields.doc:
The precipitation density, copied per pass into
 [`RenderContext::m_PrecipitationDensity`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_PrecipitationDensity).

fields.name: m_SunVector
fields.doc:
The sun direction, copied per pass into
 [`RenderContext::m_SunVector`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_SunVector).

fields.name: m_WindStrength
fields.doc:
The wind strength, copied per pass into
 [`RenderContext::m_WindStrength`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_WindStrength).

fields.name: m_SunBacklightColor
fields.doc:
The sun backlight colour. [`SetGlobalShaderConstants`](Self::SetGlobalShaderConstants) stages
 it scaled by [`m_SunBacklightDiffuseMultiplier`](Self::m_SunBacklightDiffuseMultiplier) and
 [`m_SunBacklightSpecularMultiplier`](Self::m_SunBacklightSpecularMultiplier) into the fragment
 GlobalConstants.

fields.name: m_SunBacklightDiffuseMultiplier
fields.doc: The diffuse multiplier of [`m_SunBacklightColor`](Self::m_SunBacklightColor).

fields.name: m_SunBacklightSpecularMultiplier
fields.doc: The specular multiplier of [`m_SunBacklightColor`](Self::m_SunBacklightColor).

fields.name: m_SunBacklightHeightClamp
fields.doc:
The minimum sun elevation angle in radians. [`SetGlobalShaderConstants`](Self::SetGlobalShaderConstants)
 rotates the staged sun direction up toward [`vector3_up`](types::math::vector3_up) whenever its elevation is below
 this angle.

fields.name: m_SunShadowColor
fields.doc:
The sun shadow colour, staged scaled by
 [`m_SunShadowDiffuseMultiplier`](Self::m_SunShadowDiffuseMultiplier) and
 [`m_SunShadowSpecularMultiplier`](Self::m_SunShadowSpecularMultiplier).

fields.name: m_SunShadowDiffuseMultiplier
fields.doc: The diffuse multiplier of [`m_SunShadowColor`](Self::m_SunShadowColor).

fields.name: m_SunShadowSpecularMultiplier
fields.doc: The specular multiplier of [`m_SunShadowColor`](Self::m_SunShadowColor).

fields.name: m_BackBufferCopy
fields.doc:
The ring of scene-colour copies (the screen-space refraction source).
 `CRenderEngine::UpdateRenderContextGlobals` hands the current one to
 [`RenderContext::m_BackBufferTexture`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_BackBufferTexture).

fields.name: m_CurrBackBufferCopy
fields.doc:
The current slot of [`m_BackBufferCopy`](Self::m_BackBufferCopy). The
 [`GraphicsEngine::Draw`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::Draw) prologue
 advances it once per frame, wrapping at [`m_BackBufferCopyCount`](Self::m_BackBufferCopyCount).

fields.name: m_BackBufferCopyCount
fields.doc: The number of slots in use in [`m_BackBufferCopy`](Self::m_BackBufferCopy).

fields.name: m_DepthBufferCopy
fields.doc:
The scene depth copy, handed to
 [`RenderContext::m_DepthBufferTexture`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_DepthBufferTexture).

fields.name: m_VPGlobals
fields.doc:
The vertex GlobalConstants constant buffer
 ([`RenderContext::m_VPGlobals`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_VPGlobals)).

fields.name: m_FPGlobals
fields.doc:
The fragment GlobalConstants constant buffer
 ([`RenderContext::m_FPGlobals`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_FPGlobals)).

fields.name: m_ResourceContext
fields.doc:
The render engine's embedded [`ResourceContext`]. `RecreateRenderBlockTypes` passes a
 pointer to this field to every type's [`Recreate`](RenderBlockTypeBase::Recreate), and each
 type's `RegisterType` passes it to [`Create`](RenderBlockTypeBase::Create) at startup.

fields.name: m_IsRenderingReflections
fields.doc:
Set while the planar/environment reflection passes draw; `CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext`
 maps it to
 [`RENDERSTATUS_REFLECTIONS`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderStatus::RENDERSTATUS_REFLECTIONS).

fields.name: m_IsRenderingDynamicShadowMap
fields.doc:
Set while the dynamic shadow passes draw
 ([`RENDERSTATUS_DYNAMIC_SHADOWMAP`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderStatus::RENDERSTATUS_DYNAMIC_SHADOWMAP)).

fields.name: m_IsRenderingStaticShadowMap
fields.doc:
Set while the static shadow passes draw
 ([`RENDERSTATUS_STATIC_SHADOWMAP`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderStatus::RENDERSTATUS_STATIC_SHADOWMAP)).

fields.name: m_IsRenderingReflectiveShadowMap
fields.doc:
Set while the reflective shadow map passes draw
 ([`RENDERSTATUS_RSM`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderStatus::RENDERSTATUS_RSM)).

fields.name: m_VPGlobalConstData
fields.doc:
The CPU staging copy of the global vertex-program constant buffer (the shaders'
 `GlobalConstants` cbuffer at vertex slot 0, one float4 row per element).
 [`SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants`](Self::SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants)
 fills the per-view rows from a [`RenderContext`], the fog and atmosphere setters fill rows
 14--24, and [`SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants`](Self::SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants)
 uploads the whole block to the GPU. Row layout (row = float4 index): 0--3 the full
 (translation-bearing) view-projection, 4 the camera world position, 5 the camera forward
 axis, 9 the camera world position with `w = 1`, 14--24 fog and atmospheric scattering,
 29--32 the translation-free
 [`m_OffsetViewProjection`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_OffsetViewProjection)
 (the matrix camera-relative opaque geometry multiplies by), 33--36 the previous
 view-projection, 37 frame time and dt, 38--43 the frustum planes, 44--47 the previous
 offset view-projection, and 48 the previous camera position.

fields.name: m_FPGlobalConstData
fields.doc:
The CPU staging copy of the global fragment-program constant buffer (the shaders'
 `GlobalConstants` cbuffer at fragment slot 0, one float4 row per element): lighting,
 wetness, shadow, and per-view camera rows filled by
 [`SetGlobalShaderConstants`](Self::SetGlobalShaderConstants), uploaded by
 [`SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants`](Self::SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants). Row 0 `.w`
 is the sea level, and row 8 `.zw` is `(1 / DisplayWidth, 1 / DisplayHeight)` from
 `Graphics::GetDeviceInfo` (the device display size, not the bound render setup's).

associated_functions.name: InitializeSystem
associated_functions.doc:
The one-time startup of the render engine (`CRenderEngine::InitializeSystem`). Among its setup
 of the render passes it registers the Z-and-velocity pass's two depth buckets
 ([`RenderPass::Z_AND_VELOCITY_DEPTH_SQ_NEAR`] and
 [`RenderPass::Z_AND_VELOCITY_DEPTH_SQ_FAR`]).

associated_functions.name: BeginParticlePassGpuTimingQuery
associated_functions.doc:
Begins the particle pass's GPU timing query and adapts
 [`m_TessFactorScale`](Self::m_TessFactorScale) and
 [`m_ParticlePassGpuIntense`](Self::m_ParticlePassGpuIntense) from its average GPU time.

associated_functions.name: SetFog
associated_functions.doc:
Builds the two-layer fog GlobalConstants from the render engine's time-of-day fog colours and
 distance and height ramps, using the render camera height
 ([`RenderContext::m_RenderCameraPosition`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_RenderCameraPosition)`.y`).
 `reflected` substitutes a fixed height of 1024 for the camera height (the reflection passes).
 Called at the tail of [`SetGlobalShaderConstants`](Self::SetGlobalShaderConstants) and
 [`SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants`](Self::SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants).

associated_functions.name: PostDraw
associated_functions.doc: The late render-pass step: finalizes and copies render targets under the context mutex.

associated_functions.name: DrawRenderPassRange
associated_functions.doc:
Draws every render block in the half-open pass-index range `[first, last)`: for each pass it
 walks the [`RenderPass`] list and vtable-dispatches each block.

associated_functions.name: PreDraw
associated_functions.doc:
The pre-pass step: iterates the pre-pass ids from
 [`RP_TERRAINPATCH_CLEAR`](RenderPassId::RP_TERRAINPATCH_CLEAR) through
 [`RP_RAIN_OCCLUDER`](RenderPassId::RP_RAIN_OCCLUDER) (terrain-patch prep, the sky lighting
 LUT, planar and environment reflections, cloud shadows, vegetation, the static and dynamic
 sun-shadow cascade atlas, the reflective-shadow passes, the water-simulation compute, and the
 rain occluder) and vtable-dispatches each [`RenderPass`]'s `Draw`, feeding it the render
 context. Called from `HandleDrawThreadTask` before the GBuffer range. Each pass's
 [`m_Enabled`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPassState::m_Enabled) gates whether it draws.
 The pre-pass cameras are the sun, reflection, and world-space cameras (the pass's own external
 camera), not the render camera. The exception is terrain-patch prep
 ([`RP_TERRAINPATCH_CLEAR`](RenderPassId::RP_TERRAINPATCH_CLEAR) through
 [`RP_TERRAINPATCH_ENUMERATION`](RenderPassId::RP_TERRAINPATCH_ENUMERATION)), which falls
 through to the render camera.

associated_functions.name: DrawGBuffer
associated_functions.doc:
The GBuffer fill: binds two global textures on fragment texture slots 40 and 41 (and a sampler
 on slot 9), then draws the GBuffer pass range (the depth and
 velocity prefix, static and dynamic models, and decals).

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
Lighting, reflections, opaque, environment, water, and transparency: draws the scene pass
 range, then clears the global texture samplers.

associated_functions.name: DrawPosteffects
associated_functions.doc:
The post-effects pass: draws the `RP_POSTEFFECTS` range, whose block is
 [`RenderBlockPostEffects::Draw`].

associated_functions.name: SetGlobalShaderConstants
associated_functions.doc:
Uploads the global per-view constant buffer for the frame: lighting, fog, wetness, and the
 render camera's full (translation-bearing) view-projection and world position. This drives
 screen-space and non-geometry work, not opaque-geometry vertex placement.

associated_functions.name: SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants
associated_functions.doc:
Refreshes the per-view rows of [`m_VPGlobalConstData`](Self::m_VPGlobalConstData)
 from a [`RenderContext`]: the full view-projection (rows 0--3), the camera world position
 and forward axis (rows 4, 5, 9), the offset view-projection (rows 29--32), the previous
 view-projection (rows 33--36), the frustum planes (rows 38--43), the previous offset
 view-projection (rows 44--47), and the previous camera position (row 48), then falls
 through to `SetFog`. Called by [`RenderPass::Draw`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPass::Draw)
 after `SetRenderContextCamera`, so every pass re-derives the global rows from its own
 context before drawing.

associated_functions.name: SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants
associated_functions.doc:
Uploads both global constant-buffer staging blocks
 ([`m_VPGlobalConstData`](Self::m_VPGlobalConstData) and
 [`m_FPGlobalConstData`](Self::m_FPGlobalConstData)) into the context's global
 constant buffers via lock/memcpy/unlock. Called per pass by
 [`RenderPass::Draw`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPass::Draw) and once per dispatch
 from `HandleDrawThreadTask`.

associated_functions.name: SetGlobalVertexProgramConstants
associated_functions.doc:
Writes `count` float4 rows into [`m_VPGlobalConstData`](Self::m_VPGlobalConstData)
 starting at row `index` (bounds-asserted against the array's length). The staging copy
 only; the GPU upload happens in
 [`SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants`](Self::SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants).

associated_functions.name: ApplyJitterTransform
associated_functions.doc:
The per-frame TAA jitter: forwards to [`PostEffectsManager::ApplySubsampleJitter`], which
 post-multiplies a sub-pixel clip-space translation onto `proj` only at the T2X resolve mode.

associated_functions.name: EraseAllDeletedRenderBlocks
associated_functions.doc:
Drains a separate deferred deletion list of render blocks, under its own critical section. Does
 not touch the per-pass draw lists.

associated_functions.name: SortRenderPasses
associated_functions.doc:
The render-thread sort task's body: walks every registered pass across all pass
 categories, builds a sort context from the pass's sort camera (its external camera if set,
 else the render camera), and calls
 [`SortList`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPass::SortList) on each. Because
 `SortList` latches per rotation, passes drawn before the task reaches them are sorted
 lazily by `DoDraw` instead and skipped here.

kind.doc:
The flat, contiguous render-pass id enum. Every pass / first / last index in the render engine is
 one of these. The render engine draws by pass-index range: the GBuffer from `RP_Z_OCCLUDERS` to
 `RP_LAST_GBUFFER`, the scene from `RP_REFLECTIVE_WATER_PLANES` to `RP_LAST_MAIN`, and the
 post-effects at `RP_POSTEFFECTS`. Named [`RenderPassId`] to avoid clashing with the [`RenderPass`]
 type.

 Verified against the pass-name switch ([`GetRenderPassName`]).
 [`RenderPassId::RP_PARTICLE_RIBBON`] is the one id the name switch does not name — it returns
 `"NONE"` for it — but the pass itself is live: the effect system creates it and the ribbon
 instantiator enqueues onto it, so the id is not a hole.

variants.name: RP_ROAD_STENCIL
variants.doc:
The road stencil layer. `CRoadMeshManager` owns it as the second of its two passes and
 enqueues a spline-road block onto it whenever the road's visual type has shader type
 [`ShaderType_Simple`](graphics_engine::model_instance::SplineRoadShaderType::ShaderType_Simple), so
 its draw list is the same `CRenderBlockSplineRoad` geometry as [`RP_ROAD_LAYERS`](Self::RP_ROAD_LAYERS).

variants.name: RP_MODELS_DYNAMIC
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::DynamicModelOpaquePass`.

variants.name: RP_MODELS_DYNAMIC_MASK_DAMAGE_POST_EFFECT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::DamageEffectMaskedDynamicPass`.

variants.name: RP_MODELS_STATIC
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::StaticModelOpaquePass`.

variants.name: RP_MODELS_REFLECTION
variants.doc:
The planar-reflection model pass. `CModelInstanceManager` creates *two* passes with this id —
 `ReflectionPass` (opaque) and `TransparentReflectionPass` — and both render the model geometry
 from the reflection camera into the reflection target rather than into the main scene target.

variants.name: RP_CREATURES
variants.doc:
`CCreatureManager`'s own pass. Its draw list is `CCreatureRenderBlock`, whose `Draw` always
 submits non-indexed from a vertex stream alone.

variants.name: RP_UNDERWATER_FOG_GRADIENT
variants.doc:
The underwater fog gradient. One `CRenderBlockUnderwaterFogGradient` on `CSkyGradient`'s own
 pass, drawing viewport-covering geometry — despite sitting inside the GBuffer index range.

variants.name: RP_ROAD_LAYERS
variants.doc:
The road surface layers. The first of `CRoadMeshManager`'s two passes; every visible road
 enqueues its `CRenderBlockSplineRoad` here, which draws non-indexed.

variants.name: RP_DOWNSAMPLE_DEPTH
variants.doc:
The depth downsample. A single `CRenderBlockDepthDownSample` on `m_DepthDownSamplePass`,
 drawing viewport-covering geometry — despite sitting inside the GBuffer index range.

variants.name: RP_DECALS
variants.doc:
The world decals. `CDecalManager::DecalRenderPass`; its draw list is the four
 `CRenderBlockDecal*` block types, each of which draws non-indexed from a vertex stream alone.

variants.name: RP_SKIDMARKS
variants.doc:
The skidmark layer. `CSkidmarkManager` owns the pass and re-enqueues its live skidmarks each
 frame; the draw list is `CRenderBlockSkidmarks`, which draws non-indexed.

variants.name: RP_FOG_VOLUME_GENERATE
variants.doc:
Fog-volume generation. The first of `CFogManager`'s two `CRenderBlockFogVolume` passes; the
 block draws viewport-covering geometry, not a world-space volume.

variants.name: RP_FOG_VOLUME_UPSAMPLE
variants.doc: Fog-volume upsampling. The second `CRenderBlockFogVolume` pass; likewise viewport-covering.

variants.name: RP_FOG_VOLUME_APPLY
variants.doc:
The fog-volume composite. `CFogManager::m_RenderPassAddFogVolume`, drawing one
 `CRenderBlockAddFogVolume` over the viewport.

variants.name: RP_MODELS_TRANSPARENT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::ModelTransparentPass`.

variants.name: RP_MODELS_GLINT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::ModelGlintPass`.

variants.name: RP_PARTICLE_RIBBON
variants.doc:
The ribbon-effect pass. Created by the effect system alongside its ribbon instantiator pool
 and fed by `CRibbonInstantiator::Update`. Unlike every other id, [`GetRenderPassName`] has no
 case for it and reports `"NONE"`.

variants.name: RP_MODEL_HALO_POST
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::HaloTransparentPass`.

variants.name: RP_WINDOW_DECALS
RP_MODELS_REFRACT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::ModelRefractPass`.

variants.name: RP_Z_FINAL_TRANSPARENT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::FinalZTransparentPass`.

variants.name: RP_CLEAR_STENCIL
variants.doc:
`CModelInstanceManager::ClearStencilPass`: a model-geometry pass whose render setup also
 carries the stencil clear.

variants.name: RP_GHOST_EFFECT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::GhostEffectPass`.

variants.name: RP_OUTLINE_MASK
variants.doc:
`CModelInstanceManager::OutlineMaskPass`: the model geometry that writes the outline mask,
 as opposed to the viewport-covering [`RP_OUTLINE_EFFECT`](Self::RP_OUTLINE_EFFECT) family
 that reads it.

variants.name: RP_FINAL_TRANSPARENT
variants.doc: `CModelInstanceManager::FinalTransparentPass`.

kind.doc:
The resource-creation context (`NGraphicsEngine::SResourceContext`) handed to render-block
 types' `Create`/`Destroy`/`Recreate`: the graphics device plus the texture and shader caches.
 The render engine embeds one ([`RenderEngine::m_ResourceContext`]) that every type registration
 and recreation path uses.

fields.name: m_MaxAniso
fields.doc: The `Graphics::EMaxAniso` anisotropic-filtering level.

kind.doc:
The terrain patch render system's per-frame state (partial: only the fields walked to
 `m_TerrainCamera` are mapped). Owned by `CLandscapeManager`; updated by
 [`TerrainPatchSystemUpdate`].

fields.name: m_UpdateCamera
fields.doc:
Whether [`TerrainPatchSystemUpdate`] refreshes
 [`m_TerrainCamera`](Self::m_TerrainCamera) from the LOD camera this frame; when
 clear, the previous frame's copy is kept.

fields.name: m_TessellationDistance
fields.doc: The camera-space distance at which terrain patches subdivide (tessellation LOD).

fields.name: m_TerrainCamera
fields.doc:
A copy of the LOD camera ([`m_ActiveCamera`](camera::camera_manager::CameraManager::m_ActiveCamera)) taken when
 [`m_UpdateCamera`](Self::m_UpdateCamera) is set. The terrain render passes point
 their frustum camera at this and cull patches against its
 [`m_FrustumPlane`](camera::camera::Camera::m_FrustumPlane).

kind.doc:
The opaque shader cache (`SShaderCache`), the name-hash-keyed store the `ShaderCacheGet*Program`
 family resolves shader holders from.

The immediate operands inside the terrain setup types' `Create` functions that size the GPU
 detail-tessellation budget buffers (see `CRenderBlockTerrainDetailSetup::Create` and
 `CRenderBlockTerrainSetup::Create`). The detail-quad
 pipeline allocates from these buffers with unbounded GPU cursors, so their sizes are the hard
 budget of the detail tessellation skin; each constant is the address of a 32-bit element-count
 immediate, paired with the shipped value in [`TerrainDetailBudgetValues`].

"Detail debug tessellation vertex buffer": the address of its element-count immediate
 (shipped value in [`TerrainDetailBudgetValues::DEBUG_VERTEX_COUNT`]).

"Detail tessellation index texture buffer" (the raw index buffer): the address of its
 size immediate (shipped value in [`TerrainDetailBudgetValues::INDEX_BYTES`]).

"Detail tessellation index texture buffer" (the 4-byte-typed view on the setup type):
 the address of its element-count immediate
 (shipped value in [`TerrainDetailBudgetValues::INDEX_VIEW_COUNT`]).

"Detail tessellation texel buffer": the address of its element-count immediate
 (shipped value in [`TerrainDetailBudgetValues::TEXEL_COUNT`]).

"Detail tessellation vertex buffer": the address of its element-count immediate
 (shipped value in [`TerrainDetailBudgetValues::VERTEX_COUNT`]).

The shipped sizes of the terrain detail-tessellation budget buffers, as the immediate operands
 at the [`TerrainDetailBudgetPatchSites`] addresses encode them.
The detail debug tessellation vertex buffer: this many elements of 80 bytes.
The detail tessellation index texture buffer (the raw index buffer): this many bytes.

The detail tessellation index texture buffer (the 4-byte-typed view on the setup type):
 this many elements.
The detail tessellation texel buffer: this many elements of 16 bytes.
The detail tessellation vertex buffer: this many elements of 16 bytes.
The opaque texture cache (`STextureCache`).
The per-frame constant-buffer ring.

associated_functions.name: HandBackBuffers
associated_functions.doc: Recycles last frame's constant buffers from the in-use stack back to the free pool.

kind.doc:
The low-resolution particle render pass: draws the particle render blocks routed to it (see
 `m_LowResRendering` on the particle block type) into a reduced-resolution target that the low-res
 upsampling pass later composites back up.

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
Binds the reduced-resolution render setup, runs the base [`RenderPass::DoDraw`] over the routed
 particle blocks, and restores the previously bound render setup.

kind.doc:
The per-item info accompanying a render block on a draw list (transform, sort key, and the like).
 Opaque; handled only behind pointers.

One of a render pass's double-buffered render-block-item lists.

 [`Add`](Self::Add) appends entries; on overflow (`m_NumElements >= m_ListSize`) it spills into
 the global overflow list. [`DoDraw`](RenderPass::DoDraw) reads `min(m_ListSize, m_NumElements)`
 entries and never writes `m_NumElements`, so a populated list can be redrawn any number of times.

fields.name: m_List
fields.doc: The array of entries.

fields.name: m_ListSize
fields.doc: The capacity.

fields.name: m_NumElements
fields.doc: The live element count (volatile).

associated_functions.name: Add
associated_functions.doc: Appends one render-block-item, spilling to the global overflow list on capacity overflow.

kind.doc:
One render block enqueued onto a draw list (`NGraphicsEngine::IRenderBlock`). Mapped by vtable
 only; instances are handled behind pointers.

functions.name: GetType
functions.doc:
Returns the block's [`RenderBlockTypeBase`]. [`RenderPass::DoDraw`] calls this per
 entry to detect type runs and drive the type-level setup/restore.

functions.name: GetSortID
functions.doc:
Returns the block's 64-bit sort identifier (typically derived from its shaders and
 material so equal-state blocks batch together). The sort-ID computation passes store
 the result in [`RenderInstance::m_SortID`].

functions.name: GetSqDistanceToCamera
functions.doc:
Returns the squared distance from the instance's world translation
 (`info.m_Transform[sc.m_RenderFrameIndex]`) to [`SortContext::m_CameraPosition`]. The
 depth-aware sort-ID computations store the result (or its depth-bucket index) in
 [`RenderInstance::m_Depth`].

functions.name: Setup
functions.doc:
Per-block state setup for the colour path, called by [`RenderPass::DoDraw`] when the
 block pointer changes within a type run.

functions.name: SetupZ
functions.doc: Per-block state setup for the depth-only path (the Z passes).

functions.name: Draw
functions.doc: Issues the block's draw calls for the colour path.

functions.name: DrawZ
functions.doc: Issues the block's draw calls for the depth-only path (the Z passes).

functions.name: GetBoundingBox
functions.doc: Writes the block's local-space bounding box; returns whether one is available.

fields.name: GetType
fields.doc:
Returns the block's [`RenderBlockTypeBase`]. [`RenderPass::DoDraw`] calls this per
 entry to detect type runs and drive the type-level setup/restore.

fields.doc:

 material so equal-state blocks batch together). The sort-ID computation passes store
 the result in [`RenderInstance::m_SortID`].

fields.name: GetSqDistanceToCamera
fields.doc:
Returns the squared distance from the instance's world translation
 (`info.m_Transform[sc.m_RenderFrameIndex]`) to [`SortContext::m_CameraPosition`]. The
 depth-aware sort-ID computations store the result (or its depth-bucket index) in
 [`RenderInstance::m_Depth`].

fields.name: Setup
fields.doc:
Per-block state setup for the colour path, called by [`RenderPass::DoDraw`] when the
 block pointer changes within a type run.

fields.name: SetupZ
fields.doc: Per-block state setup for the depth-only path (the Z passes).

fields.name: Draw
fields.doc: Issues the block's draw calls for the colour path.

fields.name: DrawZ
fields.doc: Issues the block's draw calls for the depth-only path (the Z passes).

fields.name: GetBoundingBox
fields.doc: Writes the block's local-space bounding box; returns whether one is available.

kind.doc:
One draw-list entry (`NGraphicsEngine::SRenderInstance`): a render block plus its per-instance
 info and the sort keys the per-frame sort orders it by.

fields.name: m_SortID
fields.doc:
The block's sort identifier, written per frame by the sort-ID computation in
 [`RenderPass::SortList`] from [`GetSortID`](RenderBlock::GetSortID). The final ordering key
 after depth and type.

fields.name: m_RenderBlock
fields.doc: The render block.

fields.name: m_Info
fields.doc: The per-instance info handed to the block's draw call.

fields.name: m_RenderBlockType
fields.doc: The block's type index, the second ordering key. Written by [`RBILists::Add`].

fields.name: m_Depth
fields.doc:
The primary ordering key, written per frame by the sort-ID computation in
 [`RenderPass::SortList`]: zero for non-depth sorts, the raw squared camera distance for
 `FrontToBack`/`BackToFront`, or the depth-bucket index (see
 [`RenderPass::m_DepthSqTable`]) for `FrontToBackBucketed`.

kind.doc:
The base render pass (`NGraphicsEngine::CRenderPass`). Specialized passes derive from it and
 extend past the base extent.

fields.name: m_CurrentAddList
fields.doc:
The list that new render-block-items append to this frame. Each rotation,
 [`SaveRenderFrameData`](Self::SaveRenderFrameData) re-points it at the new parity's list
 and zeroes its count; zeroing that count is how a pass's draw-time additions are reset.

fields.name: m_CurrentDrawList
fields.doc:
The list [`DoDraw`](Self::DoDraw) draws this frame: the other parity's list, populated
 by last rotation's adds. Re-pointed alongside
 [`m_CurrentAddList`](Self::m_CurrentAddList) by
 [`SaveRenderFrameData`](Self::SaveRenderFrameData).

fields.name: m_RenderBackToFront
fields.doc:
Whether the pass renders back-to-front (the alpha-blend render setting). The `Auto` sort
 method resolves to `BackToFront` when set, `FrontToBackBucketed` otherwise.

fields.name: m_StencilOpZFail
fields.doc:
The pass's stencil depth-fail operation (an entry of the pass's shipped `RenderSettings`, a
 `Graphics::EStencilOp`). [`PreDraw`](Self::PreDraw) applies the pass's stencil state
 ([`SetStencilOp`](graphics_engine::draw::SetStencilOp) and siblings) when
 [`m_StencilTestEnable`](Self::m_StencilTestEnable) is enabled, and copies these settings into
 the render context's stencil settings either way.

fields.name: m_StencilOpZPass
fields.doc: The stencil depth-pass operation (a `RenderSettings` entry).

fields.name: m_StencilOpSFail
fields.doc: The stencil fail operation (a `RenderSettings` entry).

fields.name: m_StencilFunc
fields.doc: The stencil comparison function (a `RenderSettings` entry, a `Graphics::EStencilFunc`).

fields.name: m_StencilMask
fields.doc: The stencil read mask (a `RenderSettings` entry).

fields.name: m_StencilWriteMask
fields.doc: The stencil write mask (a `RenderSettings` entry).

fields.name: m_StencilRef
fields.doc: The stencil reference value (a `RenderSettings` entry).

fields.name: m_StencilTestEnable
fields.doc:
Whether the pass stencil-tests (a `RenderSettings` entry). The per-pass settings
 are shipped data; the engine also clears it in code for a few passes (the depth downsample
 and the outline blur).

fields.name: m_StateFlags
m_SortStateFlags
fields.doc: List/sort state flags; carries the [`m_Sorted`](RenderPassSortState::m_Sorted) latch.

fields.name: m_Index
fields.doc: The pass's [`RenderPassId`], stored narrow.

fields.name: m_SortLock
fields.doc:
The spinlock serializing [`SortList`](Self::SortList) against concurrent callers
 (the render-engine sort task and the lazy sort in [`DoDraw`](Self::DoDraw)).

fields.name: m_SortMethod
fields.doc:
How [`SortList`](Self::SortList) orders the draw list. Most passes leave the
 constructor default (`Auto`); passes that opt out set `None`.

fields.name: m_NumDepthBuckets
fields.doc:
The number of live entries in [`m_DepthSqTable`](Self::m_DepthSqTable). The
 constructor initializes a single zero bucket; with one bucket the bucketed sort computes no
 depth keys.

fields.name: m_DepthSqTable
fields.doc:
The depth-bucket boundary table for `FrontToBackBucketed` sorting: ascending *squared*
 minimum distances, one per bucket. An instance's bucket is the first entry its
 squared camera distance is below. Boundaries are registered at pass creation by squaring
 the boundary distance, appending it, and re-sorting the live prefix (the engine's
 `AddDepthBucket`, inlined into `CRenderEngine::InitializeSystem`); the
 only stock user is the Z-and-velocity pass, with boundaries
 [`Z_AND_VELOCITY_DEPTH_SQ_NEAR`](Self::Z_AND_VELOCITY_DEPTH_SQ_NEAR) and
 [`Z_AND_VELOCITY_DEPTH_SQ_FAR`](Self::Z_AND_VELOCITY_DEPTH_SQ_FAR).

associated_functions.name: SetupRenderFrameData
associated_functions.doc:
Appends `count` render-block-items (`items`) to the active draw / add lists (`a3` holds the
 lists). Static. Called per batch, including from CPU fragment worker threads, not once per
 frame.

associated_functions.name: SetupRenderContext
associated_functions.doc:
Stamps the per-pass render-context state (`CRenderPass::SetupRenderContext`, static): the
 [`RenderStatus`] shadow and reflection bits from the render engine's `m_IsRendering*` flags, the
 render camera's world position
 ([`m_RenderCameraPosition`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_RenderCameraPosition)),
 the frame counter and its ring slots
 ([`m_RenderFrameNo`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_RenderFrameNo),
 [`m_RenderFrameIndex`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_RenderFrameIndex),
 [`m_PreviousRenderFrameIndex`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_PreviousRenderFrameIndex)),
 the active light counts, global light and sun vectors, the display size, the time of day and
 its light modulator, the underwater flag, the weather scalars, and the active pass id
 (`pass` may be null, giving `RP_NONE`). It finishes with
 `CRenderEngine::UpdateRenderContextGlobals`, which copies the global constant buffers,
 scene copies, reflection textures, and the light manager's per-frame resources.

associated_functions.name: SetRenderContextCamera
associated_functions.doc:
Fills the per-view render context from `camera` (the render camera, or a shadow or reflective
 light camera selected by the pass flags): the view, projection, and translation-free offset
 view-projection via [`CalculateOffsetViewProjectionMatrix`], the separate camera world
 position, and the parity-buffered shadow matrices. Static.

associated_functions.name: SaveRenderFrameData
associated_functions.doc:
The per-pass half of the list rotation, driven by the per-frame `CKeep1000Frames` call in the
 `CGraphicsEngine::Draw` prologue: points `m_CurrentAddList` at the new parity's list, the draw
 list at the other, and zeroes the new add-list's element count. Also snapshots the pass camera.
 It is an entry of the pass vtable.

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc:
The virtual per-pass draw entry (the first entry of the pass vtable): when the pass has work, it runs
 `SetupRenderContext`, selects the pass camera (the pass's external camera if set, else the
 render camera) into the context via
 [`SetRenderContextCamera`](Self::SetRenderContextCamera), refreshes and uploads the
 global constant buffers
 ([`SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderEngine::SetGlobalShaderProgramCameraConstants)
 then
 [`SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderEngine::SetAllGlobalShaderProgramConstants),
 under the `"SetGlobals"` marker), binds the pass's render setup and the global textures,
 and vtable-dispatches the pass body ([`PreDraw`](Self::PreDraw) and
 [`DoDraw`](Self::DoDraw)).

associated_functions.name: PreDraw
associated_functions.doc:
The per-pass pre-draw (a pass vtable entry): resolves the back buffer and depth buffer when the pass
 asks for them, binds the pass's render setup, applies its stencil state (see
 [`m_StencilTestEnable`](Self::m_StencilTestEnable)) and depth bias, and issues the pass's
 colour, depth, and stencil clears ([`ClearFlags`](graphics_engine::draw::ClearFlags)).

associated_functions.name: DoDraw
associated_functions.doc:
Draws the current draw list, walking `min(m_ListSize, m_NumElements)` blocks and
 vtable-dispatching each. Non-destructive -- never writes `m_NumElements`. Calls
 [`SortList`](Self::SortList) lazily before drawing. Consecutive blocks of one type
 form a type run: [`ChangeRenderBlockType`](Self::ChangeRenderBlockType) switches
 between runs, and the tail closes the final run (its type-level restore and its scope
 marker). It follows `Draw` and `PreDraw` in the pass vtable.

associated_functions.name: ChangeRenderBlockType
associated_functions.doc:
Switches the active render-block type between type runs in [`DoDraw`](Self::DoDraw):
 restores `prev` (dispatching the Z, colour, or glint restore variant selected by the pass
 id) and closes its scope marker (`Graphics::EndScopeMarker`), then re-applies the
 pass render states, sets up `next`, and opens a scope marker (`Graphics::BeginScopeMarker`)
 named by its
 [`GetTypeName`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::GetTypeName). Either
 pointer may be null at a run boundary. `inout_count` is the pass's running drawn-block
 counter, zeroed on a type switch.

associated_functions.name: SortList
associated_functions.doc:
Sorts the current draw list by ([`m_Depth`](RenderInstance::m_Depth),
 [`m_RenderBlockType`](RenderInstance::m_RenderBlockType),
 [`m_SortID`](RenderInstance::m_SortID)) according to
 [`m_SortMethod`](Self::m_SortMethod), first recomputing each entry's depth and
 sort-ID keys through the block vtable
 ([`GetSortID`](RenderBlock::GetSortID) / [`GetSqDistanceToCamera`](RenderBlock::GetSqDistanceToCamera)).
 Latches [`m_Sorted`](RenderPassSortState::m_Sorted) under [`m_SortLock`](Self::m_SortLock),
 so the sort runs at most once per list rotation; both the render-engine sort task
 (`CRenderEngine::SortRenderPasses`) and the lazy call in [`DoDraw`](Self::DoDraw)
 funnel here.

kind.doc:
The second squared depth-bucket boundary (in square metres) registered on the Z-and-velocity
 pass.

The first squared depth-bucket boundary (in square metres) `CRenderEngine::InitializeSystem`
 registers on the Z-and-velocity pass in [`m_DepthSqTable`](Self::m_DepthSqTable).
How a render pass orders its draw list (`NGraphicsEngine::ERenderPassSortMethod`).

variants.name: RenderPassSortMethod_Auto
variants.doc:
Resolves at sort time to `FrontToBackBucketed`, or `BackToFront` if the pass renders
 back-to-front (its alpha-blend render setting).

variants.name: RenderPassSortMethod_SortID
variants.doc: Order by type then sort ID only (no depth key).

variants.name: RenderPassSortMethod_BackToFront
variants.doc: Order by descending raw squared camera distance, then type, then sort ID.

variants.name: RenderPassSortMethod_FrontToBack
variants.doc: Order by ascending raw squared camera distance, then type, then sort ID.

variants.name: RenderPassSortMethod_FrontToBackBucketed
variants.doc:
Order by ascending depth-bucket index (quantized through
 [`RenderPass::m_DepthSqTable`]), then type, then sort ID — near-first while preserving
 type batching within each bucket. With a single bucket (the default) this degenerates to
 the `SortID` ordering with a zero depth key.

kind.doc:
Pass list/sort state flags. Only the sorted latch is identified; the remaining bits are
 unmapped.

flags.name: m_Sorted
flags.doc:
Set by [`SortList`](RenderPass::SortList) once the current draw list is sorted; cleared by
 [`SaveRenderFrameData`](RenderPass::SaveRenderFrameData) at the per-frame list rotation.
 While set, further `SortList` calls return without re-sorting, so a draw list is sorted at
 most once per rotation no matter how many times it is drawn.

kind.doc: Render-pass state flags. Only the draw gate is identified; the remaining bits are unmapped.

The render-status bits of [`RenderContext::m_RenderStatus`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_RenderStatus)
 (`RenderContext::ERenderStatus`), which tell render blocks what kind of pass is drawing so they
 can select depth, shadow, or reflection shader permutations. [`SetupRenderContext`](RenderPass::SetupRenderContext) clears and sets
 [`RENDERSTATUS_STATIC_SHADOWMAP`](Self::RENDERSTATUS_STATIC_SHADOWMAP),
 [`RENDERSTATUS_DYNAMIC_SHADOWMAP`](Self::RENDERSTATUS_DYNAMIC_SHADOWMAP),
 [`RENDERSTATUS_REFLECTIONS`](Self::RENDERSTATUS_REFLECTIONS), and
 [`RENDERSTATUS_RSM`](Self::RENDERSTATUS_RSM) with the values given here, and also clears
 [`RENDERSTATUS_MIRROR`](Self::RENDERSTATUS_MIRROR). The other values are unconfirmed.

flags.name: RENDERSTATUS_RSM
flags.doc: Set while the reflective shadow map passes draw.

flags.name: RENDERSTATUS_SHADOWMAP
flags.doc: Either shadow-map bit: the mask render blocks test to select their depth/shadow programs.

kind.doc:
The camera context a render pass sorts against (`NGraphicsEngine::IRenderBlock::SSortContext`).
 [`RenderPass::SortList`] receives it from either of its two callers:
 `CRenderEngine::SortRenderPasses` builds it from the pass's sort camera (its external camera if
 set, else the render camera), and [`RenderPass::DoDraw`]'s lazy call builds it from the render
 context's camera fields.

fields.name: m_RenderPassIndex
fields.doc: The [`RenderPassId`] of the pass being sorted.

fields.name: m_RenderFrameIndex
fields.doc:
The `%3` render-frame ring index selecting which of the info's buffered world transforms
 the distance query reads.

fields.name: m_CameraPosition
fields.doc: The sort camera's world position.

fields.name: m_CameraNear
fields.doc: The sort camera's near-plane distance.

kind.doc:
One shadow frustum's bookkeeping in [`ShadowManager`] (`SShadowFrustum`): the render passes that
 draw its atlas slice, followed by the per-parity pass settings and fit state.

fields.name: m_Passes
fields.doc:
The pair of render passes that draw this cascade's atlas slice (dynamic and static
 geometry). [`ShadowManager::CommitRenderPassSettings`] gates them per dispatch via
 [`RenderPassState::m_Enabled`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPassState::m_Enabled).

fields.name: m_RenderPassSettings
fields.doc:
The pass settings for each frame parity (`[m_FrameIndex & 1]`), the per-parity slice
 indices [`ShadowManager::CommitRenderPassSettings`] reads to re-point the passes' render
 setups.

kind.doc:
The cascaded sun-shadow system. Each sim frame, [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender)
 fits the scheduled cascades to the active camera and writes the parity-buffered fit data; each
 dispatch, [`CommitRenderPassSettings`](Self::CommitRenderPassSettings) enables the
 scheduled atlas passes. Cascade re-renders are amortised across frames by an update pattern, so
 an unscheduled cascade keeps its previous fit and contents.

fields.name: m_Enabled
fields.doc:
The settings-side enable flag. The per-frame [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender)
 syncs the engine to it via [`SetEnabled`](Self::SetEnabled) whenever it differs
 from the live state -- the graphics-menu path for toggling shadows.

fields.name: m_ActiveCascades
fields.doc:
The number of active sun cascades for each frame parity. [`RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera`]
 copies the parity's entry into
 [`RenderContext::m_ActiveCascadeCount`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_ActiveCascadeCount).

fields.name: m_ActiveShadowPassCount
fields.doc: The number of active shadow passes (cascades plus spot shadows) for each frame parity.

fields.name: m_AtlasTexture
fields.doc:
The sun-shadow cascade atlas: a single depth `Texture2DArray` whose slices hold every cascade's
 (and the spot shadows') fitted shadow map. Created by [`SetEnabled`](Self::SetEnabled)
 (`CreateShadowDepthTexture`, one render target per array slice). Which slice each pass draws
 into is chosen per frame parity by the frustum's
 [`m_RenderPassSettings`](CascadeData::m_RenderPassSettings).

fields.name: m_DepthRenderSetup
fields.doc:
One render setup per atlas slice. [`CommitRenderPassSettings`](Self::CommitRenderPassSettings)
 points each enabled pass at the setup of the slice its
 [`ShadowRenderPassSettings`] names.

fields.name: m_Cascades
fields.doc: The per-cascade slots (passes plus fit bookkeeping).

fields.name: m_CascadeUpdateLevels
fields.doc:
The per-cascade shadow-map update level, indexed by cascade. A cascade re-fits and re-renders
 only every `2^level` frames (level 0 = every frame); between refreshes its fit is copied
 forward from the previous update. `CalculateUpdatePattern` assigns the levels (the default
 pattern is `{0, 1, 2, 3}` -- the nearest cascade every frame, each further one half as often),
 and [`SetActiveShadowPassCount`](Self::SetActiveShadowPassCount) reads them each frame,
 gated against a rolling counter, to decide which cascades refresh. This is the mechanism that
 amortises cascade re-renders across frames.

fields.name: m_ShadowTransparency
fields.doc:
The global sun-shadow transparency (0 = opaque shadows, 1 = no shadows), registered as the
 console variable `"Dev|Graphics|Shadows|Transparency"` and defaulting to 0.
 [`GetShadowFade`](Self::GetShadowFade) returns it while the shadow system is enabled.

fields.name: m_ShadowCascades
fields.doc:
The forward-material cascade blocks for each frame parity, written by
 [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender). [`RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera`] copies the
 parity's block into
 [`RenderContext::m_ShadowCascades`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_ShadowCascades).

fields.name: m_ScratchCamera
fields.doc:
The shadow light camera the static-shadow passes draw with; the uniform-light update rebuilds
 it from the cascade's matrices each dispatch.

fields.name: m_ShadowTextureMatrix
fields.doc:
The per-slice projective shadow transforms for each frame parity (`[parity][slice]`),
 written by [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender). [`RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera`] copies
 the parity's matrices into
 [`RenderContext::m_ShadowMatrices`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_ShadowMatrices).

fields.name: m_HorizonMaps
fields.doc:
The terrain horizon maps, `[map][parity]`. [`RenderPass::SetRenderContextCamera`] copies the
 parity's pair into
 [`RenderContext::m_HorizonMap0`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_HorizonMap0)
 and [`m_HorizonMap1`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::RenderContext::m_HorizonMap1).

fields.name: m_HorizonTime
fields.doc:
The horizon-map blend time for each frame parity, staged by `SetGlobalShaderConstants` into
 the vertex GlobalConstants (row 4 `.w`) as `m_HorizonTime[m_RenderFrameNo & 1]`.

fields.name: m_HorizonScale
fields.doc:
The horizon-map occlusion scale, staged by `SetGlobalShaderConstants` into the vertex
 GlobalConstants (row 5 `.w`) when [`m_EnableHorizonMapping`](Self::m_EnableHorizonMapping) is
 set, and 0 otherwise.

fields.name: m_EnableHorizonMapping
fields.doc: Whether horizon mapping is enabled.

fields.name: m_HorizonMapFallback
fields.doc:
The texture of the manager's black texture holder (`m_BlackTexture`), bound in place of a null
 horizon map by
 [`SetupLightingTextures`](graphics_engine::render_engine::RenderBlockTypeBase::SetupLightingTextures).

associated_functions.name: InitializeSystem
associated_functions.doc:
Initializes the shadow system at startup (called by `CGraphicsEngine::InitializeSystem` on
 [`GraphicsEngine::m_ShadowManager`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::m_ShadowManager)):
 sets the 1024-texel map size, clears [`shadow_system_enabled`], enables the manager through
 [`SetEnabled`](Self::SetEnabled), and starts the horizon-map streams.

associated_functions.name: GetShadowFade
associated_functions.doc:
The global sun-shadow fade factor staged into the shader constants:
 [`m_ShadowTransparency`](Self::m_ShadowTransparency) while the shadow system is enabled
 ([`shadow_system_enabled`]), otherwise 1.

associated_functions.name: CommitRenderPassSettings
associated_functions.doc:
The per-dispatch pass gate: clears every shadow pass's
 [`m_Enabled`](graphics_engine::render_pass::RenderPassState::m_Enabled) flag, then
 re-enables the passes the update pattern scheduled this frame and re-points their render
 targets by the frame parity.

associated_functions.name: SetEnabled
associated_functions.doc:
Creates or destroys the shadow render targets and passes; the settings path behind
 [`m_Enabled`](Self::m_Enabled).

associated_functions.name: UpdateRender
associated_functions.doc:
The sim-side per-frame update: syncs [`m_Enabled`](Self::m_Enabled) via
 [`SetEnabled`](Self::SetEnabled), fits the scheduled cascades to
 [`CameraManager::m_ActiveCamera`](camera::camera_manager::CameraManager::m_ActiveCamera)
 (the fit frustum comes from that camera's `m_ProjectionF`), copies the unscheduled
 cascades' previous fits forward, writes the parity-indexed cascade transforms and per-slice
 matrices the draw side reads, and regenerates the cull planes.

associated_functions.name: SetActiveShadowPassCount
associated_functions.doc:
Sets the number of active shadow passes (sun cascades plus spot shadows) and rebuilds the
 per-frame cascade update schedule: it refreshes the amortisation pattern (recomputing
 [`m_CascadeUpdateLevels`](Self::m_CascadeUpdateLevels) on a cascade/spot count change),
 then marks each cascade as either refreshing this frame -- when
 `((1 << m_CascadeUpdateLevels[c]) - 1) & rolling_counter == 0` -- or copying its previous fit
 forward. Called from `CGameStateRun::UpdateShadows` before
 [`UpdateRender`](Self::UpdateRender).

kind.doc:
The per-parity render-pass settings of one shadow frustum (`SShadowRenderPassSettings`): which
 atlas slices its dynamic and static passes draw into.

fields.name: m_SliceIndexStatic
fields.doc:
The atlas slice the static-geometry pass draws into, or negative when it does not draw.
 [`ShadowManager::CommitRenderPassSettings`] points the static pass at
 [`m_DepthRenderSetup`](ShadowManager::m_DepthRenderSetup) of this slice.

fields.name: m_SliceIndexDynamic
fields.doc: The atlas slice the dynamic-geometry pass draws into.

fields.name: m_CopyFromStaticSliceIndex
fields.doc: The static slice the dynamic slice is seeded from.

kind.doc:
The shadow system's global enable (`CShadowManager::m_SystemEnabled`). It gates
 [`ShadowManager::GetShadowFade`] and the per-dispatch
 [`ShadowManager::CommitRenderPassSettings`] call.

The per-instance skinning palette data (`NGraphicsEngine::CSkinningPaletteData`). Only its static
 deletion queue is mapped.

associated_functions.name: UpdateDeleteQueue
associated_functions.doc:
Drains the double-buffered, lock-protected queue of skinning-palette vertex buffers pending
 deletion (`CSkinningPaletteData::UpdateDeleteQueue`, static). Called once per dispatch from
 [`GraphicsEngine::HandleDrawThreadTask`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::HandleDrawThreadTask).
 IDA mislabels this address as a GPU-profiler `EndScope`.

kind.doc:
The screen-space ambient-occlusion render pass.

 It maintains a two-slot temporal AO history, blended in when `m_EnableTemporalFilter` is set. The
 history index advances once per render-block draw (an inlined `SetNextHistoryBuffer` at the end of
 the apply), not in the per-frame list rotation.

 The render block's final composite draw lives inside the `m_EnableTemporalFilter` branch, so
 clearing that flag disables the whole apply (no AO at all). `m_FirstPass` is the engine's "no valid
 history, compute fresh" lever: it skips the history resolve and weights the temporal shader fully
 toward the current AO. The render block clears it after the first apply.

fields.name: m_PrevFrameIndex
fields.doc:
The previously-resolved slot of the two-slot temporal AO history; the resolve samples it. It
 advances once per draw (the inlined `SetNextHistoryBuffer`), independent of `m_FirstPass`.

fields.name: m_CurrFrameIndex
fields.doc:
The current slot the resolve writes and the final composite samples; advances with
 [`m_PrevFrameIndex`](Self::m_PrevFrameIndex).

fields.name: m_EnableTemporalFilter
fields.doc:
Enables the temporal filter, blending the current AO against the previous frame's result
 through the history ping-pong. Defaults on. Also gates the render block's final composite draw,
 so clearing it disables AO entirely. The history reset without that side effect is
 [`m_FirstPass`](Self::m_FirstPass).

fields.name: m_FirstPass
fields.doc:
The "no valid history" lever. When set, it skips the history resolve and weights the temporal
 shader fully toward the current AO; the render block clears it after the first apply.

associated_functions.name: Draw
associated_functions.doc: Sets up the render context and enqueues the AO render block onto the active draw list.

kind.doc:
The parameters to [`Create2DTexture`]. Padding after [`m_PoolType`](Self::m_PoolType) aligns
 [`m_Name`](Self::m_Name) to eight bytes.

fields.name: m_NumSlices
fields.doc: The array-slice count (`1` for a plain 2D texture).

fields.name: m_ESRAMOffset
fields.doc: The ESRAM byte offset on the console backends; ignored on D3D11.

fields.name: m_Name
fields.doc:
A debug name for the texture. The resource-tracking builds register the created texture
 under `HashString(m_Name)` in the device's texture map; this build's creation path does
 not read it.

fields.name: m_Data
fields.doc: The initial contents, or null to leave the texture uninitialised.

fields.name: m_Flags
fields.doc:
A packed bitfield, from the low bit up: `m_PreTiled:1`, `m_PreAllocated:1`,
 `m_InvertedZcull:1`, `m_TiledMemory:1`, `m_GenerateMips:1`, `m_PackedMips:1`,
 `m_Castable:1`, `m_ColorSpace:1`, `m_UnorderedAccess:1`, `m_MipLevelClamp:4`,
 `m_RenderCompression:1`.

 [`Create2DTexture`] reads four of them on D3D11: `m_ColorSpace` requests the sRGB variant
 of the format, `m_Castable` creates the resource in the typeless equivalent of the format
 so views may reinterpret it, `m_UnorderedAccess` adds a UAV bind and creates the
 unordered-access view, and `m_MipLevelClamp` becomes the view's most-detailed mip.

fields.name: m_Tag
fields.doc: The allocation tag: `Group:6`, `Pool:1`, `Asset:1` from the low bit up.

kind.doc:
The parameters to [`CreateRenderSetup`]: the output targets a pass draws into. No dimensions
 appear here — a render setup's size is whatever its bound targets carry.

fields.name: m_DepthTarget
fields.doc: The depth-stencil target, or null for a colour-only setup.

fields.name: m_ColorTargets
fields.doc:
The colour targets, in `OMSetRenderTargets` order. The engine's own name for the first
 entry is `m_ColorTarget`, which shares storage with the array. The count is derived at
 creation by scanning for the first null, so the entries must be packed from `[0]`.

fields.name: m_UAVs
fields.doc:
The buffer unordered-access views bound alongside the targets, likewise counted by
 scanning for the first null.

fields.name: m_TextureUAVs
fields.doc: The texture unordered-access views, likewise counted by scanning for the first null.

fields.name: m_Mask
fields.doc: The colour-write mask stored on the setup.

fields.name: m_Flags
fields.doc:
A packed bitfield, from the low bit up: `m_AutoResolve:1`, `m_EDRAMLayout:2`,
 `m_UAVStart:4`. [`CreateRenderSetup`] reads `m_UAVStart` as the register slot the
 unordered-access views start at; the sentinel
 [`UAV_START_AFTER_COLOR_TARGETS`](Self::UAV_START_AFTER_COLOR_TARGETS) is replaced by the
 derived colour-target count.

fields.name: m_Base
fields.doc: The EDRAM base on the console backends; ignored on D3D11.

fields.name: m_HiZBase
fields.doc: The EDRAM hierarchical-Z base on the console backends; ignored on D3D11.

fields.name: m_ManualLayout
fields.doc: An explicit EDRAM layout for the console backends; null on D3D11.

kind.doc:
The [`m_Flags`](Self::m_Flags) value
 [`CreateRenderSetups`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::CreateRenderSetups)
 passes for its setups, including both back-buffer setups: it sets `m_AutoResolve`, leaves
 `m_EDRAMLayout` clear, and sets `m_UAVStart` to
 [`UAV_START_AFTER_COLOR_TARGETS`](Self::UAV_START_AFTER_COLOR_TARGETS).

The [`m_Mask`](Self::m_Mask) value enabling writes to all four colour channels, which
 [`CreateRenderSetups`](graphics_engine::graphics_engine::GraphicsEngine::CreateRenderSetups)
 passes for its setups.

The `m_UAVStart` value in [`m_Flags`](Self::m_Flags) that [`CreateRenderSetup`] replaces
 with the derived colour-target count, so the unordered-access views start immediately
 after the colour targets.
The parameters to [`CreateSurfaceAlias`].

fields.name: m_SourceSurface
fields.doc:
The surface to alias. Its handle is copied wholesale and its D3D11 resource is
 referenced, not duplicated.

fields.name: m_Format
fields.doc: The format the alias' views reinterpret the source resource as.

fields.name: m_Name
fields.doc:
A debug name for the alias. As with [`Create2DTextureParams::m_Name`], this build's
 creation path does not read it.

fields.name: m_Flags
fields.doc:
A packed bitfield, from the low bit up: `m_ColorSpace:1`, `m_ReadOnlyDepth:1`,
 `m_ReadOnlyStencil:1`. `m_ColorSpace` requests the sRGB variant of
 [`m_Format`](Self::m_Format); the read-only bits select the corresponding
 depth-stencil-view read-only flags.

kind.doc: The memory ordering of the initial data handed to a texture creator.

The multisample configuration of a surface or render setup. The low values double as the
 D3D11 sample count (`None` is one sample); the CSAA entries are legacy names with no D3D11
 equivalent.

Which memory pool a resource is allocated from. `SysMem` produces a staging resource;
 `GfxMem` is ordinary GPU memory.

A texture/surface pixel format. The values are the `DXGI_FORMAT` codes the backend passes
 straight to D3D11 (so [`ABGR32`](Self::ABGR32) is `DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM`), with a handful
 of platform-independent names above [`ARGB32`](Self::ARGB32) for formats D3D11 has no direct
 equivalent for. `Unknown` means "take the format from the source data".

 The engine's enumeration carries many aliases that resolve to the same code (`RGBA32`,
 `BGRA32`, and `FB_A8R8G8B8` all share [`ABGR32`](Self::ABGR32)'s code); only one name per
 value is listed here.

variants.name: ABGR32
variants.doc: 32-bit RGBA (`DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM`).

kind.doc:
The tiling/swizzle mode of a texture's memory. Only `Linear` is meaningful on D3D11; the
 other entries exist for the console backends.

How a resource is written to, which selects the D3D11 usage and bind flags at creation.
 [`Create2DTexture`] maps `RenderTarget` to a render-target (or depth-stencil, for a depth
 format) bind, `Dynamic` to a dynamic/CPU-writable resource, and `Default`/`Immutable` to a
 plain default-usage resource.

fields.name: m_Format
fields.doc: The `DXGI_FORMAT` value.

kind.doc:
A per-frame brightness histogram used for eye adaptation. Its occlusion-query bucket counts are
 what the exposure read-back consumes.

fields.name: m_NumPixelsInBuckets
fields.doc:
The per-bucket pixel counts: one occlusion query per bucket, counting samples whose luminance
 is at or above the bucket's threshold. Only the first `m_NumBuckets` entries are live.

fields.name: m_HistogramBrightPoint
fields.doc: The bright-point computed from the buckets, driving the exposure target.

fields.name: m_HistogramMidPoint
fields.doc: The mid-point computed from the buckets.

kind.doc:
An N-frame exposure smoother: a ring-buffer average that advances once per render, with no `dt`
 term.
HDR tone-mapping and auto-exposure (eye adaptation).

fields.name: m_Histogram
fields.doc:
The exposure-weighted histogram, filled by
 [`CalculateMidAndBrightPointForHistogram`] and read by [`Update`](Self::Update).

fields.name: m_HistogramPingPong
fields.doc:
The ping-pong selector for the exposure-weighted histogram metering, flipped each frame by
 [`Update`](Self::Update).

fields.name: m_Histogram2
fields.doc:
The second histogram, metering raw scene brightness. Its `m_HistogramMidPoint` is the divisor
 of the auto-exposure target (`target = key / midpoint`), so this -- not `m_Histogram` -- is
 what the converged [`m_ExposureBrightPoint`](Self::m_ExposureBrightPoint) actually tracks.

fields.name: m_NumBuckets
fields.doc: The active histogram bucket count.

fields.name: m_OcclusionQuerySlotSelector
fields.doc:
The ping-pong selector for the internal histogram ring the per-frame exposure step advances:
 [`Update`](Self::Update) increments it on every call, and the engine calls `Update` once per
 real frame.

fields.name: m_ExposureBrightPoint
fields.doc:
The applied auto-exposure multiplier: the clamped, smoothed (EMA) value
 [`Update`](Self::Update) writes once per frame. [`Apply`](Self::Apply) publishes it
 into the frame's [`PostEffectContext::m_Exposure`](PostEffectContext) --
 the value the HDR-to-LDR composite multiplies the scene by -- and feeds it back into the
 exposure-weighted histogram metering, closing the adaptation loop.

fields.name: m_HistogramBrightPointWithExposure
fields.doc:
The EMA'd bright point of the exposure-weighted histogram, published alongside
 [`m_ExposureBrightPoint`](Self::m_ExposureBrightPoint) by [`Apply`](Self::Apply).

associated_functions.name: Apply
associated_functions.doc:
The per-dispatch exposure publish and exposure-weighted meter, run at the start of the
 post-effects block: publishes [`m_ExposureBrightPoint`](Self::m_ExposureBrightPoint) and
 [`m_HistogramBrightPointWithExposure`](Self::m_HistogramBrightPointWithExposure) through
 `out_exposure` / `out_bright_point` (the caller passes the frame context's `m_Exposure` /
 `m_HistogramBrightPointAfterExposure`), and meters luminance through a shader fed the
 published exposure, so that histogram's metering is exposure-weighted.

associated_functions.name: GenerateHistogramForFinalScene
associated_functions.doc:
Meters the non-exposure-weighted final-scene luminance histogram (`m_Histogram2`) at a fixed
 exposure of `1.0`, so it measures raw scene brightness -- the value
 [`Update`](Self::Update) divides the auto-exposure target by. Runs once per
 dispatch in the post chain, after the effect chain.

associated_functions.name: Update
associated_functions.doc:
The per-frame eye-adaptation step: runs [`CalculateMidAndBrightPointForHistogram`] over both
 histograms, then adapts [`m_ExposureBrightPoint`](Self::m_ExposureBrightPoint) (the target is
 `m_AutoExposureKey` over the `m_Histogram2` mid-point, clamped, then EMA'd). Runs once per
 real frame.

kind.doc:
A hashed string id (`CHashString` / `ava::idstring`): a string reduced to its little-endian
 `hashlittle` hash, used as a type, state, and event id throughout the animation and event
 systems. Only the hash is stored.

fields.name: m_Hash
fields.doc: The `hashlittle(name)` hash identifying the string.

kind.doc:
One heat level's tuning (`CHeatManager::SLevelDef`), loaded from the heat settings. Partial:
 only the point threshold is mapped; the rest of the record is pursuer and vehicle
 budgets, timers, and the level's send/receive events.

fields.name: m_PointThreshold
fields.doc: The heat-point total at which the target's heat reaches this level.

kind.doc:
The heat (wanted level) system: tracks the heat target (the player), its heat points and
 level, the pursuer and ambient enemy lists, reinforcement calls, and roadblocks. Updated once
 per frame from the game systems update; every setter asserts the main thread.

fields.name: m_SystemActive
fields.doc:
Whether the heat system runs at all. While clear, the per-frame update skips heat
 accumulation, spawning, and vocals entirely. Toggled by the heat area triggers and by
 `SetHeatActive`.

fields.name: m_SystemLocked
fields.doc:
Whether heat changes are locked. While set, the update neither raises nor decays the level:
 heat points still accumulate on the target but no level transition, reinforcement call, or
 clear timer fires. Read together with the initial-heat timer by `GetHeatLocked`. Set by the
 `heat_lock` / `heat_unlock` events and `SetHeatLock`.

fields.name: m_Levels
fields.doc: Per-level tuning, indexed by level (`0..=MAX_LEVEL`).

fields.name: m_Level
fields.doc:
The current heat level, `0..=MAX_LEVEL`. Written by [`SetHeat`](Self::SetHeat) and
 [`ClearHeat`](Self::ClearHeat); read by every consumer (`GetHeat`).

fields.name: m_LevelCap
fields.doc:
The maximum level heat may reach, or [`LEVEL_CAP_NONE`](Self::LEVEL_CAP_NONE) for no cap.
 [`SetHeat`](Self::SetHeat) clamps the requested level to it unless told to ignore it.

associated_functions.name: SetHeat
